how to add and sign a paging seal signature
using System;
using System.Text;
using System.IO;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit;
using foxit.pdf.annots;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Security;
using System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates;
using System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using foxit.pdf.interform;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here
 static PagingSealSignature AddPagingSealSiganture(PDFDoc pdf_doc, string sub_filter, bool is_on_perforation)
 {
 using (PDFPage pdf_page = pdf_doc.GetPage(0))
 {
 float page_width = pdf_page.GetWidth();
 float page_height = pdf_page.GetHeight();
 float sig_width = page_width * (float)0.4;
 float sig_hegiht = page_height * (float)0.1;
 using (Range range = new Range(1, pdf_doc.GetPageCount(), Range.Filter.e_All))
 {
 // Add a new paging seal signature to document.
 PagingSealSignature new_sig = pdf_doc.AddPagingSealSignature(range, sig_width, sig_hegiht);
 using (PagingSealConfig paging_seal_config = new PagingSealConfig(PagingSealConfig.PagingSealPosition.e_PagingSealPositionLeft, page_height / 2, 0.5f, is_on_perforation, PagingSealConfig.PagingSealStyle.e_PagingSealStyleMultipleSignatures))
 {
 new_sig.SetPagingSealConfig(paging_seal_config);
 // Set values for the new paging seal signature.
 new_sig.SetKeyValue(Signature.KeyName.e_KeyNameSigner, "Foxit PDF SDK");
 return new_sig;
 }
 }
 }
 }
 static void AdobePPKLitePagingSealSignature(PDFDoc pdf_doc, bool use_default)
 {
 string filter = "Adobe.PPKLite";
 string sub_filter = "adbe.pkcs7.detached";
 Library.RegisterSignatureCallback(filter, sub_filter, null);
 bool is_on_perforation = true;
 // Add a new paging seal signature to the document.
 using (PagingSealSignature new_signature = AddPagingSealSiganture(pdf_doc, sub_filter, is_on_perforation))
 {
 // Set filter and subfilter for the new paging seal signature.
 new_signature.SetFilter(filter);
 new_signature.SetSubFilter(sub_filter);
 bool is_signed = new_signature.IsSigned();
 uint sig_state = new_signature.GetState();

 // Sign the new signature.
 String signed_pdf_path = "signed_middle_paging_seal_signature.pdf";

 String cert_file_path = "foxit_all.pfx";
 byte[] cert_file_password = Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes("123456");
 new_signature.StartSign(cert_file_path, cert_file_password,
 Signature.DigestAlgorithm.e_DigestSHA1, signed_pdf_path, IntPtr.Zero, null);
 is_signed = new_signature.IsSigned();
 sig_state = new_signature.GetState();
 using (PDFDoc signed_pdf_doc = new PDFDoc(signed_pdf_path))
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = signed_pdf_doc.Load(null);
 if (ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess != error_code)
 {
 return;
 }
 // Get the last signature which is just added and signed.
 int sig_count = signed_pdf_doc.GetSignatureCount();
 using (Signature signed_signature = signed_pdf_doc.GetSignature(sig_count - 1))
 {
 // Verify the intergrity of signature.
 signed_signature.StartVerify(IntPtr.Zero, null);
 is_signed = signed_signature.IsSigned();
 sig_state = signed_signature.GetState();
 }
 }
 }
 }

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }
 string input_file = "AboutFoxit.pdf";
 using (PDFDoc pdf_doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 pdf_doc.StartLoad(null, true, null);
 AdobePPKLitePagingSealSignature(pdf_doc, false);
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to edit layer tree
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Drawing;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Environment.Exit(1);
 }

 // edit layer tree
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("OCTest_src.pdf"))
 {
 error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Library.Release();
 return;
 }

 using (LayerTree layertree = new LayerTree(doc))
 {
 using (LayerNode root = layertree.GetRootNode())
 {
 if (root.IsEmpty())
 {
 Console.WriteLine("No layer information!\r\n");
 Library.Release();
 return;
 }
 int children_count = root.GetChildrenCount();
 root.RemoveChild(children_count - 1);

 using (LayerNode child = root.GetChild(children_count - 2))
 {
 using (LayerNode child0 = root.GetChild(0))
 {
 child.MoveTo(child0, 0);
 using (child.AddChild(0, "AddedLayerNode", true))
 using (child.AddChild(0, "AddedNode", false)) { }
 doc.SaveAs("edit_layer_tree.pdf", (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

---

how to output preview
using System;
using System.Drawing;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 // "default_icc_folder_path" is the path of the folder which contains default icc profile files. Please refer to Developer Guide for more details.
 string default_icc_folder_path = "";
 if (default_icc_folder_path.Length < 1)
 {
 return;
 }
 // Set folder path which contains default icc profile files.
 Library.SetDefaultICCProfilesPath(default_icc_folder_path);

 string input_file = "AboutFoxit.pdf";
 using (PDFDoc pdf_doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 error_code = pdf_doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Library.Release();
 return;
 }
 using (PDFPage pdf_page = pdf_doc.GetPage(0))
 {
 pdf_page.StartParse((int)foxit.pdf.PDFPage.ParseFlags.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);
 float page_width = (int)(pdf_page.GetWidth());
 float page_height = (int)(pdf_page.GetHeight());
 int bitmap_width = (int)page_width;
 int bitmap_height = (int)page_height;
 System.Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat pixel_format = System.Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat.Format32bppArgb;
 if (!pdf_page.HasTransparency())
 pixel_format = System.Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat.Format24bppRgb;
 Matrix2D display_matrix = pdf_page.GetDisplayMatrix(0, 0, bitmap_width, bitmap_height, Rotation.e_Rotation0);

 System.Drawing.Bitmap bitmap = new System.Drawing.Bitmap(bitmap_width, bitmap_height, pixel_format);
 Graphics draw = Graphics.FromImage(bitmap);
 draw.Clear(System.Drawing.Color.White);

 using (Renderer renderer = new Renderer(bitmap, false))
 {
 using (OutputPreview output_preview = new OutputPreview(pdf_doc))
 {
 string simulation_icc_file_path = "icc_profile/USWebCoatedSWOP.icc";
 output_preview.SetSimulationProfile(simulation_icc_file_path);
 output_preview.SetShowType(OutputPreview.ShowType.e_ShowAll);
 StringArray process_plates = output_preview.GetPlates(OutputPreview.ColorantType.e_ColorantTypeProcess);
 StringArray spot_plates = output_preview.GetPlates(OutputPreview.ColorantType.e_ColorantTypeSpot);

 for (uint i = 0; i < spot_plates.GetSize(); i++)
 {
 output_preview.SetCheckStatus(spot_plates.GetAt(i), true);
 }

 for (uint i = 0; i < process_plates.GetSize(); i++)
 {
 if (0 != i)
 {
 output_preview.SetCheckStatus(process_plates.GetAt(i - 1), false);
 }
 output_preview.SetCheckStatus(process_plates.GetAt(i), true);

 using (System.Drawing.Bitmap preview_bitmap = output_preview.GeneratePreviewBitmap(pdf_page, display_matrix, renderer))
 {
 using (foxit.common.Image result_image = new foxit.common.Image())
 {
 result_image.AddFrame(preview_bitmap);
 result_image.SaveAs("result.bmp");
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
 Console.WriteLine("[END] demo ouput_preview\n");

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

How to add a new attachment
using System;
using System.Text;
using System.IO;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.objects;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ".."; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ".."; // Enter the key here
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("Simple.pdf"))
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("Load document error!");
 }

 using (Attachments attachment = new Attachments(doc, new PDFNameTree()))
 {
 attachment.AddFromFilePath("OriginalAttachmentsInfo", "AboutFoxit.pdf");
 string newPdf = "attachment_add.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 Console.WriteLine("Add a new attachment to PDF document.");
 }
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

How to get associate files in catalog dictionary
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;
using foxit.pdf.objects;
using foxit.pdf.annots;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 const string sn = "";
 const string key = "";

 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("Simple.pdf"))
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("Load document error!");
 }

 AssociatedFiles associated_files = new AssociatedFiles(doc);

 PDFDictionary doc_catalog_dict = doc.GetCatalog();
 int count = associated_files.GetAssociatedFilesCount(doc_catalog_dict);
 if (count > 0)
 {
 FileSpec filespec = associated_files.GetAssociatedFile(doc_catalog_dict, 0);
 filespec.ExportToFile("af_1.txt");
 }
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to remove all headers and footers
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }

 {
 // Load PDF document.
 string input_file = "HeaderFooter.pdf";
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("The PDFDoc [{0}] Error: {1}\n", input_file, error_code);
 Library.Release();
 return;
 }

 using (HeaderFooter headerfooter = doc.GetEditableHeaderFooter())
 {

 // Remove all header-footers
 doc.RemoveAllHeaderFooters();
 string output_file = "HeaderFooter_RemoveAll.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(output_file, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 Console.WriteLine("Remove PDF document all header-footers.");
 }
 }
 }
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("Simple.pdf"))
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("Load document error!");

how to set all the layer nodes information
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Drawing;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 public static void SetAllLayerNodesInformation(LayerNode layer_node)
 {
 if (layer_node.HasLayer())
 {
 layer_node.SetDefaultVisible(true);
 layer_node.SetExportUsage(LayerTree.UsageState.e_StateUndefined);
 layer_node.SetViewUsage(LayerTree.UsageState.e_StateOFF);
 LayerPrintData print_data = new LayerPrintData("subtype_print", LayerTree.UsageState.e_StateON);
 layer_node.SetPrintUsage(print_data);
 LayerZoomData zoom_data = new LayerZoomData(1, 10);
 layer_node.SetZoomUsage(zoom_data);
 string new_name = "[View_OFF_Print_ON_Export_Undefined]" + layer_node.GetName();
 layer_node.SetName(new_name);
 }
 int count = layer_node.GetChildrenCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
 {
 using (LayerNode child = layer_node.GetChild(i))
 {
 SetAllLayerNodesInformation(child);
 }
 }
 }

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode errorCode = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (errorCode != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("OCTest_src.pdf"))
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load(null);
 using (LayerTree layertree = new LayerTree(doc))
 {
 using (LayerNode root = layertree.GetRootNode())
 {
 SetAllLayerNodesInformation(root);
 doc.SaveAs("new_layers.pdf", (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 }
 }
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

How to add a screen annotation
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;
using foxit.pdf.annots;
using foxit.pdf.actions;
using foxit.pdf.objects;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static String RandomUID()
 {
 return System.Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
 }
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 const string sn = "";
 const string key = "";

 Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("Sample.pdf"))
 {
 doc.Load(null);

 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);

 { //Add a screen annotation
 Screen screen = null;
 Annot annot = null;
 foxit.common.Image image = null;
 Rendition rendition = null;
 RenditionAction rendition_action = null;
 FileSpec video_filespec = null;
 foxit.pdf.actions.Action action = null;
 BorderInfo borderInfo = null;
 PDFDoc doc = null;
 using (doc = page.GetDocument())
 using (annot = page.AddAnnot(Annot.Type.e_Screen, new RectF(300, 150, 400, 200)))
 using (image = new foxit.common.Image("FoxitLogo.jpg"))
 using (rendition = new Rendition(doc, null))
 using (action = foxit.pdf.actions.Action.Create(doc, foxit.pdf.actions.Action.Type.e_TypeRendition))
 using (rendition_action = new RenditionAction(action))
 using (video_filespec = new FileSpec(doc))
 using (borderInfo = new BorderInfo(2, BorderInfo.Style.e_Solid, 0, 0, new FloatArray()))
 using (screen = new Screen(annot))
 {
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 screen.SetFlags(4);
 screen.SetTitle("Foxit SDK");
 screen.SetUniqueID(RandomUID());
 screen.SetBorderColor(0x0000FF);
 screen.SetBorderInfo(borderInfo);
 screen.SetImage(image, 0, 1);

 // Prepare rendition action
 rendition_action.SetOperationType(RenditionAction.OperationType.e_OpTypeAssociate);
 rendition_action.SetScreenAnnot(screen);

 // Prepare rendition
 rendition.SetRenditionName("screen for rendition");
 rendition.SetMediaClipName("ytb210-Mopa.mp4");
 rendition.SetPermission(Rendition.MediaPermission.e_MediaPermTempAccess);

 String video_file_path = "ytb210-Mopa.mp4";
 video_filespec.SetFileName("ytb210-Mopa.mp4");
 video_filespec.Embed(video_file_path);
 rendition.SetMediaClipFile(video_filespec);
 rendition.SetMediaClipContentType("video/mp4");
 rendition_action.InsertRendition(rendition, 0);
 screen.SetAction(rendition_action);

 // Appearance should be reset.
 screen.ResetAppearanceStream();
 Console.WriteLine("Add a screen annotation.");
 }
 }

 // Save PDF file
 string newPdf = "newpdf.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

---

how to add and sign a PAdES signature
using System;
using System.Text;

using foxit.common;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.objects;
using foxit;
using foxit.pdf.annots;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf.interform;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = "";
 static string key = "";

 static void PAdESSign(string input_pdf, string signed_pdf_path, Signature.PAdESLevel pades_level)
 {
 string cached_signed_pdf_path = "cache.pdf";
 string real_signed_pdf_path = signed_pdf_path;
 using (PDFDoc pdf_doc = new PDFDoc(input_pdf))
 {
 pdf_doc.StartLoad(null, true, null);
 using (PDFPage pdf_page = pdf_doc.GetPage(0))
 {
 float page_width = pdf_page.GetWidth() / 2;
 float page_height = pdf_page.GetHeight() / 2;
 RectF rect = new RectF((page_width - 50.0f), (page_height - 50.0f), (page_width + 50.0f), (page_height + 50.0f));
 using (Signature new_signature = pdf_page.AddSignature(rect))
 {
 string filter = "Adobe.PPKLite";
 string sub_filter = "ETSI.CAdES.detached";
 new_signature.SetFilter(filter);
 new_signature.SetSubFilter(sub_filter);

 new_signature.SetKeyValue(Signature.KeyName.e_KeyNameSigner, "Foxit");

 String cert_path = "foxit.pfx";
 byte[] cert_password = Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes("123");
 using (Progressive sign_progressive = new_signature.StartSign(cert_path, cert_password, Signature.DigestAlgorithm.e_DigestSHA256,
 cached_signed_pdf_path, IntPtr.Zero, null))
 {
 if (sign_progressive.GetRateOfProgress() != 100)
 {
 if (Progressive.State.e_Finished != sign_progressive.Continue())
 {
 return;
 }
 }
 if (pades_level > Signature.PAdESLevel.e_PAdESLevelBT)
 {
 using (PDFDoc cache_doc = new PDFDoc(cached_signed_pdf_path))
 {
 cache_doc.StartLoad(null, true, null);
 cache_doc.CreateDSS();

 if (pades_level > Signature.PAdESLevel.e_PAdESLevelBLT)
 {
 using (PDFPage cache_pdf_page = cache_doc.GetPage(0))
 {
 using (Signature time_stamp_signature = cache_pdf_page.AddSignature(new RectF(), "", Signature.SignatureType.e_SignatureTypeTimeStamp, true))
 {
 using (Progressive progressive = time_stamp_signature.StartSign("", null,
 Signature.DigestAlgorithm.e_DigestSHA256, real_signed_pdf_path, IntPtr.Zero, null))
 {
 if (progressive.GetRateOfProgress() != 100)
 {
 if (Progressive.State.e_Finished != progressive.Continue())
 {
 return;
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
 else
 {
 cache_doc.SaveAs(real_signed_pdf_path, Convert.ToInt32(PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagIncremental));
 }
 }
 }

 }
 }
 }
 }
 }

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 {
 TimeStampServerMgr.Initialize();

 PAdESSign("About.pdf", "rst.pdf", Signature.PAdESLevel.e_PAdESLevelBB);

 TimeStampServerMgr.Release();
 }
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

---

how to add Long Term Validation
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.IO;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Security;
using System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates;
using System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs;
using System.Security.Cryptography;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 const string FREE_ETSIRFC316TSA_SERVER_NAME = "FreeTSAServer";
 const string FREE_ETSIRFC316TSA_SERVER_URL = "http://ca.signfiles.com/TSAServer.aspx";
 const string PKCS7_SIGNATURE_FILTER = "Adobe.PPKLite";
 const string PKCS7_SIGNATURE_SUBFILTER = "adbe.pkcs7.detached";

 static void UseLTVVerifier(PDFDoc pdf_doc, bool is_to_add_dss)
 {
 using (LTVVerifier ltv_verifier = new LTVVerifier(pdf_doc, true, true, false, LTVVerifier.TimeType.e_SignatureCreationTime))
 {
 ltv_verifier.SetTrustedCertStoreCallback(null);
 ltv_verifier.SetVerifyMode(LTVVerifier.VerifyMode.e_VerifyModeAcrobat);

 SignatureVerifyResultArray sig_verify_result_array = ltv_verifier.Verify();
 for (uint i = 0; i < sig_verify_result_array.GetSize(); i++)
 {
 SignatureVerifyResult sig_verify_result = sig_verify_result_array.GetAt(i);
 string signature_name = sig_verify_result.GetSignatureName();
 uint sig_state = sig_verify_result.GetSignatureState();
 SignatureVerifyResult.LTVState ltv_state = sig_verify_result.GetLTVState();
 string ltv_state_str = "";
 switch (ltv_state)
 {
 case SignatureVerifyResult.LTVState.e_LTVStateInactive:
 ltv_state_str = "inactive";
 break;
 case SignatureVerifyResult.LTVState.e_LTVStateEnable:
 ltv_state_str = "enabled";
 break;
 case SignatureVerifyResult.LTVState.e_LTVStateNotEnable:
 ltv_state_str = "not enabled";
 break;
 }
 Console.WriteLine(String.Format("Signature name:{0}, LTV state: {1}",
 signature_name, ltv_state_str));
 }

 if (is_to_add_dss)
 {
 for (uint i = 0; i < sig_verify_result_array.GetSize(); i++)
 {
 if ((sig_verify_result_array.GetAt(i).GetSignatureState() & Convert.ToUInt32(Signature.States.e_StateVerifyValid)) > 0)
 ltv_verifier.AddDSS(sig_verify_result_array.GetAt(i));
 }
 }
 }
 }

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 string signed_pdf_path = "AboutFoxit_signed.pdf";
 string saved_ltv_pdf_path = "AboutFoxit_signed_ltv.pdf";

 TimeStampServerMgr.Initialize();
 TimeStampServer timestamp_server = TimeStampServerMgr.AddServer(FREE_ETSIRFC316TSA_SERVER_NAME, FREE_ETSIRFC316TSA_SERVER_URL, "", "");
 TimeStampServerMgr.SetDefaultServer(timestamp_server);

 PDFDoc pdf_doc = new PDFDoc(signed_pdf_path);
 pdf_doc.StartLoad(null, true, null);
 Console.WriteLine("== Before Add DSS ==\r\n");
 UseLTVVerifier(pdf_doc, true);

 PDFPage pdf_page = pdf_doc.GetPage(0);
 Signature timestamp_signature = pdf_page.AddSignature(new RectF(), "", Signature.SignatureType.e_SignatureTypeTimeStamp, true);
 byte[] empty_byte = Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes("");
 Progressive sign_progressive = timestamp_signature.StartSign("", empty_byte, Signature.DigestAlgorithm.e_DigestSHA256,
 saved_ltv_pdf_path, IntPtr.Zero, null);
 if (sign_progressive.GetRateOfProgress() != 100)
 sign_progressive.Continue();

 PDFDoc check_pdf_doc = new PDFDoc(saved_ltv_pdf_path);
 check_pdf_doc.StartLoad(null, true, null);
 Console.WriteLine("== After Add DSS ==\r\n");
 UseLTVVerifier(check_pdf_doc, false);

 TimeStampServerMgr.Release();

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to optimize pdf file by discard useless uer data
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.IO;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;
using foxit.pdf.objects;
using foxit.addon;
using foxit.addon.optimization;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 string input_file = "DiscardObjects.pdf";
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("Document Load Error: {0}", error_code);
 return;
 }
 using (OptimizerSettings settings = new OptimizerSettings())
 {
 settings.SetOptimizerOptions((int)foxit.addon.optimization.OptimizerSettings.OptimizerOptions.e_OptimizerDiscardObjects);
 settings.SetDiscardObjectsOptions((int)(foxit.addon.optimization.OptimizerSettings.DiscardObjectsOptions.e_DiscardObjectsBookmarks | foxit.addon.optimization.OptimizerSettings.DiscardObjectsOptions.e_DiscardObjectsEmbeddedPageThumbnails
 | foxit.addon.optimization.OptimizerSettings.DiscardObjectsOptions.e_DiscardObjectsEmbeddedPrintSettings | foxit.addon.optimization.OptimizerSettings.DiscardObjectsOptions.e_DiscardObjectsFlattenFormFields
 | foxit.addon.optimization.OptimizerSettings.DiscardObjectsOptions.e_DiscardObjectsFormActions | foxit.addon.optimization.OptimizerSettings.DiscardObjectsOptions.e_DiscardObjectsJavaScriptActions));
 Progressive progressive = Optimizer.Optimize(doc, settings, null);
 Progressive.State progress_state = Progressive.State.e_ToBeContinued;
 while (Progressive.State.e_ToBeContinued == progress_state)
 {
 progress_state = progressive.Continue();
 int percent = progressive.GetRateOfProgress();
 Console.WriteLine("Optimize progress percent: {0}%", percent);
 }
 if (Progressive.State.e_Finished == progress_state)
 {
 doc.SaveAs("DiscardObjects_Optimized.pdf", (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagRemoveRedundantObjects);
 }
 }
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to do some operation about PDF object
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;
using foxit.pdf.objects;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Environment.Exit(1);
 }

 {
 String input_file = "pdfobjects.pdf";
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 doc.Load(null);

 // Do some operation about PDF object.
 ObjectOperation(doc);
 String save_pdf_patth = "pdfobjects_addnewobjects.pdf";
 doc.StartSaveAs(save_pdf_patth, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal, null);
 }
 }

 Library.Release();
 }

 static void ObjectOperation(PDFDoc document)
 {
 PDFObject boolean_object = PDFObject.CreateFromBoolean(true);
 int boolean_object_number = document.AddIndirectObject(boolean_object);
 Boolean boolean_object_value = boolean_object.GetBoolean();
 PDFObject float_object = PDFObject.CreateFromFloat(0.1f);
 int float_object_number = document.AddIndirectObject(float_object);
 float float_object_value = float_object.GetFloat();

 PDFObject integer_object = PDFObject.CreateFromInteger(1);
 int integer_object_number = document.AddIndirectObject(integer_object);
 int integer_object_value = integer_object.GetInteger();

 PDFObject string_object = PDFObject.CreateFromString("foxit");
 int string_object_number = document.AddIndirectObject(string_object);
 String string_object_value = string_object.GetWideString();

 PDFObject name_object = PDFObject.CreateFromName("sdk");
 int name_object_number = document.AddIndirectObject(name_object);
 String name_object_value = name_object.GetName();

 foxit.common.DateTime date_time = new foxit.common.DateTime(2017, 9, 27, 19, 36, 6, 0, (short)8, 0);
 PDFObject datetime_object = PDFObject.CreateFromDateTime(date_time);
 int datetime_object_number = document.AddIndirectObject(datetime_object);
 String datetime_object_value = datetime_object.GetWideString();

 PDFArray array = PDFArray.Create();
 PDFObject boolean_object_reference = PDFObject.CreateReference(document, boolean_object_number);
 int boolean_object_reference_number = boolean_object_reference.GetObjNum();
 PDFObject float_object_reference = PDFObject.CreateReference(document, float_object_number);
 PDFObject integer_object_reference = PDFObject.CreateReference(document, integer_object_number);
 PDFObject integer_object_direct = integer_object_reference.GetDirectObject();
 Console.WriteLine(String.Format("Object number of the direct number object: " + integer_object_direct.GetObjNum()));
 PDFObject string_object_reference = PDFObject.CreateReference(document, string_object_number);
 PDFObject name_object_reference = PDFObject.CreateReference(document, name_object_number);
 PDFObject datetime_object_reference = PDFObject.CreateReference(document, datetime_object_number);

 array.AddElement(boolean_object_reference);
 array.AddElement(float_object_reference);
 array.AddElement(integer_object_reference);
 array.AddElement(string_object_reference);
 array.AddElement(name_object_reference);
 array.AddElement(datetime_object_reference);
 array.AddElement(boolean_object.CloneObject());

 int array_object_number = document.AddIndirectObject(array);
 Console.WriteLine(String.Format("Object number of array object: " + array_object_number));
 }
 }
}

---

how to compare two pdf documents and marked the difference of insert type
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.annots;
using foxit.addon;
using foxit.addon.comparison;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static void CreateInsertStamp(PDFPage page, RectFArray rects, int color, String csContents, String csType, String csObjType)
 {
 RectF rcStamp = new RectF();
 int rectSize = rects.GetSize();
 if (rectSize > 0)
 {
 RectF item = rects.GetAt(0);
 rcStamp.left = item.left;
 rcStamp.top = item.top - 4;
 rcStamp.right = rcStamp.left + 4;
 rcStamp.bottom = rcStamp.top - 8;
 }

 Image pImage = new Image("insert_stamp.png");

 using (Annot annot = page.AddAnnot(Annot.Type.e_Stamp, rcStamp))
 {
 Stamp stamp = new Stamp(annot);
 stamp.SetContent(csContents);
 stamp.SetBorderColor(color);
 stamp.SetSubject(csObjType);
 stamp.SetTitle(csType);
 stamp.SetImage(pImage, 0, 0);

 stamp.ResetAppearanceStream();
 stamp.Dispose();
 }
 }

 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 // Initialize library
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 {
 using (PDFDoc base_doc = new PDFDoc("test_base.pdf"))
 {
 error_code = base_doc.Load(null);

 using (PDFDoc compared_doc = new PDFDoc("test_compared.pdf"))
 {
 error_code = compared_doc.Load(null);

 using (Comparison comparison = new Comparison(base_doc, compared_doc))
 {
 CompareResults result = comparison.DoCompare(0, 0, (int)Comparison.CompareType.e_CompareTypeText);
 CompareResultInfoArray oldInfo = result.base_doc_results;
 CompareResultInfoArray newInfo = result.compared_doc_results;
 uint oldInfoSize = oldInfo.GetSize();
 uint newInfoSize = newInfo.GetSize();

 using (PDFPage page1 = base_doc.GetPage(0))
 {
 for (uint i = 0; i < oldInfoSize; i++)
 {
 CompareResultInfo item = oldInfo.GetAt(i);
 CompareResultInfo.CompareResultType type = item.type;
 if (type == CompareResultInfo.CompareResultType.e_CompareResultTypeInsertText)
 {
 String res_string = String.Format("\"{0}\"", item.diff_contents);
 CreateInsertStamp(page1, item.rect_array, 0x0000ff, res_string, "Compare : Insert", "Text");
 }
 }
 }
 base_doc.SaveAs("old.pdf", (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNormal);

 using (PDFDoc new_doc = comparison.GenerateComparedDoc((int)Comparison.CompareType.e_CompareTypeAll))
 {
 new_doc.SaveAs("generate_result.pdf", (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNormal);
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("Sample.pdf"))
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("Load document error!");
 }

 int page_count = doc.GetPageCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < page_count; i++)
 {
 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(i);
 int annot_count = page.GetAnnotCount();
 for (int j = 0; j < annot_count; j++)
 {
 Annot annot = page.GetAnnot(j);
 }
 }
 }

how to add a text form field to a PDF
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.interform;
using foxit.pdf.annots;
using foxit.pdf.actions;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc())
 {
 using (Form form = new Form(doc))
 {
 // Create a blank new page and add some form fields.
 using (PDFPage page = doc.InsertPage(0, PDFPage.Size.e_SizeLetter))
 {
 // Add text field
 using (Control control = form.AddControl(page, "Text Field0", Field.Type.e_TypeTextField, new RectF(50f, 600f, 90f, 640f)))
 using (Control control1 = form.AddControl(page, "Text Field1", Field.Type.e_TypeTextField, new RectF(100f, 600f, 140f, 640f)))
 using (Control control2 = form.AddControl(page, "Text Field2", Field.Type.e_TypeTextField, new RectF(150f, 600f, 190f, 640f)))
 using (Field field = control.GetField())
 {
 field.SetValue("3");
 // Update text field's appearance.
 using (Widget widget = control.GetWidget())
 widget.ResetAppearanceStream();
 using (Field field1 = control1.GetField())
 {
 field1.SetValue("23");
 // Update text field's appearance.
 using (Widget widget1 = control1.GetWidget())
 widget1.ResetAppearanceStream();

 using (Field field2 = control2.GetField())
 using (PDFDoc doc2 = form.GetDocument())
 using (foxit.pdf.actions.Action action = foxit.pdf.actions.Action.Create(doc2, foxit.pdf.actions.Action.Type.e_TypeJavaScript))
 using (foxit.pdf.actions.JavaScriptAction javascipt_action = new foxit.pdf.actions.JavaScriptAction(action))
 {
 javascipt_action.SetScript("AFSimple_Calculate(\"SUM\", new Array (\"Text Field0\", \"Text Field1\"));");
 using (AdditionalAction aa = new AdditionalAction(field2))
 {
 aa.SetAction(AdditionalAction.TriggerEvent.e_TriggerFieldRecalculateValue, javascipt_action);
 field2.SetValue("333333");
 // Update text field's appearance.
 using (Widget widget2 = control2.GetWidget())
 widget2.ResetAppearanceStream();
 Console.WriteLine("Add text field.");
 }
 }
 }
 }
 string new_pdf = "form.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(new_pdf, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
 }
 }
}

how to show doc information
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.IO;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;

namespace docinfoCS
{

 class docinfo
 {
 public static PDFDoc.DisplayMode[] display_modes = {PDFDoc.DisplayMode.e_DisplayUseNone,PDFDoc.DisplayMode.e_DisplayUseOutlines,
 PDFDoc.DisplayMode.e_DisplayUseThumbs, PDFDoc.DisplayMode.e_DisplayFullScreen,PDFDoc.DisplayMode.e_DisplayUseOC,
 PDFDoc.DisplayMode.e_DisplayUseAttachment};

 public static string[] display_mode_strings = { "UseNone", "UseOutlines", "UseThumbs", "FullScreen", "UseOC", "UseAttachment" };

 public static string[] metadata_items = { "Title", "Author", "Subject", "Keywords", "Creator", "Producer", "CreationDate", "ModDate" };

 public static void ShowDocViewerPrefsInfo(PDFDoc doc, string file_name)
 {
 using (DocViewerPrefs prefs = new DocViewerPrefs(doc, null))
 {

 // Get display mode for non full-screen mode.
 PDFDoc.DisplayMode mode = prefs.GetNonFullScreenPageMode();
 string display_mode = "";
 for (int i = 0; i < display_modes.Length; i++)
 {
 if (mode == display_modes[i])
 {
 display_mode = display_mode_strings[i];
 break;
 }
 }
 // Get reading direction.
 // Get the type of area item.
 PDFPage.BoxType type = prefs.GetPrintClip();
 type = prefs.GetPrintArea();
 type = prefs.GetViewArea();
 type = prefs.GetViewClip();
 Range print_ranges = prefs.GetPrintRange();
 }
 }

 public static void ShowMetaDataInfo(PDFDoc doc, string file_name)
 {
 using (Metadata metadata = new Metadata(doc))
 {
 for (int i = 0; i < metadata_items.Length; i++)
 {
 string item = metadata_items[i];
 WStringArray value = metadata.GetValues(item);
 }
 }
 }

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 string sn = "";
 string key = "";
 // Initialize library
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("Library Initialize Error: {0}\n", error_code);
 return;
 }

 try
 {
 string input_file = "AboutFoxit.pdf";
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 ErrorCode code = doc.Load(null);
 if (code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Library.Release();
 return;
 }

 // Show document information.
 ShowDocViewerPrefsInfo(doc, "new.txt");
 ShowMetaDataInfo(doc, "new.txt");
 string output_file = "AboutFoxit_docinfo.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(output_file, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 }
 catch (foxit.PDFException e)
 {
 Console.WriteLine(e.Message);
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

How to add a circle annotation
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;
using foxit.pdf.annots;
using foxit.pdf.actions;
using foxit.pdf.objects;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static foxit.common.DateTime GetLocalDateTime()
 {
 System.DateTimeOffset rime = System.DateTimeOffset.Now;
 foxit.common.DateTime datetime = new foxit.common.DateTime();
 datetime.year = (UInt16)rime.Year;
 datetime.month = (UInt16)rime.Month;
 datetime.day = (ushort)rime.Day;
 datetime.hour = (UInt16)rime.Hour;
 datetime.minute = (UInt16)rime.Minute;
 datetime.second = (UInt16)rime.Second;

 datetime.utc_hour_offset = (short)rime.Offset.Hours;
 datetime.utc_minute_offset = (ushort)rime.Offset.Minutes;

 return datetime;
 }
 static String RandomUID()
 {
 return System.Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
 }
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 const string sn = "";
 const string key = "";

 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("Sample.pdf"))
 {
 doc.Load(null);

 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);
 {
 // Add circle annotation
 Circle circle = null;
 Annot annot = null;
 using (annot = page.AddAnnot(Annot.Type.e_Circle, new RectF(100, 650, 200, 750)))
 using (circle = new Circle(annot))
 {
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 circle.SetFlags(4);
 circle.SetInnerRect(new RectF(120, 660, 160, 740));
 circle.SetSubject("Circle");
 circle.SetTitle("Foxit SDK");
 circle.SetCreationDateTime(GetLocalDateTime());
 circle.SetModifiedDateTime(GetLocalDateTime());
 circle.SetUniqueID(RandomUID());
 // Appearance should be reset.
 circle.ResetAppearanceStream();
 Console.WriteLine("Add a circle annotation.");
 }
 }

 // Save PDF file
 string newPdf = "newpdf.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to add a single watermark
using System;
using System.IO;

using foxit.common;
using foxit.pdf;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }
 const string input_file = "AboutFoxit.pdf";
 const string output_file = "watermark_add.pdf";
 using (var doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 error_code = doc.Load(null);

 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("The PDFDoc " + input_file + " Error: " + error_code);
 return;
 }
 int nCount = doc.GetPageCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < nCount; i++)
 {
 using (var page = doc.GetPage(i))
 {
 page.StartParse((int)PDFPage.ParseFlags.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);

 AddSingleWatermark(doc, page);
 }
 }

 doc.SaveAs(output_file, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 Console.WriteLine("Add watermarks to PDF file.");
 }

 Library.Release();
 }

 static void AddSingleWatermark(PDFDoc doc, PDFPage page)
 {
 using (var settings = new WatermarkSettings())
 {
 settings.flags = (int)(WatermarkSettings.Flags.e_FlagASPageContents | WatermarkSettings.Flags.e_FlagOnTop);
 settings.offset_x = 0.0f;
 settings.offset_y = 0.0f;
 settings.opacity = 90;
 settings.position = Position.e_PosBottomRight;
 settings.rotation = 0.0f;
 settings.scale_x = 0.1f;
 settings.scale_y = 0.1f;
 using (var watermark = new Watermark(doc, page, settings))
 {
 watermark.InsertToPage(page);
 }
 }
 }
 }
}

how to export and import XFA form data
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.addon;
using foxit.pdf.annots;
using foxit.addon.xfa;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }

 string input_file = "xfa_dynamic.pdf";
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("The PDFDoc [{0}] Error: {1}\n", input_file, error_code);
 Library.Release();
 return;
 }

 using (XFADoc xfa_doc = new XFADoc(doc, null))
 {
 xfa_doc.StartLoad(null);

 xfa_doc.ExportData("xfa_form.xml", XFADoc.ExportDataType.e_ExportDataTypeXML);
 xfa_doc.ResetForm();
 doc.SaveAs("xfa_dynamic_resetform.pdf", (int)foxit.pdf.PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNormal);
 xfa_doc.ImportData("xfa_form.xml");
 doc.SaveAs("xfa_dynamic_importdata.pdf", (int)foxit.pdf.PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNormal);
 }
 Console.WriteLine("Xfa_form test.");
 }
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

How to add a stamp annotation
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;
using foxit.pdf.annots;
using foxit.pdf.actions;
using foxit.pdf.objects;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 const string sn = "";
 const string key = "";

 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 int err_ret = 0;

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("Sample.pdf"))
 {
 doc.Load(null);

 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);

 {
 // Set icon provider for annotation to Foxit PDF SDK.
 IconProvider icon_provider = new IconProvider("../input_files/Stamps");
 icon_provider.SetUseDynamicStamp(false);
 Library.SetAnnotIconProviderCallback(icon_provider);

 // Add common stamp annotation.
 Library.SetActionCallback(null);
 Stamp static_stamp = null;
 Annot annot = null;

 using (annot = page.AddAnnot(Annot.Type.e_Stamp, new RectF(110, 150, 200, 250)))
 using (static_stamp = new Stamp(annot))
 {
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 static_stamp.SetFlags(4);
 static_stamp.SetIconName("Approved");
 // Appearance should be reset.
 static_stamp.ResetAppearanceStream();

 // using (action_event = new ActionEvent(page.GetDocument()))
 {
 // Add dynamic stamp annotation.
 Library.SetActionCallback(action_callback);
 icon_provider.SetUseDynamicStamp(true);
 Stamp dynamic_stamp = null;
 using (annot = page.AddAnnot(Annot.Type.e_Stamp, new RectF(10, 150, 100, 250)))
 using (dynamic_stamp = new Stamp(annot))
 {
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 dynamic_stamp.SetFlags(4);
 dynamic_stamp.SetIconName("Approved");
 // Appearance should be reset.
 dynamic_stamp.ResetAppearanceStream();
 Console.WriteLine("Add stamp annotations.");
 }
 }

 }
 }

 // Save PDF file
 string newPdf = "newpdf.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to add an image to pdf page
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;

using foxit.common;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 string input_file = "graphics_objects.pdf";

 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(input_file);
 ErrorCode ret = doc.Load(null);
 // Add a new PDF page and insert image objects.
 PDFPage page = doc.InsertPage(1, 300, 600);
 string image_file = "sdk.png";
 AddImageObjects(page, image_file);

 Library.Release();
 }

 public static void AddImageObjects(PDFPage page, string image_file)
 {
 long position = page.GetLastGraphicsObjectPosition(GraphicsObject.Type.e_TypeImage);
 using (var image = new Image(image_file))
 {
 using (var doc = page.GetDocument())
 {
 using (var image_object = ImageObject.Create(doc))
 {
 image_object.SetImage(image, 0);

 float width = image.GetWidth();
 float height = image.GetHeight();
 float page_width = page.GetWidth();
 float page_height = page.GetHeight();

 // Please notice the matrix value.
 image_object.SetMatrix(new Matrix2D(width, 0, 0, height, (page_width - width) / 2.0f, (page_height - height) / 2.0f));
 page.InsertGraphicsObject(position, image_object);
 page.GenerateContent();
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
}

how to update header footer
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }

 string input_file = "HeaderFooter.pdf";
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("The PDFDoc [{0}] Error: {1}\n", input_file, error_code);
 Library.Release();
 return;
 }

 using (HeaderFooter headerfooter = doc.GetEditableHeaderFooter())
 {
 // Update header-footer
 using (HeaderFooterContentGenerator contentgenerator = new HeaderFooterContentGenerator())
 {
 contentgenerator.AddDate(HeaderFooterContentGenerator.DateFormatType.e_DateFormatMSlashDSlashYYYY);
 contentgenerator.AddString(" foxit");
 HeaderFooterContent content = headerfooter.content;
 content.header_right_content = contentgenerator.GenerateContent();
 headerfooter.content = content;
 doc.UpdateHeaderFooter(headerfooter);
 String output_file = "HeaderFooter_UpdateHeaderFooter.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(output_file, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 Console.WriteLine("Update PDF document header-footer.");
 }
 }
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to create mark content
using System;
using System.IO;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;
using foxit.pdf.objects;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc();
 ErrorCode ret = doc.Load(null);
 PDFPage page = doc.InsertPage(0,300,600);
 CreateMarkedContent(page);

 Library.Release();
 }

 static void CreateMarkedContent(PDFPage page)
 {
 long position = page.GetLastGraphicsObjectPosition(GraphicsObject.Type.e_TypeText);
 using (TextObject text_object = TextObject.Create())
 {
 text_object.SetFillColor(0xFF83AF9B);

 // Prepare text state
 using (TextState state = new TextState())
 {
 state.font_size = 72f;
 using (state.font = new Font(Font.StandardID.e_StdIDTimesB))
 {

 state.textmode = TextState.Mode.e_ModeFill;

 text_object.SetTextState(page, state, false, 750);

 text_object.SetText("Marked-Content");
 page.InsertGraphicsObject(position, text_object);

 RectF rect = text_object.GetRect();
 float offset_x = (page.GetWidth() - (rect.right - rect.left)) / 2;
 float offset_y = page.GetHeight() * 0.618f - (rect.top - rect.bottom) / 2;
 text_object.Transform(new Matrix2D(1, 0, 0, 1, offset_x, offset_y), false);

 MarkedContent content = text_object.GetMarkedContent();
 PDFDictionary span_dict = PDFDictionary.Create();
 span_dict.SetAtInteger("Direct", 55);
 content.AddItem("Span", span_dict);

 // Generate content
 page.GenerateContent();
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
}

---

how to add path into pdf page
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;

using foxit.common;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = "";
 static string key = "";

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 string input_file = "graphics_objects.pdf";
 using (var doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load(null);

 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }
 // Get original shading objects from PDF page.
 using (var original_page = doc.GetPage(0))
 {
 using (var progressive = original_page.StartParse((int)PDFPage.ParseFlags.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false))
 {
 long position = original_page.GetFirstGraphicsObjectPosition(GraphicsObject.Type.e_TypeShading);
 if (position == 0)
 {
 return;
 }
 using (var black_pieces = original_page.GetGraphicsObject(position))
 {
 position = original_page.GetNextGraphicsObjectPosition(position, GraphicsObject.Type.e_TypeShading);
 using (var white_pieces = original_page.GetGraphicsObject(position))
 {
 // Add a new PDF page and insert path objects, and copy shading objects.
 using (var page = doc.InsertPage(2, PDFPage.Size.e_SizeLetter))
 {
 AddPathObjects(page, black_pieces, white_pieces);
 }
 string output_file = "graphics_objects.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(output_file, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNormal);
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }

 Library.Release();
 }

 public static void AddPathObjects(PDFPage page, GraphicsObject black_pieces, GraphicsObject white_pieces)
 {
 long position = page.GetLastGraphicsObjectPosition(GraphicsObject.Type.e_TypePath);
 using (var path_object = PathObject.Create())
 {
 using (var path = new foxit.common.Path())
 {
 float page_width = page.GetWidth();
 float page_height = page.GetHeight();

 float width = Math.Min(page_width, page_height) / 20.0f;
 float start_x = (page_width - width * 18.0f) / 2.0f;
 float start_y = (page_height - width * 18.0f) / 2.0f;

 // Draw a chess board
 for (int i = 0; i < 19; i++)
 {
 float x1 = start_x;
 float y1 = i * width + start_y;

 float x2 = start_x + 18 * width;
 path.MoveTo(new PointF(x1, y1));
 path.LineTo(new PointF(x2, y1));

 x1 = i * width + start_x;
 y1 = start_y;

 float y2 = 18 * width + start_y;
 path.MoveTo(new PointF(x1, y1));
 path.LineTo(new PointF(x1, y2));
 }

 int[] star = { 3, 9, 15 };
 for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
 {
 for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++)
 {
 var rect = new RectF(start_x + star[i] * width - width / 12, start_y + star[j] * width - width / 12,
 start_x + star[i] * width + width / 12, start_y + star[j] * width + width / 12);
 path.AppendEllipse(rect);
 }
 }
 path_object.SetPathData(path);

 path_object.SetFillColor(0xFF000000);
 path_object.SetFillMode(FillMode.e_FillModeAlternate);
 path_object.SetStrokeState(true);
 path_object.SetStrokeColor(0xFF000000);

 page.InsertGraphicsObject(position, path_object);
 page.GenerateContent();
 }
 }
 }
 }
}

How to get bookmark information
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.IO;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.actions;

namespace bookmarkCS
{
 class TextDoc
 {
 private FileStream mfile_stream;
 public TextDoc(string file_name, FileMode fill_mode)
 {
 mfile_stream = new FileStream(file_name, fill_mode);
 }
 ~TextDoc()
 {
 try
 {
 mfile_stream.Flush();
 mfile_stream.Close();
 }
 catch (System.ObjectDisposedException e)
 {
 string str = e.Message;
 }

 }
 public void Write(string contents)
 {
 byte[] byte_data = Encoding.Default.GetBytes(contents);
 // Move file pointer to the end of file.
 mfile_stream.Seek(0, SeekOrigin.End);
 mfile_stream.Write(byte_data, 0, byte_data.Length);
 mfile_stream.Flush();
 }
 public string Read()
 {
 int fs_len = (int)mfile_stream.Length;
 byte[] byte_data = new byte[fs_len];
 int r = mfile_stream.Read(byte_data, 0, byte_data.Length);
 string contents = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetString(byte_data);
 return contents;
 }
 };

 class bookmark
 {
 public static void ShowBookmarksInfo(PDFDoc doc, string info_path)
 {
 TextDoc text_doc = new TextDoc(info_path, FileMode.Create);
 Bookmark root = doc.GetRootBookmark();
 using (root)
 {
 if (!root.IsEmpty())
 {
 ShowBookmarkInfo(root, text_doc, 0);
 }
 else
 {
 text_doc.Write("No bookmark information!\r\n");
 }
 }
 }

 public static void ShowBookmarkInfo(Bookmark bookmark, TextDoc doc, int depth)
 {
 if (depth > 32)
 return;
 if (bookmark.IsEmpty())
 return;
 for (int i = 0; i < depth; i++)
 doc.Write("\t");

 // Show bookmark's title.
 string title = bookmark.GetTitle();
 doc.Write(string.Format("{0}\t", title));

 // Show bookmark's color.
 int color = bookmark.GetColor();
 doc.Write(string.Format("color: {0:X}\r\n", color));
 using (Bookmark first_child = bookmark.GetFirstChild())
 ShowBookmarkInfo(first_child, doc, depth + 1);
 using (Bookmark next_sibling = bookmark.GetNextSibling())
 ShowBookmarkInfo(next_sibling, doc, depth);
 }

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 string sn = "";
 string key = "";
 // Initialize library
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("Library Initialize Error: {0}\n", error_code);
 return;
 }

 try
 {
 string input_file = "AboutFoxit.pdf";

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("The PDFDoc [{0}] Error: {1}\n", input_file, error_code);
 Library.Release();
 return;
 }

 // Show original bookmark information.
 ShowBookmarksInfo(doc, "bookmark_info.txt");
 }
 }
 catch (foxit.PDFException e)
 {
 Console.WriteLine(e.Message);
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

How to associate file to marked content
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;
using foxit.pdf.objects;
using foxit.pdf.annots;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("Simple.pdf"))
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("Load document error!");
 }

 using (foxit.common.DateTime dateTime = new foxit.common.DateTime(2017, 9, 15, 17, 20, 20, 0, 8, 0))
 {
 AssociatedFiles associated_files = new AssociatedFiles(doc);

 FileSpec filespec_jpg = new FileSpec(doc);
 filespec_jpg.SetAssociteFileRelationship(AssociatedFiles.Relationship.e_RelationshipSource);
 filespec_jpg.SetFileName("2.jpg");
 filespec_jpg.SetDescription("jpeg");
 filespec_jpg.Embed("2.jpg");
 filespec_jpg.SetCreationDateTime(dateTime);
 filespec_jpg.SetModifiedDateTime(dateTime);
 filespec_jpg.SetSubtype("application/octet-stream");

 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);
 page.StartParse((int)PDFPage.ParseFlags.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);
 PDFDictionary page_dict = page.GetDict();
 PDFDictionary resource_dict = (PDFDictionary)page_dict.GetElement("Resources");
 if (resource_dict == null)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("Resource dictionary not found!");
 Environment.Exit(1);
 }

 Int64 position = page.GetFirstGraphicsObjectPosition(GraphicsObject.Type.e_TypeText);
 GraphicsObject text_object = page.GetGraphicsObject(position);
 if (text_object != null)
 {
 MarkedContent markcontent = text_object.GetMarkedContent();
 if (markcontent == null)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("Marked content not found!");
 Environment.Exit(1);
 }

 if (markcontent.GetItemCount() == 0)
 {
 markcontent.AddItem("Associated", null);
 }

 associated_files.AssociateFile(text_object, 0, resource_dict, "textobject", filespec_jpg);
 page.GenerateContent();
 }

 string newPdf = "newPDF.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to layout recognition information
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.IO;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;
using foxit.pdf.objects;
using foxit.addon.layoutrecognition;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 String input_file = "AboutFoxit.pdf";

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }

 using (PDFPage original_page = doc.GetPage(0))
 {
 original_page.StartParse((int)PDFPage.ParseFlags.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);
 using (LRContext context = new LRContext(original_page))
 {
 Progressive progressive = context.StartParse(null);

 LRStructureElement root = context.GetRootElement();
 LRElement.ElementType type = root.GetElementType();
 int nElemListSize = root.GetChildCount();
 Console.WriteLine("RootElement getChildCount: {0}", nElemListSize);

 List<LRElement> element_array = new List<LRElement>();
 GetChildFromElement(root, element_array, LRElement.ElementType.e_ElementTypeSpan);
 Console.WriteLine("LRElement::e_ElementTypeSpan count: {0}\n", element_array.Count());
 }
 }

 Console.WriteLine("Layout recognition test.");
 }

 Library.Release();
 }

 public static void GetChildFromElement(LRStructureElement pElement, List<LRElement> elemArray, LRElement.ElementType nType)
 {
 int nElemListSize = pElement.GetChildCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < nElemListSize; i++)
 {
 LRElement item = pElement.GetChild(i);
 LRElement.ElementType item_type = item.GetElementType();
 if (item_type == nType)
 elemArray.Add(item);
 if (item.IsStructureElement())
 {
 LRStructureElement srt_item = new LRStructureElement(item);
 GetChildFromElement(srt_item, elemArray, nType);
 }
 }
 }
 }
}

---

how to convert pdf page to image file
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Drawing;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 public static void Save2Image(System.Drawing.Bitmap bitmap, int page_index, string sExt, bool from_memory)
 {
 string save_name = "result.bmp";
 // Add the bitmap to image and save the image.
 foxit.common.Image image = new foxit.common.Image();
 image.AddFrame(bitmap);
 image.SaveAs(save_name);
 System.GC.Collect();
 Console.WriteLine("Save page {0} into a picture of {1} format{2}.", page_index, sExt, from_memory ? " from memory" : "");
 }

 public static void PDF2Image(PDFDoc doc, bool from_memory)
 {
 string[] support_image_extends = { ".bmp", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".jpx", ".jp2" };

 // Get page count
 int nPageCount = doc.GetPageCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < nPageCount; i++)
 {
 using (PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(i))
 {
 // Parse page.
 page.StartParse((int)foxit.pdf.PDFPage.ParseFlags.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);

 int width = (int)(page.GetWidth());
 int height = (int)(page.GetHeight());
 Matrix2D matrix = page.GetDisplayMatrix(0, 0, width, height, page.GetRotation());

 // Prepare a bitmap for rendering.
 System.Drawing.Bitmap bitmap = new System.Drawing.Bitmap(width, height, System.Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat.Format32bppArgb);
 Graphics draw = Graphics.FromImage(bitmap);
 draw.Clear(System.Drawing.Color.White);

 // Render page
 Renderer render = new Renderer(bitmap, false);
 render.StartRender(page, matrix, null);
 for (int j = 0; j < support_image_extends.Length; j++)
 {
 string extend = support_image_extends[j];
 Save2Image(bitmap, i, extend, from_memory);
 }

 draw.Dispose();
 }
 }
 }

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Environment.Exit(1);
 }

 {
 string input_file = "AboutFoxit.pdf";
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Library.Release();
 return;
 }
 PDF2Image(doc, false);
 System.GC.Collect();
 }
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to tag a pdf document
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.addon.conversion;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.addon.accessibility;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }

 {
 const string input_file = "AboutFoxit.pdf";
 string output_file = "TaggedPdf_StartAutoTagged.pdf";
 using (var pdf_doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 pdf_doc.Load(null);
 using (var taggedpdf = new TaggedPDF(pdf_doc))
 {
 Progressive progressive = taggedpdf.StartTagDocument(null);
 Progressive.State state = Progressive.State.e_ToBeContinued;
 while (state == Progressive.State.e_ToBeContinued)
 {
 state = progressive.Continue();
 }
 }
 pdf_doc.SaveAs(output_file, 0);
 }
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to recognize form in pdf
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.interform;
using foxit.pdf.annots;
using foxit.pdf.actions;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 string input_file = "ElectricTable.pdf";
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 doc.Load(null);
 using (Form form = new Form(doc))
 {
 int count = form.GetFieldCount("");
 Console.WriteLine("Field count:{0}", count);
 Console.WriteLine("===Start Recognize Form===");
 //Start to recognize form in current PDF document.
 doc.StartRecognizeForm(null);
 Console.WriteLine("===End===");
 count = form.GetFieldCount("");
 Console.WriteLine("Field count:{0}", count);
 for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
 {
 using (Field field = form.GetField(i, ""))
 {
 string str = string.Format("NO.{0}", i + 1);
 field.SetValue(str);
 }
 }
 string new_pdf = "ElectricTable_StartRecognizeForm.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(new_pdf, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to convert pdf file to office file
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.addon.conversion.pdf2office;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }

 {
 PDF2Office.Initialize(""); //Please ensure the path is valid.
 string metrics_data_folder_path = ""; //Please ensure the path is valid.
 // Convert PDF file to Word format file.
 using (PDF2OfficeSettingData setting_data = new PDF2OfficeSettingData())
 {
 setting_data.metrics_data_folder_path = metrics_data_folder_path; //Please ensure the path is valid.
 using (Progressive progressive = PDF2Office.StartConvertToWord("word.pdf", null, "pdf2word_result.docx", setting_data, null))
 {
 if (progressive.GetRateOfProgress() != 100)
 {
 Progressive.State state = Progressive.State.e_ToBeContinued;
 while (Progressive.State.e_ToBeContinued == state)
 {
 state = progressive.Continue();
 }
 }
 Console.WriteLine("Convert PDF file to Word format file with path.");
 }
 }
 // Convert PDF file to Excel format file.

 using (PDF2OfficeSettingData setting_data = new PDF2OfficeSettingData())
 {
 setting_data.metrics_data_folder_path = metrics_data_folder_path; //Please ensure the path is valid.
 using (Progressive progressive = PDF2Office.StartConvertToExcel("excel.pdf", null, "pdf2excel_result.xlsx", setting_data, null))
 {
 if (progressive.GetRateOfProgress() != 100)
 {
 Progressive.State state = Progressive.State.e_ToBeContinued;
 while (Progressive.State.e_ToBeContinued == state)
 {
 state = progressive.Continue();
 }
 }
 Console.WriteLine("Convert PDF file to Excel format file with path.");
 }
 }
 // Convert PDF file to PowerPoint format file.
 using (PDF2OfficeSettingData setting_data = new PDF2OfficeSettingData())
 {
 setting_data.metrics_data_folder_path = metrics_data_folder_path; //Please ensure the path is valid.
 using (Progressive progressive = PDF2Office.StartConvertToPowerPoint("powerpoint.pdf", null, "pdf2powerpoint_result.pptx", setting_data, null))
 {
 if (progressive.GetRateOfProgress() != 100)
 {
 Progressive.State state = Progressive.State.e_ToBeContinued;
 while (Progressive.State.e_ToBeContinued == state)
 {
 state = progressive.Continue();
 }
 }
 Console.WriteLine("Convert PDF file to PowerPoint format file with path.");
 }
 }
 PDF2Office.Release();
 }
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to Convert PDF file to PDF-1.4
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.IO;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.addon.compliance;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 // "compliance_resource_folder_path" is the path of compliance resource folder. Please refer to Developer Guide for more details.
 string compliance_resource_folder_path = "";
 // If you use an authorization key for Foxit PDF SDK, please set a valid unlock code string to compliance_engine_unlockcode for ComplianceEngine.
 // If you use an trial key for Foxit PDF SDK, just keep compliance_engine_unlockcode as an empty string.
 string compliance_engine_unlockcode = "";

 if (compliance_resource_folder_path.Length < 1)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("compliance_resource_folder_path is still empty. Please set it with a valid path to compliance resource folder path.");
 return;
 }
 // Initialize compliance engine.
 ErrorCode error_code = ComplianceEngine.Initialize(compliance_resource_folder_path, compliance_engine_unlockcode);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 switch (error_code)
 {
 case ErrorCode.e_ErrInvalidLicense:
 Console.WriteLine("[Failed] Compliance module is not contained in current Foxit PDF SDK keys.");
 break;
 default:
 Console.WriteLine("[Failed] Fail to initialize compliance engine. Error: {0}", error_code);
 break;
 }
 return;
 }
 Console.WriteLine("ComplianceEngine is initialized.");

 using (PDFCompliance pdf_compliance = new PDFCompliance())
 {
 string input_file = "AF_ImageXObject_FormXObject.pdf";
 string save_pdf_path = "5_pdfcompliance_convert_to_1_7.pdf";
 // Convert original PDF file to PDF-1.4.
 Console.WriteLine("======== PDFCompliance: Convert ========");
 ResultInformation convert_result_info = pdf_compliance.ConvertPDFFile(input_file, save_pdf_path, 14, null);
 ComplianceEngine.Release();
 }
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to edit paragraph in a PDF doc.

using System;
using System.IO;
using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.addon.pageeditor;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
class EditingCallback : ParagraphEditingCallback
{
private int index = 0;

public EditingCallback(int index)
{
index = index;
}

public override void Release()
{
}

public override void AddUndoItem(ParagraphEditingUndoItem undo_item) {

}
public override RectF GetClientRect(PDFDoc doc) {
return new RectF();
}
public override int GetCurrentPageIndex(PDFDoc doc) {
return 0;
}
public override RectF GetPageRect(PDFDoc doc, int index) {
PDFPage p = doc.GetPage(index);
int w = (int)(p.GetWidth());
int h = (int)(p.GetHeight());
RectF r = new RectF(); ;
r.left = 0;
r.bottom = height;
r.right = width;
r.top = 0;
p.Dispose();
return r;
}
public override IntPtr GetPageViewHandle(PDFDoc doc, int index) {
return IntPtr.Zero; ;
}
public override RectF GetPageVisibleRect(PDFDoc doc, int index) {
return new RectF();
}
public override Matrix2D GetRenderMatrix(PDFDoc doc, int index) {
PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(index);
int width = (int)page.GetWidth();
int height = (int)page.GetHeight();
Matrix2D matrix = page.GetDisplayMatrix(0, 0, width, height, page.GetRotation());
page.Dispose();
return matrix;
}
public override Rotation GetRotation(PDFDoc doc, int index) {
return Rotation.e_Rotation0;

}
public override float GetScale(PDFDoc doc, int index) {
return 1;
}
public override Int32Array GetVisiblePageIndexArray(PDFDoc doc ) {
Int32Array array = new Int32Array();
array.Add(0);
return array;
}
public override bool GotoPageView(PDFDoc doc, int index, float left, float top) {
return true;
}
public override void InvalidateRect(PDFDoc doc, int index, RectFArray invalid_rects) {
}
public override void NotifyTextInputReachLimit(PDFDoc doc, int index) {
}
public override void SetDocChangeMark(PDFDoc doc) {
}
}

class Program
{
static void Main(String[] args)
{
// Initialize library
string sn = "";
string key = "";
ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess) return;
using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("AboutFoxit.pdf"))
{
error_code = doc.Load(null);
if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
{
Library.Release();
return;
}
using (PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0))
{
page.StartParse(0, null, false);
float h = page.GetHeight();
int index = page.GetIndex();
using (EditingCallback cb = new EditingCallback(index))
{
using (Paragraphmgr mgr = new Paragraphmgr(cb, doc))
{
ParagraphEditing editing = mgr.GetParagraphEditing();
if (editing.IsEmpty() == true)
return;
editing.Activate();
editing.StartEditing(0, new PointF(95, h - 728), new PointF(95, h - 728));
editing.SetFontSize(24);
editing.SetUnderline(true);
editing.InsertText("InsertText_Paragraph_editing");
editing.Deactivate();
doc.SaveAs("Paragraph_editing.pdf", (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);

//Join&split
JoinSplit joinSplit = mgr.GetJoinSplit();
joinSplit.Activate();
joinSplit.OnLButtonDown(0, new PointF(289, 659));
joinSplit.OnLButtonUp(0, new PointF(289, 659));
joinSplit.SplitBoxes();
joinSplit.Deactivate();
doc.SaveAs("Split_Boxes.pdf", (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);

joinSplit.Activate();
joinSplit.OnLButtonDown(0, new PointF(307, h - 637));
joinSplit.OnLButtonUp(0, new PointF(307, h - 637));
joinSplit.OnLButtonDown(0, new PointF(307, h - 453));
joinSplit.OnLButtonUp(0, new PointF(307, h - 453));
joinSplit.JoinBoxes();
joinSplit.Deactivate();
doc.SaveAs("Join_Boxes.pdf", (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
}
}
 }
}
}
 }
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to move annotation to new position in PDF coordinate system
```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using foxit;
using foxit.pdf.annots;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.annots;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace sample
{
 class sample_class
 {

 static void Main(String[] args)
 {
 // Initialize library
 string sn = "";
 string key = "";
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 Console.WriteLine("Library Initialize Error: {0}\n", error_code);
 try
 {

 // Load a document
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("input_file.pdf"))
 {
 error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }
 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);
 float fDelta = 10;
 int iAnnotCount = page.GetAnnotCount();
 for (int j = 0; j < iAnnotCount; j++)
 {
 Annot pAnnot = page.GetAnnot(j);
 Annot.Type annotType = pAnnot.GetType();
 RectF orgRect = pAnnot.GetRect();
 RectF newRect = new RectF();
 newRect.left = orgRect.left;
 newRect.bottom = orgRect.bottom;
 if (Annot.Type.e_Popup != annotType)
 {
 newRect.left += fDelta;
 newRect.bottom += fDelta;
 }
 newRect.right = orgRect.right + fDelta;
 newRect.top = orgRect.top + fDelta;
 pAnnot.Move(newRect);
 }
 doc.SaveAs("output.pdf", (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 }
 catch (System.Exception e)
 {
 Console.WriteLine(e.Message);
 }
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}
```

How to add a "file attachment" annotation
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;
using foxit.pdf.annots;
using foxit.pdf.actions;
using foxit.pdf.objects;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static foxit.common.DateTime GetLocalDateTime()
 {
 System.DateTimeOffset rime = System.DateTimeOffset.Now;
 foxit.common.DateTime datetime = new foxit.common.DateTime();
 datetime.year = (UInt16)rime.Year;
 datetime.month = (UInt16)rime.Month;
 datetime.day = (ushort)rime.Day;
 datetime.hour = (UInt16)rime.Hour;
 datetime.minute = (UInt16)rime.Minute;
 datetime.second = (UInt16)rime.Second;

 datetime.utc_hour_offset = (short)rime.Offset.Hours;
 datetime.utc_minute_offset = (ushort)rime.Offset.Minutes;

 return datetime;
 }
 static String RandomUID()
 {
 return System.Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
 }
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 const string sn = "";
 const string key = "";

 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("Sample.pdf"))
 {
 doc.Load(null);

 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);

 {
 // Add file attachment annotation
 String pdf_file = "AboutFoxit.pdf";
 FileAttachment file_attachment = null;
 Annot annot = null;
 PDFDoc doc = null;
 using (annot = page.AddAnnot(Annot.Type.e_FileAttachment, new RectF(280, 350, 300, 380)))
 using (file_attachment = new FileAttachment(annot))
 {
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 file_attachment.SetFlags(4);
 file_attachment.SetIconName("Graph");
 foxit.pdf.FileSpec file_spec = null;
 using (doc = page.GetDocument())
 using (file_spec = new foxit.pdf.FileSpec(doc))
 {
 file_spec.SetFileName("attachment.pdf");
 file_spec.SetCreationDateTime(GetLocalDateTime());
 file_spec.SetDescription("The original file");
 file_spec.SetModifiedDateTime(GetLocalDateTime());
 file_spec.Embed(pdf_file);
 file_attachment.SetFileSpec(file_spec);
 file_attachment.SetSubject("File Attachment");
 file_attachment.SetTitle("Foxit SDK");
 // Appearance should be reset.
 file_attachment.ResetAppearanceStream();
 Console.WriteLine("Add an attachment annotation.");
 }
 }
 }

 // Save PDF file
 string newPdf = "newpdf.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

How to remove all annotations
using System;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.common;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 const string sn = "";
 const string key = "";

 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("Sample.pdf"))
 {
 doc.Load(null);

 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);

 int annotationCount = page.GetAnnotCount();
 for (int i = annotationCount - 1; i >= 0; i--)
 page.RemoveAnnot(page.GetAnnot(i));

 // Save PDF file
 string newPdf = "newpdf.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

How to generate barcode
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;

namespace barcodeCS
{

 class barcode
 {

 public static void Save2Image(System.Drawing.Bitmap bitmap, string filepath)
 {
 string save_name = output_path + filepath;
 foxit.common.Image image = new foxit.common.Image();
 image.AddFrame(bitmap);
 image.SaveAs(save_name);
 }

 public static void Barcode_GenerateEachType(string code_str, Barcode.Format code_format, int unit_width, int unit_height, Barcode.QRErrorCorrectionLevel qr_level, string bmp_name)
 {
 using (Barcode barcode = new Barcode())
 {
 System.Drawing.Bitmap bitmap = barcode.GenerateBitmap(code_str, code_format, unit_width, unit_height, qr_level);
 Save2Image(bitmap, bmp_name);
 }
 }
 public static void Barcode_GenerateAll()
 {
 // Strings used as barcode content.
 String[] sz_code_str = { "TEST-SHEET", "102030405060708090", "80674313", "890444000335", "9780804816632", "070429", "Unknown - change me!", "TestForBarcodeQrCode" };
 // Barcode format types
 Barcode.Format[] sz_code_format = {Barcode.Format.e_FormatCode39, Barcode.Format.e_FormatCode128,
 Barcode.Format.e_FormatEAN8, Barcode.Format.e_FormatUPCA,
 Barcode.Format.e_FormatEAN13, Barcode.Format.e_FormatITF,
 Barcode.Format.e_FormatPDF417, Barcode.Format.e_FormatQRCode};

 // Image names for the saved image files.(except QR code)
 String[] bmp_name = {"/code39_TEST-SHEET.bmp", "/CODE_128_102030405060708090.bmp",
 "/EAN_8_80674313.bmp", "/UPC_A_890444000335.bmp", "/EAN_13_9780804816632.bmp",
 "/ITF_070429.bmp", "/PDF_417_Unknown.bmp"};

 Barcode.QRErrorCorrectionLevel[] qr_level = {Barcode.QRErrorCorrectionLevel.e_QRCorrectionLevelLow, Barcode.QRErrorCorrectionLevel.e_QRCorrectionLevelMedium,
 Barcode.QRErrorCorrectionLevel.e_QRCorrectionLevelQuater, Barcode.QRErrorCorrectionLevel.e_QRCorrectionLevelHigh};
 String[] sz_bmp_qr_name = {"/QR_CODE_TestForBarcodeQrCode_L.bmp", "/QR_CODE_TestForBarcodeQrCode_M.bmp",
 "/QR_CODE_TestForBarcodeQrCode_Q.bmp", "/QR_CODE_TestForBarcodeQrCode_H.bmp"};
 int unit_width = 2;
 int unit_height = 120;

 // Generate barcode for different types.
 for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
 {
 if (sz_code_format[i] != Barcode.Format.e_FormatQRCode) // Not QR code
 Barcode_GenerateEachType(sz_code_str[i], sz_code_format[i], unit_width, unit_height, (Barcode.QRErrorCorrectionLevel)0, bmp_name[i]);
 else
 {
 for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++)
 Barcode_GenerateEachType(sz_code_str[i], sz_code_format[i], unit_width, unit_height, qr_level[j], sz_bmp_qr_name[j]);
 }
 }

 }
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 string sn = "";
 string key = "";
 // Initialize library.
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }

 try
 {
 // Generate all types of barcode
 Barcode_GenerateAll();
 Console.WriteLine("Barcode demo.", error_code);
 }
 catch (foxit.PDFException e)
 {
 Console.WriteLine(e.Message);
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

How to add a line annotation
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;
using foxit.pdf.annots;
using foxit.pdf.actions;
using foxit.pdf.objects;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static foxit.common.DateTime GetLocalDateTime()
 {
 System.DateTimeOffset rime = System.DateTimeOffset.Now;
 foxit.common.DateTime datetime = new foxit.common.DateTime();
 datetime.year = (UInt16)rime.Year;
 datetime.month = (UInt16)rime.Month;
 datetime.day = (ushort)rime.Day;
 datetime.hour = (UInt16)rime.Hour;
 datetime.minute = (UInt16)rime.Minute;
 datetime.second = (UInt16)rime.Second;

 datetime.utc_hour_offset = (short)rime.Offset.Hours;
 datetime.utc_minute_offset = (ushort)rime.Offset.Minutes;

 return datetime;
 }
 static String RandomUID()
 {
 return System.Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
 }
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 const string sn = "";
 const string key = "";

 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 int err_ret = 0;

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("Sample.pdf"))
 {
 doc.Load(null);

 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);

 {
 // Add line annotation
 // No special intent, as a common line.
 Line line = null;
 Annot annot = null;
 using (annot = page.AddAnnot(Annot.Type.e_Line, new RectF(0, 650, 100, 750)))
 {
 using (line = new Line(annot))
 {
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 line.SetFlags(4);
 line.SetStartPoint(new foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF(20, 650));
 line.SetEndPoint(new foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF(100, 740));
 // Intent, as line arrow.
 line.SetContent("A line arrow annotation");
 line.SetIntent("LineArrow");
 line.SetSubject("Arrow");
 line.SetTitle("Foxit SDK");
 line.SetCreationDateTime(GetLocalDateTime());
 line.SetModifiedDateTime(GetLocalDateTime());
 line.SetUniqueID(RandomUID());
 // Appearance should be reset.
 line.ResetAppearanceStream();
 }
 using (annot = page.AddAnnot(Annot.Type.e_Line, new RectF(0, 650, 100, 760)))
 using (line = new Line(annot))
 {
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 line.SetFlags(4);
 // Set foxit RGB color
 line.SetBorderColor(0x00FF00);
 line.SetStartPoint(new foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF(10, 650));
 line.SetEndPoint(new foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF(100, 750));
 line.SetContent("A common line.");
 line.SetLineStartStyle(Markup.EndingStyle.e_EndingStyleSquare);
 line.SetLineEndStyle(Markup.EndingStyle.e_EndingStyleOpenArrow);
 // Show text in line
 line.EnableCaption(true);
 line.SetCaptionOffset(new foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF(0, 5));

 line.SetSubject("Line");
 line.SetTitle("Foxit SDK");
 line.SetCreationDateTime(GetLocalDateTime());
 line.SetModifiedDateTime(GetLocalDateTime());
 line.SetUniqueID(RandomUID());
 // Appearance should be reset.
 line.ResetAppearanceStream();
 Console.WriteLine("Add a line annotations.");
 }
 }
 }

 // Save PDF file
 string newPdf = "newpdf.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}
