how to flatten a pdf without annotations
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode errorCode = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (errorCode != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }
 {
 // Flatten PDF with no annotation
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("annotations.pdf"))
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Library.Release();
 return;
 }

 // Get page count.
 int pageCount = doc.GetPageCount();
 // Flatten PDF pages.
 for (int i = 0; i < pageCount; i++)
 {
 using (PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(i))
 {
 // Parse page before flattening the page.
 page.StartParse((int)foxit.pdf.PDFPage.ParseFlags.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);
 page.Flatten(true, (int)PDFPage.FlattenOptions.e_FlattenNoAnnot);
 }
 }
 doc.SaveAs("annotations_flatten_noannot.pdf", (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNormal);
 }
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to encrypt a PDF file with Foxit DRM
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates;
using System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

using foxit.common;
using foxit.pdf;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void FoxitDRMDecrypt(string input_file)
 {
 string output_file = "foxit_drm_encrypt.pdf";
 string file_id = "Simple-DRM-file-ID";
 string initialize_key = "Simple-DRM-initialize-key";
 using (var doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load(null);

 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }

 // Do encryption.
 using (var handler = new DRMSecurityHandler())
 {
 using (var encrypt_data = new DRMEncryptData(true,
 "Simple-DRM-filter", SecurityHandler.CipherType.e_CipherAES, 16, true, -4))
 {
 handler.Initialize(encrypt_data, file_id, initialize_key);
 doc.SetSecurityHandler(handler);

 doc.SaveAs(output_file, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNormal);
 }
 }
 }
 // Do decryption.
 using (var callback = new DRMSecurityEvent(file_id, initialize_key))
 {
 Library.RegisterSecurityCallback("FoxitDRM", callback);
 using (var encrypted_doc = new PDFDoc(output_file))
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = encrypted_doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("The PDFDoc " + output_file + " Error: " + error_code);
 return;
 }

 output_file = "foxit_drm_decrypt.pdf";

 encrypted_doc.RemoveSecurity();
 encrypted_doc.SaveAs(output_file, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNormal);
 }
 }
 }

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }

 FoxitDRMDecrypt("AboutFoxit.pdf");

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to convert image file to pdf
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.addon.conversion;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 public static void Image2PDF(string input_file, string output_file)
 {
 using (Image image = new Image(input_file))
 {
 int count = 1;
 if (image.GetType() != Image.Type.e_JBIG2)
 {
 count = image.GetFrameCount();
 }
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc())
 {
 for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
 {
 using (PDFPage page = doc.InsertPage(i, image.GetWidth(), image.GetHeight()))
 {
 page.StartParse((int)PDFPage.ParseFlags.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);
 // Add image to page
 page.AddImage(image, i, new PointF(0, 0), image.GetWidth(), image.GetHeight(), true);
 }
 }
 doc.SaveAs(output_file, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 }
 }

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 // Convert .bmp file to PDF document.
 string input_file = "watermark.bmp";
 string output_file = "watermark_bmp.pdf";
 Image2PDF(input_file, output_file);

 // Convert .jpg file to PDF document.
 input_file = "image_samples.jpg";
 output_file = "image_samples_jpg.pdf";
 Image2PDF(input_file, output_file);

 // Convert .tif file to PDF document.
 input_file = "TIF2Pages.tif";
 output_file = "TIF2Pages_tif.pdf";
 Image2PDF(input_file, output_file);

 // Convert .gif file to PDF document.
 input_file = "image005.gif";
 output_file = "image005_gif.pdf";
 Image2PDF(input_file, output_file);

 // Convert .png file to PDF document.
 input_file = "1.png";
 output_file = "1_png.pdf";
 Image2PDF(input_file, output_file);

 // Convert .jb2 file to PDF document.
 input_file = "STR_039.jb2";
 output_file = "STR_039_jb2.pdf";
 Image2PDF(input_file, output_file);

 // Convert .jp2 file to PDF document.
 input_file = "1.jp2";
 output_file = "1_jp2.pdf";
 Image2PDF(input_file, output_file);

 // Convert .jpx file to PDF document.
 input_file = "1.jpx";
 output_file = "1_jpx.pdf";
 Image2PDF(input_file, output_file);

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

How to define a signature callback class that inherits SignatureCallback for signing PDF using X509 certificates in the. Net SDK and Windows certificate store.

using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates;
using System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
namespace signatureCS
{
class SignAndVerifyMsg
{
public static X509Certificate2 GetCertificate(string name, StoreName store)
{
X509Certificate2 cert = null;
var store = new X509Store(store, StoreLocation.CurrentUser);
store.Open(OpenFlags.ReadOnly);
foreach (var c in store.Certificates)
{
var sub = c.SubjectName.Name.Split(',');
foreach (var s in sub)
{
string cn = " CN=" + name;
if (s.Equals(cn))
{
cert = c;
break;
}
}
if (cert != null) break;
}
return cert;
}
public static bool SignMsg(byte[] to_be_signed, string c_name, StoreName store, ref byte[] signed_data)
{
X509Certificate2 cert = GetCertificate(c_name, store);
if (cert == null)
cert = GetCertificate(c_name, store.Root);
var signer = new CmsSigner(cert);
signer.DigestAlgorithm = new Oid("1.3.14.3.2.26", "sha1");
signer.IncludeOption = X509IncludeOption.WholeChain;
var content = new ContentInfo(to_be_signed);
var cms = new SignedCms(content, false);
cms.ComputeSignature(signer);
signed_data = cms.Encode();
return true;
}
public static bool VerifyMsg(byte[] verify_data, byte[] signed_data)
{
try
{
var content = new ContentInfo(verify_data);
var cms = new SignedCms(content, false);
cms.Decode(signed_data);
cms.CheckSignature(true);
return true;
} catch (Exception e) {
return false;
}
}
}
class DigestContext
{
public FileReaderCallback callback_;
public IntPtr byte_range_array_;
public int byte_range_array_size_;
public DigestContext(FileReaderCallback read, IntPtr range_array, int range_array_size)
{
callback_ = read;
byte_range_array_ = range_array;
byte_range_array_size_ = range_array_size;
}
}
class SignatureCallbackImpl : SignatureCallback
{
private DigestContext context_ = null;
byte[] allData = null;
public SignatureCallbackImpl()
{
}
public override bool StartCalcDigest(FileReaderCallback file, IntPtr byte_range_array, int byte_range_array_size, Signature signature, IntPtr client_data)
{
context_ = new DigestContext(file, byte_range_array, byte_range_array_size);
return true;
}
public override Progressive.State ContinueCalcDigest(IntPtr client_data, PauseCallback pause)
{
FileReaderCallback reader = context_.callback_;
int[] intArray = new int[context_.byte_range_array_size_];
Marshal.Copy(context_.byte_range_array_, intArray, 0, context_.byte_range_array_size_);
byte[] arr1 = new byte[intArray[1]];
IntPtr buf1 = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(intArray[1]);
reader.ReadBlock(buf1, intArray[0], (uint)intArray[1]);
Marshal.Copy(buf1, arr1, 0, intArray[1]);
byte[] arr2 = new byte[intArray[3]];
IntPtr buf2 = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(intArray[3]);
reader.ReadBlock(buf2, intArray[2], (uint)intArray[3]);
Marshal.Copy(buf2, arr2, 0, intArray[3]);
byte[] tempData = new byte[intArray[1] + intArray[3]];
Array.Copy(arr1, 0, tempData, 0, arr1.Length);
Array.Copy(arr2, 0, tempData, arr1.Length, arr2.Length);
Marshal.FreeHGlobal(buf1);
Marshal.FreeHGlobal(buf2);
HashAlgorithm hash = HashAlgorithm.Create("sha1");
hash.Initialize();
allData = hash.ComputeHash(tempData);
return Progressive.State.e_Finished;
}
public override byte[] GetDigest(IntPtr client_data)
{
if (allData != null)
return allData;
return null;
}
public override byte[] Sign(IntPtr digest, int digest_length, string cert_path, byte[] password, Signature.DigestAlgorithm digest_algorithm, IntPtr client_data)
{
byte[] digestBytes = new byte[digest_length];
Marshal.Copy(digest, digestBytes, 0, digest_length);
byte[] encryptedData = null;
SignAndVerifyMsg.SignMsg(digestBytes, "test", StoreName.My, ref encryptedData);
return encryptedData;
}
public override byte[] Sign(IntPtr digest, int digest_length, StreamCallback cert_path, byte[] password, Signature.DigestAlgorithm digest_algorithm, IntPtr client_data)
{
return null;
}
public override uint VerifySigState(IntPtr digest, int digest_length, IntPtr signed_data, int signed_data_length, IntPtr client_data)
{
byte[] signedBytes = new byte[signed_data_length];
Marshal.Copy(signed_data, signedBytes, 0, signed_data_length);
byte[] digestBytes = new byte[digest_length];
Marshal.Copy(digest, digestBytes, 0, digest_length);
bool verified = SignAndVerifyMsg.VerifyMsg(digestBytes, signedBytes);
return verified ? Convert.ToUInt32(Signature.States.e_StateVerifyNoChange) : Convert.ToUInt32(Signature.States.e_StateVerifyChange);
}
public override void Dispose() { }
public override void Release() { }
public override bool IsNeedPadData() { return false; }
public override SignatureCallback.CertValidity CheckCertificateValidity(string cert_path, byte[] cert_password, IntPtr client_data)
{
return SignatureCallback.CertValidity.e_CertValid;
}
}
}

how to search text for PDF document
using System;
using System.IO;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;
using foxit.pdf.objects;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static void wrapper_write(StreamWriter text_out, String formatbuff)
 {
 text_out.WriteLine(formatbuff);
 Console.WriteLine(formatbuff);
 }
 static void OutputMatchedInfo(StreamWriter text_out, TextSearch search, int matched_index)
 {
 int page_index = search.GetMatchPageIndex();
 wrapper_write(text_out, "Index of matched pattern:\t" + matched_index);
 wrapper_write(text_out, "\tpage:\t" + page_index);
 wrapper_write(text_out, "\tmatch char start index:\t" + search.GetMatchStartCharIndex());
 wrapper_write(text_out, "\tmatch char end index:\t" + search.GetMatchEndCharIndex());
 wrapper_write(text_out, "\tmatch sentence start index:\t" + search.GetMatchSentenceStartIndex());
 wrapper_write(text_out, "\tmatch sentence:\t" + search.GetMatchSentence());
 RectFArray rect_array = search.GetMatchRects();
 int rect_count = rect_array.GetSize();
 wrapper_write(text_out, "\tmatch rectangles count:\t" + rect_count);
 for (int i = 0; i < rect_count; i++)
 {
 RectF rect = rect_array.GetAt(i);
 wrapper_write(text_out, "\trectangle(in PDF space) :" + i + "\t[left = " + rect.left.ToString("0.0000")
 + ", bottom = " + rect.bottom.ToString("0.0000") + ", right = " + rect.right.ToString("0.0000") + ", top = " + rect.top.ToString("0.0000") + "]");
 }
 }

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 ErrorCode code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 string input_file = "AboutFoxit.pdf";
 String output_file = "search.txt";
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load(null);
 // sample 1: search for all pages of doc.
 FileStream sfile = new FileStream(output_file, FileMode.OpenOrCreate);
 StreamWriter sw = new StreamWriter(sfile);
 using (TextSearch search = new TextSearch(doc, null, (int)TextPage.TextParseFlags.e_ParseTextNormal))
 {
 int start_index = 0;
 int end_index = doc.GetPageCount() - 1;
 search.SetStartPage(start_index);
 search.SetEndPage(end_index);
 string pattern = "Foxit";
 search.SetPattern(pattern);
 Int32 flags = (int)TextSearch.SearchFlags.e_SearchNormal;
 search.SetSearchFlags(flags);
 sw.WriteLine("Begin search " + pattern + " at " + input_file + ".");
 sw.WriteLine("Start index:\t" + start_index);
 sw.WriteLine("End index:\t" + end_index);
 sw.WriteLine("Match key:\t" + pattern);
 String match_case = ((flags & (int)TextSearch.SearchFlags.e_SearchMatchCase) != 0) ? "Yes" : "No";
 sw.WriteLine("Match Case\t" + match_case);
 String match_whole_word = ((flags & (int)TextSearch.SearchFlags.e_SearchMatchWholeWord) != 0) ? "Yes" : "No";
 sw.WriteLine("Match whole word:\t" + match_whole_word);
 String match_consecutive = ((flags & (int)TextSearch.SearchFlags.e_SearchConsecutive) != 0) ? "Yes" : "No";
 sw.WriteLine("Consecutive:\t" + match_consecutive);
 int match_count = 0;
 while (search.FindNext())
 {
 RectFArray rect_array = search.GetMatchRects();
 OutputMatchedInfo(sw, search, match_count);
 match_count++;
 }
 Console.WriteLine("Marched " + match_count + " counts.");
 }
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

using System;
using System.IO;

using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;

{
 class Program
 {

 static void RemovePage()
 {
 string input_file = "page_organization_123.pdf";
 using (var doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 ErrorCode code = doc.Load(null);
 if (code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("The PDFDoc {0} Error: {1}", input_file, code);
 return;

 while (doc.GetPageCount() > 1)
 {
 doc.RemovePage(0);
 }
 string output_file = "remove_all_pages_exceptt_the_last_page.pdf";

 }
 Console.WriteLine("Remove pages.");
 }

 {
 return;
 }
 RemovePage();
 Library.Release();
 }
 }

How to clone bitmap with the bounding box of content according to the given color difference between content and margin
using System;
using System.Drawing;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using System.Drawing.Imaging;

namespace bitmap_transformCS
{
 class bitmap_transform
 {
 public static void SaveBitmap(System.Drawing.Bitmap bitmap, string file_path)
 {
 using (foxit.common.Image image = new foxit.common.Image())
 {
 image.AddFrame(bitmap);
 image.SaveAs(file_path);
 }
 }

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 string sn = "";
 string key = "";
 // Initialize library
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("Library Initialize Error: {0}\n", error_code);
 return;
 }
 string input_file = "Foxit.bmp";

 try
 {
 using (foxit.common.Image image = new foxit.common.Image(input_file))
 {
 System.Drawing.Bitmap _bitmap = image.GetFrameBitmap(0);
 BitmapData bitmap_data = _bitmap.LockBits(new Rectangle(0, 0, _bitmap.Width, _bitmap.Height), ImageLockMode.ReadWrite, PixelFormat.Format32bppArgb);
 using (foxit.common.Bitmap bitmap = new foxit.common.Bitmap(_bitmap.Width, _bitmap.Height, foxit.common.Bitmap.DIBFormat.e_DIBRgb32, bitmap_data.Scan0, bitmap_data.Stride))
 {
 System.Drawing.Bitmap clone_bitmap;

 // Detect the bounding box of content according to the given color difference between content and margin.
 RectI rect = bitmap.DetectBBoxByColorDiffer(20, 64);
 if (rect.Height() > 0 && rect.Width() > 0)
 {
 clone_bitmap = bitmap.Clone(rect);
 string output_file = "result.bmp";
 SaveBitmap(clone_bitmap, output_file);
 }
 else
 {
 Console.WriteLine("[Warning] The result of bounding box (according to the given color difference between content and margin) is an empty rectangle.\r\n");
 }
 _bitmap.UnlockBits(bitmap_data);
 }
 }
 }
 catch (foxit.PDFException e)
 {
 Console.WriteLine(e.Message);
 }
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

How to add a freetext annotation as callout
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;
using foxit.pdf.annots;
using foxit.pdf.actions;
using foxit.pdf.objects;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static foxit.common.DateTime GetLocalDateTime()
 {
 System.DateTimeOffset rime = System.DateTimeOffset.Now;
 foxit.common.DateTime datetime = new foxit.common.DateTime();
 datetime.year = (UInt16)rime.Year;
 datetime.month = (UInt16)rime.Month;
 datetime.day = (ushort)rime.Day;
 datetime.hour = (UInt16)rime.Hour;
 datetime.minute = (UInt16)rime.Minute;
 datetime.second = (UInt16)rime.Second;

 datetime.utc_hour_offset = (short)rime.Offset.Hours;
 datetime.utc_minute_offset = (ushort)rime.Offset.Minutes;

 return datetime;
 }
 static String RandomUID()
 {
 return System.Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
 }
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 const string sn = "";
 const string key = "";

 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 ErrorCode error_code = ErrorCode.e_ErrUnknown;

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("Sample.pdf"))
 {
 doc.Load(null);
 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);

 {
 // Add freetext annotation, as call-out.
 FreeText freetext = null;
 Annot annot = null;
 using (annot = page.AddAnnot(Annot.Type.e_FreeText, new RectF(300, 550, 400, 600)))
 using (freetext = new FreeText(annot))
 // Set default appearance
 using (DefaultAppearance default_ap = new DefaultAppearance())
 {
 default_ap.flags = (int)DefaultAppearance.DefAPFlags.e_FlagFont | (int)DefaultAppearance.DefAPFlags.e_FlagFontSize | (int)DefaultAppearance.DefAPFlags.e_FlagTextColor;
 using (default_ap.font = new foxit.common.Font(foxit.common.Font.StandardID.e_StdIDHelveticaB))
 {
 default_ap.text_size = 12.0f;
 default_ap.text_color = 0x000000;
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 freetext.SetFlags(4);
 // Set default appearance for form.
 freetext.SetDefaultAppearance(default_ap);

 freetext.SetIntent("FreeTextCallout");
 using (PointFArray callout_points = new PointFArray())
 using (foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF point1 = new foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF(250, 540))
 using (foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF point2 = new foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF(280, 570))
 using (foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF point3 = new foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF(300, 570))
 {
 callout_points.Add(point1);
 callout_points.Add(point2);
 callout_points.Add(point3);

 freetext.SetCalloutLinePoints(callout_points);
 freetext.SetCalloutLineEndingStyle(Markup.EndingStyle.e_EndingStyleOpenArrow);
 freetext.SetContent("A callout annotation.");
 freetext.SetSubject("FreeTextCallout");
 freetext.SetTitle("Foxit SDK");
 freetext.SetCreationDateTime(GetLocalDateTime());
 freetext.SetModifiedDateTime(GetLocalDateTime());
 freetext.SetUniqueID(RandomUID());
 // Appearance should be reset.
 freetext.ResetAppearanceStream();
 Console.WriteLine("Add a callout freetext annotation.");
 }
 }
 }
 }

 // Save PDF file
 string newPdf = "newpdf.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

How to swap bitmap
using System;
using System.Drawing;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;

{

 {

 {

 string key = "";
 // Initialize library
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 void SaveBitmap(Bitmap bitmap, string filePath)
 {
 Image image = new Image();
 image.AddFrame(bitmap);
 image.SaveAs(filePath);
 }

 Image image = new Image("Sample.png");
 Bitmap bitmap = image.GetFrameBitmap(0);

 int width = bitmap.GetWidth();
 int height = bitmap.GetHeight();

 // Swap the X and Y axis, and then vertical and horizontal flip bitmap.
 System.Drawing.Bitmap swap_xy_bitmap = bitmap.SwapXY(true, true, null);
 string output_file = "result.bmp";
 SaveBitmap(swap_xy_bitmap, output_file);

 Library.Release();
 Environment.Exit(0);
 }
 }

how to use Foxit PDF SDK to implement the conversion between OFD file and PDF file and to render OFD page.

using System;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.addon.conversion;
using foxit.addon.ofd;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 public static void Save2Image(foxit.common.Bitmap bitmap)
 {
 // Add the bitmap to image and save the image.
 foxit.common.Image image = new foxit.common.Image();
 image.AddFrame(bitmap);
 image.SaveAs("renderBitmap.bmp");
 System.GC.Collect();
 }

 static void Main(String[] args)
 {
 // Initialize library
 string sn = "";
 string key = "";
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess) return;

 // "ofd_resource_path" is the path of ofd resources. Please refer to Developer Guide for more details.
 string ofd_resource_path = "";
 // Initialize OFD engine.
 error_code = Library.InitializeOFDEngine(ofd_resource_path);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess) return;

 // Convert PDF document to OFD document, and convert OFD document to PDF document.
 using(OFDConvertParam convert_param = new OFDConvertParam())
 {
 // Convert OFD document to PDF document.
 foxit.addon.conversion.Convert.FromOFD("input.ofd", "", "output.pdf", convert_param);
 // Convert PDF document to OFD document.
 foxit.addon.conversion.Convert.ToOFD("input.pdf", "", "output.ofd", convert_param);
 }
 }

 // Render OFD document to bitmap.
 using (OFDDoc doc = new OFDDoc("demo.ofd", ""))
 {
 using (OFDPage ofd_page = doc.GetPage(0))
 {
 // Get the size of the page.
 float w = ofd_page.GetWidth();
 float h = ofd_page.GetHeight();
 using (Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap((int)w, (int)h, Bitmap.DIBFormat.e_DIBArgb, System.IntPtr.Zero, 0))
 {
 // Get the display matrix of the page.
 Matrix2D matrix_1 = ofd_page.GetDisplayMatrix(0, 0, (int)w, (int)h, Rotation.e_Rotation0);

 OFDRenderer ofd_render = new OFDRenderer(bitmap);

 Progressive progressive = ofd_render.StartRender(ofd_page, matrix_1);
 // Add the bitmap to image and save the image.
 Save2Image(bitmap);
 ofd_page.Release();
 doc.Release();
 }
 }
 }
 }

}

---

how to reflow pdf page and change the size depend on the size of reflow page
using System;
using System.Drawing;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Environment.Exit(1);
 }

 string input_file = "AboutFoxit.pdf";
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("The PDFDoc [{0}] Error: {1}\n", input_file, error_code);
 Library.Release();
 return;
 }
 string output_path = "pdfreflow/";
 ReflowSingle(doc, output_path);

 Console.WriteLine("Reflow test.");
 }

 Library.Release();
 }

 public static void SaveBitmap(System.Drawing.Bitmap bitmap, string file_name)
 {
 RectF margin = new RectF(50, 30, 30, 30);
 foxit.common.fxcrt.Point size = new foxit.common.fxcrt.Point(480, 800);
 Graphics pDraw = Graphics.FromImage(bitmap);
 SolidBrush brush = new SolidBrush(System.Drawing.Color.White);
 pDraw.FillRectangle(brush, 0, 0, size.x, margin.top);
 pDraw.FillRectangle(brush, 0, size.y - margin.bottom, size.x, margin.top);
 bitmap.Save(file_name);
 pDraw.Dispose();
 }

 public static void ReflowSingle(PDFDoc doc, string output_path)
 {
 RectF margin = new RectF(50f, 30f, 30f, 30f);
 foxit.common.fxcrt.Point size = new foxit.common.fxcrt.Point(480, 800);
 int nCount = doc.GetPageCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < nCount; i++)
 {
 using (PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(i))
 {
 // Parse PDF page.
 page.StartParse((int)foxit.pdf.PDFPage.ParseFlags.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);

 using (ReflowPage reflow_page = new ReflowPage(page))
 {
 // Set some arguments used for parsing the relfow
 reflow_page.SetLineSpace(0);
 reflow_page.SetScreenMargin((int)margin.left, (int)margin.top, (int)margin.right, (int)margin.bottom);
 reflow_page.SetScreenSize(size.x, size.y);
 reflow_page.SetZoom(100);
 reflow_page.SetParseFlags((int)ReflowPage.Flags.e_Normal);

 // Parse reflow page
 reflow_page.StartParse(null);

 // Get actual size of content of reflow page. The content size does not contain the margin.
 float content_width = reflow_page.GetContentWidth();
 float content_height = reflow_page.GetContentHeight();

 // Create a bitmap for rendering the reflow page. The bitmap size contains the
 System.Drawing.Bitmap bitmap = new System.Drawing.Bitmap((int)(content_width + margin.left + margin.right), (int)(content_height + margin.top + margin.bottom));
 Graphics draw = Graphics.FromImage(bitmap);
 draw.Clear(System.Drawing.Color.White);

 // Render reflow page
 using (Renderer renderer = new Renderer(bitmap, false))
 {
 Matrix2D matrix = reflow_page.GetDisplayMatrix(0, 0, Convert.ToInt32(content_width), Convert.ToInt32(content_height), Rotation.e_Rotation0);
 renderer.StartRenderReflowPage(reflow_page, matrix, null);

 SaveBitmap(bitmap, string.Format("{0}reflow_single_{1}.bmp", output_path, i));
 draw.Dispose();
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
}

How to render pages or convert pdf to image.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Drawing;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 public static void Save2Image(System.Drawing.Bitmap bitmap, int page_index, string sExt, bool from_memory)
 {
 string save_name = string.Format("AboutFoxit_{0}{1}{2}", page_index, from_memory ? "_from_memory" : "", sExt);
 // Add the bitmap to image and save the image.
 foxit.common.Image image = new foxit.common.Image();
 image.AddFrame(bitmap);
 image.SaveAs(save_name);
 System.GC.Collect();
 Console.WriteLine("Save page {0} into a picture of {1} format{2}.", page_index, sExt, from_memory ? " from memory" : "");
 }
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 const string sn = "";
 const string key = "";

 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("sample.pdf"))
 {
 doc.Load(null);
 string[] support_image_extends = { ".bmp", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".jpx", ".jp2" };

 // Get page count
 int nPageCount = doc.GetPageCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < nPageCount; i++)
 {
 using (PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(i))
 {
 // Parse page.
 page.StartParse((int)foxit.pdf.PDFPage.ParseFlags.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);

 int width = (int)(page.GetWidth());
 int height = (int)(page.GetHeight());
 Matrix2D matrix = page.GetDisplayMatrix(0, 0, width, height, page.GetRotation());

 // Prepare a bitmap for rendering.
 System.Drawing.Bitmap bitmap = new System.Drawing.Bitmap(width, height, System.Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat.Format32bppArgb);
 Graphics draw = Graphics.FromImage(bitmap);
 draw.Clear(System.Drawing.Color.White);

 // Render page
 Renderer render = new Renderer(bitmap, false);
 render.StartRender(page, matrix, null);
 for (int j = 0; j < support_image_extends.Length; j++)
 {
 string extend = support_image_extends[j];
 Save2Image(bitmap, i, extend, from_memory);
 }

 draw.Dispose();
 }
 }
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to Add points to pressure sensitive ink.
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.annots;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static float[] kPointsData = {
 1, 121.3043f, 326.6846f, 0.0966f, 2, 121.1304f, 326.8709f, 0.1376f, 2, 121.1304f, 326.9641f, 0.1484f,
 2, 121.1304f, 327.0572f, 0.2226f, 2, 121.1304f, 327.2435f, 0.3203f, 2, 121.1304f, 327.5230f, 0.3916f,
 2, 121.4782f, 330.7833f, 0.7041f, 2, 122.0000f, 331.4354f, 0.7275f, 2, 122.9565f, 331.9943f, 0.7363f,
 2, 546.0869f, 402.0447f, 0.5322f, 3, 546.0869f, 402.0447f, 0.0000f
 };

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode errorCode = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (errorCode != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }

 PSI psi = new PSI(480, 180, true);
 psi.SetDiameter(9);
 psi.SetColor(0x434236);
 psi.SetOpacity(0.8f);

 // Add points to pressure sensitive ink.
 for (int i = 0; i < kPointsData.Length; i += 4)
 {
 float x = kPointsData[i + 1] - 100f;
 float y = kPointsData[i + 2] - 300f;
 float pressure = kPointsData[i + 3];
 Path.PointType type = (Path.PointType)(int)kPointsData[i];
 psi.AddPoint(new PointF(x, y), type, pressure);
 }

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc())
 {
 using (PDFPage page = doc.InsertPage(0, PDFPage.Size.e_SizeLetter))
 {

 // Convert PSI to PSInk annotation.
 float width = 480f;
 float height = 180f;
 RectF rect = new RectF(
 page.GetWidth() / 2 - width / 2,
 page.GetHeight() / 2 - height / 2,
 page.GetWidth() / 2 + width / 2,
 page.GetHeight() / 2 + height / 2);

 using (Annot annot = psi.ConvertToPDFAnnot(page, rect, Rotation.e_Rotation0))
 {

 string output_file = "pressure_sensitive_ink.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(output_file, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 }
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to flatten a pdf without form controls
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode errorCode = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (errorCode != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Environment.Exit(1);
 }
 {
 // Flatten PDF with no form control
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("annotations.pdf"))
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Library.Release();
 return;
 }

 // Get page count.
 int pageCount = doc.GetPageCount();
 // Flatten PDF pages.
 for (int i = 0; i < pageCount; i++)
 {
 using (PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(i))
 {
 // Parse page before flattening the page.
 page.StartParse((int)foxit.pdf.PDFPage.ParseFlags.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);
 page.Flatten(true, (int)PDFPage.FlattenOptions.e_FlattenNoFormControl);
 }
 }
 doc.SaveAs("annotations_flatten_noformcontrol.pdf", (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNormal);
 }
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to show the information of portfolio pdf
using System;
using System.Text;
using System.IO;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.actions;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 public static void OutputFileNodeInfo(PortfolioFileNode node, int tab_count)
 {
 string key_name = node.GetKeyName();

 using (FileSpec file_spec = node.GetFileSpec())
 {
 string file_name = file_spec.GetFileName();
 string description = file_spec.GetDescription();
 }
 }

 public static void OutputFolderNodeInfo(PortfolioFolderNode node, int tab_count)
 {
 string name = node.GetName();
 string description = node.GetDescription();
 using (PortfolioNodeArray sub_nodes = node.GetSortedSubNodes())
 {
 OutputSubNodesInfo(sub_nodes, tab_count + 1);
 }
 }

 public static void OutputNodeInfo(PortfolioNode node, int tab_count)
 {
 switch (node.GetNodeType())
 {
 case PortfolioNode.Type.e_TypeFolder:
 using (PortfolioFolderNode folder_node = new PortfolioFolderNode(node))
 {
 OutputFolderNodeInfo(folder_node, tab_count);
 }
 break;
 case PortfolioNode.Type.e_TypeFile:
 using (PortfolioFileNode file_node = new PortfolioFileNode(node))
 {
 OutputFileNodeInfo(file_node, tab_count);
 }
 break;
 default:
 break;
 }
 }

 public static void OutputSubNodesInfo(PortfolioNodeArray sub_nodes, int tab_count)
 {
 for (uint index = 0; index < sub_nodes.GetSize(); index++)
 {
 using (PortfolioNode node = sub_nodes.GetAt(index))
 {
 OutputNodeInfo(node, tab_count);
 }
 }
 }

 public static void OutputPortfolioPDFInfo(string portfolio_file_path)
 {
 using (PDFDoc pdf_doc = new PDFDoc(portfolio_file_path))
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = pdf_doc.Load(null);

 if (false == pdf_doc.IsPortfolio())
 {
 return;
 }

 using (Portfolio exist_portfolio = Portfolio.CreatePortfolio(pdf_doc))
 {
 if (true == exist_portfolio.IsEmpty())
 {
 return;
 }

 // Output all nodes.
 using (PortfolioNode root_node = exist_portfolio.GetRootNode())
 {
 using (PortfolioFolderNode root_folder = new PortfolioFolderNode(root_node))
 {
 using (PortfolioNodeArray sub_nodes = root_folder.GetSortedSubNodes())
 {
 OutputSubNodesInfo(sub_nodes, 0);
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 ErrorCode code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 // Show information of the new portfolio PDF file.
 OutputPortfolioPDFInfo("AboutFoxit.pdf");

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to add a pkcs7 signature and sign it
using System;
using System.Text;
using System.IO;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit;
using foxit.pdf.annots;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Security;
using System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates;
using System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using foxit.pdf.interform;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 string input_pdf_path = "AboutFoxit.pdf";
 string signed_pdf_path = "AboutFoxit_signed.pdf";

 PDFDoc pdf_doc = new PDFDoc(input_pdf_path);
 pdf_doc.StartLoad(null, true, null);
 PDFPage pdf_page = pdf_doc.GetPage(0);
 float page_width = pdf_page.GetWidth();
 float page_height = pdf_page.GetHeight();
 RectF new_sig_rect = new RectF((page_width / 2 - 50.0f), (page_height / 2 - 50.0f), (page_width / 2 + 50.0f), (page_height / 2 + 50.0f));
 Signature new_signature = pdf_page.AddSignature(new_sig_rect);
 new_signature.SetFilter("Adobe.PPKLite");
 new_signature.SetSubFilter("adbe.pkcs7.detached");

 new_signature.SetKeyValue(Signature.KeyName.e_KeyNameSigner, "Foxit PDF SDK");
 new_signature.SetKeyValue(Signature.KeyName.e_KeyNameContactInfo, "support@foxitsoftware.com");
 new_signature.SetKeyValue(Signature.KeyName.e_KeyNameDN, "CN=CN,MAIL=MAIL@MAIL.COM");
 new_signature.SetKeyValue(Signature.KeyName.e_KeyNameLocation, "Fuzhou, China");
 string new_value = string.Format("As a sample for subfilter \"{0}\" ", "adbe.pkcs7.detached");
 new_signature.SetKeyValue(Signature.KeyName.e_KeyNameReason, new_value);
 new_signature.SetKeyValue(Signature.KeyName.e_KeyNameText, new_value);
 int ap_flags = Convert.ToInt32(Signature.APFlags.e_APFlagLabel | Signature.APFlags.e_APFlagSigner |
 Signature.APFlags.e_APFlagReason | Signature.APFlags.e_APFlagDN |
 Signature.APFlags.e_APFlagLocation | Signature.APFlags.e_APFlagText |
 Signature.APFlags.e_APFlagSigningTime | Signature.APFlags.e_APFlagBitmap);
 new_signature.SetAppearanceFlags(ap_flags);

 string cert_path = "foxit_all.pfx";
 byte[] cert_password = Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes("123456");
 Progressive sign_progressive = new_signature.StartSign(cert_path, cert_password, Signature.DigestAlgorithm.e_DigestSHA256,
 signed_pdf_path, IntPtr.Zero, null);

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to remove properties from catalog dictionary
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;
using foxit.pdf.objects;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {

 // This function is to remove some properties from catalog dictionary.
 static void RemoveCatalogKey(PDFDoc document)
 {
 if (document.IsEmpty())
 {
 return;
 }

 PDFDictionary catalog = document.GetCatalog();
 if (null == catalog)
 {
 return;
 }

 String[] key_strings = { "Type", "Boolean", "Name", "String", "Array", "Dict" };
 int count = key_strings.Length;
 for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
 {
 if (catalog.HasKey(key_strings[i]))
 {
 catalog.RemoveAt(key_strings[i]);
 }
 }
 }
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("AboutFoxit.pdf"))
 {
 error_code = doc.Load(null);
 // To remove some properties from catalog dictionary.
 RemoveCatalogKey(doc);
 }
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to redact pdf page
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.addon;
using foxit.pdf.annots;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }

 {
 string input_file = "AboutFoxit.pdf";
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("The PDFDoc [{0}] Error: {1}\n", input_file, error_code);
 Library.Release();
 return;
 }

 using (Redaction redaction = new Redaction(doc))
 {
 using (PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0))
 {
 // Parse PDF page.
 page.StartParse((int)foxit.pdf.PDFPage.ParseFlags.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);
 using (TextPage text_page = new TextPage(page, (int)foxit.pdf.TextPage.TextParseFlags.e_ParseTextNormal))
 {
 using (TextSearch text_search = new TextSearch(text_page))
 {
 text_search.SetPattern("PDF");
 RectFArray rect_array = new RectFArray();
 while (text_search.FindNext())
 {
 RectFArray itemArray = text_search.GetMatchRects();
 rect_array.InsertAt(rect_array.GetSize(), itemArray);
 }
 if (rect_array.GetSize() > 0)
 {
 Redact redact = redaction.MarkRedactAnnot(page, rect_array);
 redact.ResetAppearanceStream();
 doc.SaveAs("AboutFoxit_redected_default.pdf", (int)foxit.pdf.PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNormal);

 // Set border color to green
 redact.SetBorderColor(0x00FF00);
 // Set fill color to blue
 redact.SetFillColor(0x0000FF);
 // Set rollover fill color to red
 redact.SetApplyFillColor(0xFF0000);
 redact.ResetAppearanceStream();
 doc.SaveAs("AboutFoxit_redected_setColor.pdf", (int)foxit.pdf.PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNormal);

 redact.SetOpacity((float)0.5);
 redact.ResetAppearanceStream();
 doc.SaveAs("AboutFoxit_redected_setOpacity.pdf", (int)foxit.pdf.PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNormal);

 if (redaction.Apply())
 Console.WriteLine("Redact page(0) succeed.");
 else
 Console.WriteLine("Redact page(0) failed.");
 redact.Dispose();
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }

 doc.SaveAs("AboutFoxit_redected_apply.pdf", (int)foxit.pdf.PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNormal);
 Console.WriteLine("Redact test.");
 }
 }
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

How to load a PDF document from memory
using System;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.common;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 // Declare the sn and key for the Foxit SDK. These values must be filled in correctly.
 string sn = "";
 string key = "";

 // Initialize the Foxit SDK.
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 Environment.Exit(1);

 using (FileStream fileStream = new FileStream("sample.pdf", FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read))
 {
 long long_file_size = fileStream.Length;
 byte[] buffer = new byte[long_file_size];
 fileStream.Read(buffer, 0, (int)long_file_size);

 // Create a PDFDoc object using the buffer and its size.
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(buffer, long_file_size))
 {
 // Load the PDF document from memory.
 doc.Load();

 // Use the PDF document as needed.

 // No need to free the buffer in C# as it will be automatically garbage collected.
 }
 }

 // Release the Foxit SDK.
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

How to remove all pages.
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.pdf;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 const string sn = "";
 const string key = "";

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 //Initialize library
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 try
 {
 using (var doc = new PDFDoc("sample.pdf"))
 {
 //Load a document
 ErrorCode code = doc.Load(null);
 while (doc.GetPageCount() > 1)
 {
 doc.RemovePage(0);
 }
 //Save PDF file
 string new_pdf = "newpdf.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(new_pdf, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNormal);
 }
 }
 catch (System.Exception e)
 {
 Console.WriteLine(e.Message);
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to insert page in pdf
using System;
using System.IO;

using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here
 static void AddTextObjects(PDFPage page, string content)
 {
 long position = page.GetLastGraphicsObjectPosition(GraphicsObject.Type.e_TypeText);
 using (var text_object = TextObject.Create())
 {

 text_object.SetFillColor(0xFFAAAAAA);
 text_object.SetStrokeColor(0xFFF68C21);

 // Prepare text state
 using (var state = new TextState())
 {
 using (var font = new Font(Font.StandardID.e_StdIDTimes))
 {
 state.font_size = 64.0f;
 state.font = font;
 state.textmode = TextState.Mode.e_ModeFillStrokeClip;
 }

 text_object.SetTextState(page, state, false, 750);

 // Set content
 text_object.SetText(content);
 page.InsertGraphicsObject(position, text_object);

 // Transform to center
 var rect = text_object.GetRect();
 float offset_x = (page.GetWidth() - (rect.right - rect.left)) / 2;
 float offset_y = (page.GetHeight() - (rect.top - rect.bottom)) / 2;
 text_object.Transform(new Matrix2D(1, 0, 0, 1, offset_x, offset_y), false);

 // Generator content
 page.GenerateContent();
 }
 }
 }
 static void InsertPage()
 {
 string input_file = "page_organization_123.pdf";
 using (var doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 ErrorCode code = doc.Load(null);
 if (code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("The PDFDoc {0} Error: {1}", input_file, code);
 return;
 }

 using (var page = doc.InsertPage(-1, PDFPage.Size.e_SizeLetter))
 {
 AddTextObjects(page, "insert in first");
 }
 using (var page = doc.InsertPage(2, PDFPage.Size.e_SizeLetter))
 {
 AddTextObjects(page, "insert in 2 (based 0)");
 }
 using (var page = doc.InsertPage(doc.GetPageCount(), PDFPage.Size.e_SizeLetter))
 {
 AddTextObjects(page, "insert in last");
 }
 string output_file = "insert_page.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(output_file, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNormal);
 }
 Console.WriteLine("Insert pages.");
 }

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }
 InsertPage();
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

How to add a freetext annotation as typewriter
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.annots;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static foxit.common.DateTime GetLocalDateTime()
 {
 System.DateTimeOffset rime = System.DateTimeOffset.Now;
 foxit.common.DateTime datetime = new foxit.common.DateTime();
 datetime.year = (UInt16)rime.Year;
 datetime.month = (UInt16)rime.Month;
 datetime.day = (ushort)rime.Day;
 datetime.hour = (UInt16)rime.Hour;
 datetime.minute = (UInt16)rime.Minute;
 datetime.second = (UInt16)rime.Second;

 datetime.utc_hour_offset = (short)rime.Offset.Hours;
 datetime.utc_minute_offset = (ushort)rime.Offset.Minutes;

 return datetime;
 }
 static String RandomUID()
 {
 return System.Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
 }
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 const string sn = "";
 const string key = "";

 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 ErrorCode error_code = ErrorCode.e_ErrUnknown;

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("Sample.pdf"))
 {
 doc.Load(null);
 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);

 {
 // Add freetext annotation, as type writer.
 FreeText freetext = null;
 Annot annot = null;
 using (annot = page.AddAnnot(Annot.Type.e_FreeText, new RectF(10, 550, 200, 600)))
 using (freetext = new FreeText(annot))
 // Set default appearance
 using (DefaultAppearance default_ap = new DefaultAppearance())
 {
 default_ap.flags = (int)(DefaultAppearance.DefAPFlags.e_FlagFont | DefaultAppearance.DefAPFlags.e_FlagFontSize | DefaultAppearance.DefAPFlags.e_FlagTextColor);
 using (default_ap.font = new foxit.common.Font(foxit.common.Font.StandardID.e_StdIDHelvetica))
 {
 default_ap.text_size = 12.0f;
 default_ap.text_color = 0x000000;
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 freetext.SetFlags(4);
 freetext.SetDefaultAppearance(default_ap);
 freetext.SetIntent("FreeTextTypewriter");
 freetext.SetContent("A typewriter annotation");
 freetext.SetSubject("FreeTextTypewriter");
 freetext.SetTitle("Foxit SDK");
 freetext.SetCreationDateTime(GetLocalDateTime());
 freetext.SetModifiedDateTime(GetLocalDateTime());
 freetext.SetUniqueID(RandomUID());
 // Appearance should be reset.
 freetext.ResetAppearanceStream();
 Console.WriteLine("Add a typewriter freetext annotation.");
 }
 }
 }

 // Save PDF file
 string newPdf = "newpdf.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

How to flip bitmap
using System;
using System.Drawing;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using System.Drawing.Imaging;

namespace FoxitImageExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 string sn = "";
 string key = "";
 // Initialize library
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 void SaveBitmap(Bitmap bitmap, string filePath)
 {
 Image image = new Image();
 image.AddFrame(bitmap);
 image.SaveAs(filePath);
 }

 Image image = new Image("Sample.png");
 Bitmap bitmap = image.GetFrameBitmap(0);

 int width = bitmap.GetWidth();
 int height = bitmap.GetHeight();

 // Vertical and horizontal flip bitmap.
 System.Drawing.Bitmap flip_bitmap = bitmap.Flip(true, true);
 string output_file = "result.bmp";
 SaveBitmap(flip_bitmap, output_file);

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

How to transform bitmap
using System;
using System.Drawing;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using System.Drawing.Imaging;

namespace FoxitImageExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 string sn = "";
 string key = "";
 // Initialize library
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 void SaveBitmap(Bitmap bitmap, string filePath)
 {
 Image image = new Image();
 image.AddFrame(bitmap);
 image.SaveAs(filePath);
 }

 Image image = new Image("Sample.png");
 Bitmap bitmap = image.GetFrameBitmap(0);

 int width = bitmap.GetWidth();
 int height = bitmap.GetHeight();
 int left = 0;
 int top = 0;
 Matrix2D matrix = new Matrix2D(width * 2.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, height / 2.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
 System.Drawing.Bitmap transform_bitmap = bitmap.TransformTo(matrix, foxit.common.Bitmap.InterpolationFlag.e_Downsample, ref left, ref top, null);
 string output_file = "transform_bitmap_Foxit.bmp";
 SaveBitmap(transform_bitmap, output_file);

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

---

how to check paging seal signature information
using System;
using System.Text;
using System.IO;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit;
using foxit.pdf.annots;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Security;
using System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates;
using System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using foxit.pdf.interform;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here
 static void CheckPagingSealSignatureInfo(PDFDoc pdf_doc)
 {
 int sig_count = pdf_doc.GetSignatureCount();
 if (sig_count < 1)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("No signature in current PDF file.");
 return;
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < sig_count; i++)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("Signature index: {0}", i);
 using (Signature signature = pdf_doc.GetSignature(i))
 {
 if (signature.IsEmpty()) continue;
 if (signature.GetSignatureType() != Signature.SignatureType.e_SignatureTypePagingSeal) continue;
 bool is_signed = signature.IsSigned();
 Console.WriteLine("Signed?:{0}", is_signed ? "true" : "false");
 uint sig_state = signature.GetState();

 using (Control control = signature.GetControl(0))
 using (Widget widget_annot = control.GetWidget())
 {
 Console.WriteLine("Object number {0} of related widget annotation's dictionary", widget_annot.GetDict().GetObjNum());
 }

 String filter = signature.GetFilter();
 Console.WriteLine("Filter:{0}", filter);
 String sub_filter = signature.GetSubFilter();
 Console.WriteLine("Sub-filter:{0}", sub_filter);
 if (is_signed)
 {
 foxit.common.DateTime sign_time = signature.GetSignTime();
 }
 string key_value;
 key_value = signature.GetKeyValue(Signature.KeyName.e_KeyNameSigner);
 Console.WriteLine("Signer:{0}", key_value);
 key_value = signature.GetKeyValue(Signature.KeyName.e_KeyNameLocation);
 Console.WriteLine("Location:{0}", key_value);
 key_value = signature.GetKeyValue(Signature.KeyName.e_KeyNameReason);
 Console.WriteLine("Reason:{0}", key_value);
 key_value = signature.GetKeyValue(Signature.KeyName.e_KeyNameContactInfo);
 Console.WriteLine("Contact Info:{0}", key_value);
 key_value = signature.GetKeyValue(Signature.KeyName.e_KeyNameDN);
 Console.WriteLine("DN:{0}", key_value);
 key_value = signature.GetKeyValue(Signature.KeyName.e_KeyNameText);
 Console.WriteLine("Text:{0}", key_value);
 }
 }
 }

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }
 string input_file = "AboutFoxit.pdf";
 using (PDFDoc pdf_doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 pdf_doc.StartLoad(null, true, null);
 CheckPagingSealSignatureInfo(pdf_doc);
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to set information into doc
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.IO;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 public static DocViewerPrefs.ViewerPref[] UI_Items = {DocViewerPrefs.ViewerPref.e_HideToolbar,
 DocViewerPrefs.ViewerPref.e_HideMenubar,DocViewerPrefs.ViewerPref.e_HideWindowUI,
 DocViewerPrefs.ViewerPref.e_FitWindow,DocViewerPrefs.ViewerPref.e_CenterWindow,
 DocViewerPrefs.ViewerPref.e_DisplayDocTitle};

 public static PDFDoc.DisplayMode[] display_modes = {PDFDoc.DisplayMode.e_DisplayUseNone,PDFDoc.DisplayMode.e_DisplayUseOutlines,
 PDFDoc.DisplayMode.e_DisplayUseThumbs, PDFDoc.DisplayMode.e_DisplayFullScreen,PDFDoc.DisplayMode.e_DisplayUseOC,
 PDFDoc.DisplayMode.e_DisplayUseAttachment};

 public static string[] display_mode_strings = { "UseNone", "UseOutlines", "UseThumbs", "FullScreen", "UseOC", "UseAttachment" };
 public static string[] metadata_items = { "Title", "Author", "Subject", "Keywords", "Creator", "Producer", "CreationDate", "ModDate" };

 public static foxit.common.DateTime GetLocalDateTime()
 {
 System.DateTimeOffset rime = System.DateTimeOffset.Now;
 foxit.common.DateTime datetime = new foxit.common.DateTime();
 datetime.year = (UInt16)rime.Year;
 datetime.month = (UInt16)rime.Month;
 datetime.day = (ushort)rime.Day;
 datetime.hour = (UInt16)rime.Hour;
 datetime.minute = (UInt16)rime.Minute;
 datetime.second = (UInt16)rime.Second;

 datetime.utc_hour_offset = (short)rime.Offset.Hours;
 datetime.utc_minute_offset = (ushort)rime.Offset.Minutes;

 return datetime;
 }
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 ErrorCode code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }

 string input_file = "AboutFoxit.pdf";
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 doc.Load(null);

 // Set information.
 SetDocViewerPrefsInfo(doc);
 SetMetaDataInfo(doc);
 }

 Library.Release();
 }

 static void SetDocViewerPrefsInfo(PDFDoc doc)
 {
 doc.SetDisplayMode(PDFDoc.DisplayMode.e_DisplayFullScreen);
 DocViewerPrefs prefs = new DocViewerPrefs(doc, null);

 // Set UI visibility status.
 for (int i = 0; i < UI_Items.Length; i++)
 {
 prefs.SetUIDisplayStatus(UI_Items[i], true);
 }

 // Set display mode for non full-screen mode.
 prefs.SetNonFullScreenPageMode(PDFDoc.DisplayMode.e_DisplayUseOutlines);

 // Set reading direction.
 prefs.SetReadingDirection(false);

 // Set the type of area item.
 prefs.SetViewArea(PDFPage.BoxType.e_CropBox);
 prefs.SetViewClip(PDFPage.BoxType.e_CropBox);
 prefs.SetPrintArea(PDFPage.BoxType.e_CropBox);
 prefs.SetPrintClip(PDFPage.BoxType.e_CropBox);

 // Set page scaling option.
 prefs.SetPrintScale(DocViewerPrefs.PrintScale.e_PrintScaleNone);

 // Set the number of copies to be printed.
 prefs.SetPrintCopies(4);

 Range print_range = new Range(0, doc.GetPageCount() / 2, Range.Filter.e_All);
 prefs.SetPrintRange(print_range);
 }

 static void SetMetaDataInfo(PDFDoc doc)
 {
 string[] metadata_values = {"Title set by simple demo", "Simple demo","Subject set by simple demo",
 "Keywords set by simple demo","Foxit PDF SDK", "Foxit"};
 using (Metadata metadata = new Metadata(doc))
 {
 for (int i = 0; i < metadata_values.Length; i++)
 {
 WStringArray ws_metadata_values = new WStringArray();
 ws_metadata_values.Add(metadata_values[i]);
 metadata.SetValues(metadata_items[i], ws_metadata_values);
 }
 metadata.SetCreationDateTime(GetLocalDateTime());
 metadata.SetModifiedDateTime(GetLocalDateTime());
 }
 }
 }
}

---

how to reflow pdf page and render as bitmap
using System;
using System.Drawing;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here
 public static void SaveBitmap(System.Drawing.Bitmap bitmap, string file_name)
 {
 Graphics pDraw = Graphics.FromImage(bitmap);
 SolidBrush brush = new SolidBrush(System.Drawing.Color.White);
 pDraw.FillRectangle(brush, 0, 0, 480, 30);
 pDraw.FillRectangle(brush, 0, 7700, 480, 30);
 bitmap.Save(file_name);
 pDraw.Dispose();
 }
 public static void ReflowContinuous(PDFDoc doc, string output_path)
 {
 RectF margin = new RectF(50f, 30f, 30f, 30f);
 foxit.common.fxcrt.Point size = new foxit.common.fxcrt.Point(480, 800);
 float display_height = 740;

 System.Drawing.Bitmap bitmap = new System.Drawing.Bitmap(size.x, size.y);
 Graphics draw = Graphics.FromImage(bitmap);
 draw.Clear(System.Drawing.Color.White);

 float offset_y = 0;
 int nCount = doc.GetPageCount();
 using (PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0))
 {
 // Parse PDF page.
 page.StartParse((int)foxit.pdf.PDFPage.ParseFlags.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);

 using (ReflowPage reflow_page = new ReflowPage(page))
 {
 reflow_page.SetLineSpace(0);
 reflow_page.SetScreenMargin((int)margin.left, (int)margin.top, (int)margin.right, (int)margin.bottom);
 reflow_page.SetScreenSize(size.x, size.y);
 reflow_page.SetZoom(100);
 reflow_page.SetParseFlags((int)ReflowPage.Flags.e_WithImage);
 reflow_page.SetTopSpace(offset_y);

 // Parse reflow page.
 reflow_page.StartParse(null);
 float content_height = reflow_page.GetContentHeight();
 float content_width = reflow_page.GetContentWidth();
 // Render reflow page.
 using (Renderer renderer = new Renderer(bitmap, false))
 {
 Matrix2D matrix = reflow_page.GetDisplayMatrix(0, 0, Convert.ToInt32(content_width), Convert.ToInt32(content_height), Rotation.e_Rotation0);
 renderer.StartRenderReflowPage(reflow_page, matrix, null);
 int rate_need_screen_count = (int)(Math.Ceiling(Math.Max(content_height - display_height, 0.0f) / display_height));
 if (rate_need_screen_count > 0)
 {
 SaveBitmap(bitmap, "1.bmp");

 float has_display_height = display_height;
 for (int j = 0; j < rate_need_screen_count; j++)
 {
 draw.Clear(System.Drawing.Color.White);
 // Render reflow page.
 using (Renderer _renderer = new Renderer(bitmap, false))
 {
 matrix = reflow_page.GetDisplayMatrix(0, -has_display_height, Convert.ToInt32(content_width), Convert.ToInt32(content_height), Rotation.e_Rotation0);
 renderer.StartRenderReflowPage(reflow_page, matrix, null);
 if (j != rate_need_screen_count - 1)
 {
 has_display_height += display_height;
 SaveBitmap(bitmap, "2.bmp");
 }
 else
 {
 offset_y = content_height - rate_need_screen_count * display_height;
 }
 }
 }
 }
 else
 {
 offset_y = content_height;
 }
 }
 }
 }

 SaveBitmap(bitmap, "reflow.bmp");

 draw.Dispose();
 }

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 string input_file = "AboutFoxit.pdf";
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 error_code = doc.Load(null);
 ReflowContinuous(doc, "/pdfreflow");
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to optimize pdf file by clean up redundant date
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.IO;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;
using foxit.pdf.objects;
using foxit.addon;
using foxit.addon.optimization;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 string input_file = "Cleanup.pdf";
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("Document Load Error: {0}", error_code);
 return;
 }
 using (OptimizerSettings settings = new OptimizerSettings())
 {
 settings.SetOptimizerOptions((int)foxit.addon.optimization.OptimizerSettings.OptimizerOptions.e_OptimizerCleanUp);
 settings.SetCleanUpOptions((int)(foxit.addon.optimization.OptimizerSettings.CleanUpOptions.e_CleanUpRemoveInvalidBookmarks | foxit.addon.optimization.OptimizerSettings.CleanUpOptions.e_CleanUpRemoveInvalidLinks
 | foxit.addon.optimization.OptimizerSettings.CleanUpOptions.e_CleanUpUseFlateForNonEncodedStream | foxit.addon.optimization.OptimizerSettings.CleanUpOptions.e_CleanUpUseFlateInsteadOfLZW));
 Progressive progressive = Optimizer.Optimize(doc, settings, null);
 Progressive.State progress_state = Progressive.State.e_ToBeContinued;
 while (Progressive.State.e_ToBeContinued == progress_state)
 {
 progress_state = progressive.Continue();
 int percent = progressive.GetRateOfProgress();
 Console.WriteLine("Optimize progress percent: {0}%", percent);
 }
 if (Progressive.State.e_Finished == progress_state)
 {
 doc.SaveAs("Cleanup_Optimized.pdf", (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagRemoveRedundantObjects);
 }
 }
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

How to associate file to page dictionary
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;
using foxit.pdf.objects;
using foxit.pdf.annots;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 const string sn = "";
 const string key = "";

 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("Simple.pdf"))
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("Load document error!");
 }

 AssociatedFiles associated_files = new AssociatedFiles(doc);

 // Create filespec with 1.txt
 FileSpec filespec_txt = new FileSpec(doc);
 filespec_txt.SetAssociteFileRelationship(AssociatedFiles.Relationship.e_RelationshipSource);
 filespec_txt.SetFileName("1.txt");
 using (foxit.common.DateTime dateTime = new foxit.common.DateTime(2017, 9, 15, 17, 20, 20, 0, 8, 0))
 {
 filespec_txt.SetDescription("text");
 filespec_txt.Embed("1.txt");
 filespec_txt.SetCreationDateTime(dateTime);
 filespec_txt.SetModifiedDateTime(dateTime);
 filespec_txt.SetSubtype("application/octet-stream");

 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);
 page.StartParse((int)PDFPage.ParseFlags.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);

 associated_files.AssociateFile(page, filespec_txt);

 string newPdf = "newPDF.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

How to add a highlight annotation
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;
using foxit.pdf.annots;
using foxit.pdf.actions;
using foxit.pdf.objects;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static foxit.common.DateTime GetLocalDateTime()
 {
 System.DateTimeOffset rime = System.DateTimeOffset.Now;
 foxit.common.DateTime datetime = new foxit.common.DateTime();
 datetime.year = (UInt16)rime.Year;
 datetime.month = (UInt16)rime.Month;
 datetime.day = (ushort)rime.Day;
 datetime.hour = (UInt16)rime.Hour;
 datetime.minute = (UInt16)rime.Minute;
 datetime.second = (UInt16)rime.Second;

 datetime.utc_hour_offset = (short)rime.Offset.Hours;
 datetime.utc_minute_offset = (ushort)rime.Offset.Minutes;

 return datetime;
 }
 static String RandomUID()
 {
 return System.Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
 }
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 const string sn = "";
 const string key = "";

 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("Sample.pdf"))
 {
 doc.Load(null);

 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);

 {
 // Add highlight annotation.
 Highlight highlight = null;
 Annot annot = null;
 using (annot = page.AddAnnot(Annot.Type.e_Highlight, new RectF(10, 450, 100, 550)))
 using (highlight = new Highlight(annot))
 {
 highlight.SetContent("Highlight");
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 highlight.SetFlags(4);
 QuadPoints quad_points = new QuadPoints();
 using (quad_points.first = new foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF(10, 500))
 using (quad_points.second = new foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF(90, 500))
 using (quad_points.third = new foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF(10, 480))
 using (quad_points.fourth = new foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF(90, 480))
 using (QuadPointsArray quad_points_array = new QuadPointsArray())
 {
 quad_points_array.Add(quad_points);
 highlight.SetQuadPoints(quad_points_array);
 highlight.SetSubject("Highlight");
 highlight.SetTitle("Foxit SDK");
 highlight.SetCreationDateTime(GetLocalDateTime());
 highlight.SetModifiedDateTime(GetLocalDateTime());
 highlight.SetUniqueID(RandomUID());
 // Appearance should be reset.
 highlight.ResetAppearanceStream();
 Console.WriteLine("Add a highlight annotation.");
 }
 }
 }

 // Save PDF file
 string newPdf = "newpdf.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

---

how to print a pdf file? how to print document?
using System;
using System.Drawing.Printing;
using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 private const int HORZRES = 8;
 private const int VERTRES = 10;
 private const int SP_ERROR = -1;

 [System.Runtime.InteropServices.DllImportAttribute("gdi32.dll")]
 private static extern IntPtr CreateDC(
 string lp_sz_driver,
 string lp_sz_device,
 string lp_sz_output,
 IntPtr lp_init_data
 );

 [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, CharSet = CharSet.Ansi)]
 public class DOCINFOA
 {
 [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.I4)]
 public int cbSize;
 [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.LPStr)]
 public string lpszDocName;
 [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.LPStr)]
 public string lpszOutput;
 [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.LPStr)]
 public string lpszDatatype;
 [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.I4)]
 public int fwType;
 }
 [System.Runtime.InteropServices.DllImportAttribute("gdi32.dll")]
 public static extern int StartDocA(IntPtr hdc, [In, MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.LPStruct)]DOCINFOA docinfo);
 [System.Runtime.InteropServices.DllImportAttribute("gdi32.dll")]
 public static extern int StartPage(IntPtr hdc);
 [System.Runtime.InteropServices.DllImportAttribute("gdi32.dll")]
 public static extern int GetDeviceCaps(IntPtr hdc, int index);
 [System.Runtime.InteropServices.DllImportAttribute("gdi32.dll")]
 public static extern int EndDoc(IntPtr hdc);
 [System.Runtime.InteropServices.DllImportAttribute("gdi32.dll")]
 public static extern int EndPage(IntPtr hdc);
 [System.Runtime.InteropServices.DllImportAttribute("gdi32.dll")]
 public static extern bool DeleteDC(IntPtr hdc);
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 PrintDocument fPrintDoc = new PrintDocument();
 IntPtr dc = CreateDC("", fPrintDoc.PrinterSettings.PrinterName, "", (IntPtr)null);
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("annotations.pdf"))
 {
 error_code = doc.Load(null);
 DOCINFOA doc_info = new DOCINFOA();
 doc_info.lpszDocName = "document.pdf";
 doc_info.lpszOutput = null;
 doc_info.fwType = 0;
 int nError = StartDocA(dc, doc_info);
 if (nError == SP_ERROR) return;
 int nPageCount = doc.GetPageCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < nPageCount; i++)
 using (PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(i))
 {
 // Parse page.
 page.StartParse((int)foxit.pdf.PDFPage.ParseFlags.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);
 int width = (int)(page.GetWidth());
 int height = (int)(page.GetHeight());
 nError = StartPage(dc);
 if (nError == SP_ERROR) continue;
 float device_width = (float)GetDeviceCaps(dc, HORZRES);
 float device_height = (float)GetDeviceCaps(dc, VERTRES);
 float x_scale = device_width / width;
 float y_scale = device_height / height;
 float scale = x_scale < y_scale ? x_scale : y_scale;
 float x_offset = 0.0f;
 float y_offset = 0.0f;
 if (x_scale < y_scale)
 {
 y_offset = (device_height - scale * height) / 2;
 device_height = scale * height;
 } else {
 x_offset = (device_width - scale * width) / 2;
 device_width = scale * width;
 }
 Matrix2D matrix = page.GetDisplayMatrix((int)x_offset, (int)y_offset, (int)device_width, (int)device_height, page.GetRotation());
 using (Renderer render = new Renderer(dc, fPrintDoc.PrinterSettings.PrinterName))
 {
 using (RectI clip_rect = new RectI((int)x_offset, (int)y_offset, (int)(device_width + x_offset), (int)(device_height + y_offset)))
 {
 render.EnableForPrint(true);
 render.SetClipRect(clip_rect);
 Progressive render_prossive = render.StartRender(page, matrix, null);
 foxit.common.Progressive.State state = render_prossive.Continue();
 }
 }
 EndPage(dc);
 }
 EndDoc(dc);
 }
 DeleteDC(dc);
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to check the information of existed signature
using System;
using System.Text;
using System.IO;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit;
using foxit.pdf.annots;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Security;
using System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates;
using System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using foxit.pdf.interform;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {

 static void CheckSignatureInfo(PDFDoc pdf_doc)
 {
 int sig_count = pdf_doc.GetSignatureCount();
 if (sig_count < 1)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("No signature in current PDF file.");
 return;
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < sig_count; i++)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("Signature index: {0}", i);
 using (Signature signature = pdf_doc.GetSignature(i))
 {
 if (signature.IsEmpty()) continue;
 bool is_signed = signature.IsSigned();
 Console.WriteLine("Signed?:{0}", is_signed ? "true" : "false");
 uint sig_state = signature.GetState();

 using (Control control = signature.GetControl(0))
 using (Widget widget_annot = control.GetWidget())
 {
 Console.WriteLine("Object number {0} of related widget annotation's dictionary", widget_annot.GetDict().GetObjNum());
 }

 String filter = signature.GetFilter();
 Console.WriteLine("Filter:{0}", filter);
 String sub_filter = signature.GetSubFilter();
 Console.WriteLine("Sub-filter:{0}", sub_filter);
 if (is_signed)
 {
 foxit.common.DateTime sign_time = signature.GetSignTime();
 }
 string key_value;
 key_value = signature.GetKeyValue(Signature.KeyName.e_KeyNameSigner);
 Console.WriteLine("Signer:{0}", key_value);
 key_value = signature.GetKeyValue(Signature.KeyName.e_KeyNameLocation);
 Console.WriteLine("Location:{0}", key_value);
 key_value = signature.GetKeyValue(Signature.KeyName.e_KeyNameReason);
 Console.WriteLine("Reason:{0}", key_value);
 key_value = signature.GetKeyValue(Signature.KeyName.e_KeyNameContactInfo);
 Console.WriteLine("Contact Info:{0}", key_value);
 key_value = signature.GetKeyValue(Signature.KeyName.e_KeyNameDN);
 Console.WriteLine("DN:{0}", key_value);
 key_value = signature.GetKeyValue(Signature.KeyName.e_KeyNameText);
 Console.WriteLine("Text:{0}", key_value);
 }
 }
 }

 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }

 using (PDFDoc pdf_doc = new PDFDoc("AboutFoxit.pdf"))
 {
 pdf_doc.StartLoad(null, true, null);
 // Check information of existed signature(s) in PDF file if there's any signature in the PDF file.
 CheckSignatureInfo(pdf_doc);
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

How to add a squiggly annotation
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;
using foxit.pdf.annots;
using foxit.pdf.actions;
using foxit.pdf.objects;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static foxit.common.DateTime GetLocalDateTime()
 {
 System.DateTimeOffset rime = System.DateTimeOffset.Now;
 foxit.common.DateTime datetime = new foxit.common.DateTime();
 datetime.year = (UInt16)rime.Year;
 datetime.month = (UInt16)rime.Month;
 datetime.day = (ushort)rime.Day;
 datetime.hour = (UInt16)rime.Hour;
 datetime.minute = (UInt16)rime.Minute;
 datetime.second = (UInt16)rime.Second;

 datetime.utc_hour_offset = (short)rime.Offset.Hours;
 datetime.utc_minute_offset = (ushort)rime.Offset.Minutes;

 return datetime;
 }
 static String RandomUID()
 {
 return System.Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
 }
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 const string sn = "";
 const string key = "";

 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("Sample.pdf"))
 {
 doc.Load(null);

 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);

 {
 // Add squiggly annotation.
 Squiggly squiggly = null;
 Annot annot = null;
 using (annot = page.AddAnnot(Annot.Type.e_Squiggly, new RectF(200, 450, 300, 550)))
 using (squiggly = new Squiggly(annot))
 {
 squiggly.SetIntent("Squiggly");
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 squiggly.SetFlags(4);
 using (QuadPoints quad_points = new QuadPoints())
 using (quad_points.first = new foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF(210, 500))
 using (quad_points.second = new foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF(290, 500))
 using (quad_points.third = new foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF(210, 480))
 using (quad_points.fourth = new foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF(290, 480))
 using (QuadPointsArray quad_points_array = new QuadPointsArray())
 {
 quad_points_array.Add(quad_points);
 squiggly.SetQuadPoints(quad_points_array);
 squiggly.SetSubject("Squiggly");
 squiggly.SetTitle("Foxit SDK");
 squiggly.SetCreationDateTime(GetLocalDateTime());
 squiggly.SetModifiedDateTime(GetLocalDateTime());
 squiggly.SetUniqueID(RandomUID());
 // Appearance should be reset.
 squiggly.ResetAppearanceStream();
 Console.WriteLine("Add a squiggly annotation.");
 }
 }
 }

 // Save PDF file
 string newPdf = "newpdf.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to make multiple signatures share signature data.

using System;
using System.Text;
using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
namespace sample
{
 class sample_class
 {

 static void Main(String[] args)
 {
 // Initialize library
 string sn = "";
 string key = "";
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 Console.WriteLine("Library Initialize Error: {0}\n", error_code);
 try
 {
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("blank.pdf"))
 {
 error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Library.Release();
 return;
 }
 using (PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0))
 {
 using (Signature pNewSig = page.AddSignature(new RectF(0, 400, 200, 475)))
 {
 pNewSig.SetKeyValue(Signature.KeyName.e_KeyNameSigner, "Neko");
 pNewSig.SetKeyValue(Signature.KeyName.e_KeyNameReason, "For test");
 pNewSig.GenerateAppearance();
 Signature sign1 = page.AddSignatureWithExistedVDict(new RectF(200, 200, 400, 275), "test1", Signature.SignatureType.e_SignatureTypeOrdinary, false, pNewSig);
 sign1.SetKeyValue(Signature.KeyName.e_KeyNameSigner, "Jack");
 sign1.SetKeyValue(Signature.KeyName.e_KeyNameReason, "For test GSDK");
 sign1.GenerateAppearance();
 byte[] cert_file_password = Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes("123456");
 pNewSig.StartSign("foxit_all.pfx", cert_file_password, Signature.DigestAlgorithm.e_DigestSHA1, "Signed.pdf", IntPtr.Zero, null);
 }
 }
 }
 }
 catch (System.Exception e)
 {
 Console.WriteLine(e.Message);
 }
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

---

how to add push button
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.interform;
using foxit.pdf.annots;
using foxit.pdf.actions;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc())
 using (Form form = new Form(doc))
 {
 // Create a blank new page and add some form fields.
 using (PDFPage page = doc.InsertPage(0, PDFPage.Size.e_SizeLetter))
 {

 // Add push button field.
 using (Control btn_submit = form.AddControl(page, "Push Button Submit", Field.Type.e_TypePushButton, new RectF(50, 750, 150, 780)))
 // Set default appearance
 using (DefaultAppearance default_ap = new DefaultAppearance())
 {
 default_ap.flags = (int)(DefaultAppearance.DefAPFlags.e_FlagFont | DefaultAppearance.DefAPFlags.e_FlagFontSize | DefaultAppearance.DefAPFlags.e_FlagTextColor);
 using (default_ap.font = new Font(Font.StandardID.e_StdIDHelveticaB))
 {
 default_ap.text_size = 12.0f;
 default_ap.text_color = 0x000000;
 form.SetDefaultAppearance(default_ap);
 }

 // Set push button appearance.
 using (Widget widget = btn_submit.GetWidget())
 {
 widget.SetHighlightingMode(Annot.HighlightingMode.e_HighlightingPush);
 widget.SetMKBorderColor(0xFF0000);
 widget.SetMKBackgroundColor(0xF0F0F0);
 widget.SetMKNormalCaption("Submit");
 widget.ResetAppearanceStream();

 // Set submit form action.
 using (PDFDoc doc2 = form.GetDocument())
 {
 using (foxit.pdf.actions.Action action = foxit.pdf.actions.Action.Create(doc2, foxit.pdf.actions.Action.Type.e_TypeSubmitForm))
 using (SubmitFormAction submit_action = new SubmitFormAction(action))
 {
 int count = form.GetFieldCount(null);
 WStringArray name_array = new WStringArray();
 for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
 {
 Field field = form.GetField(i, null);
 using (field)
 {
 name_array.Add(field.GetName());
 }
 }
 submit_action.SetFieldNames(name_array);
 //submit_action.SetURL("http://www.foxitsoftware.com");
 widget.SetAction(submit_action);
 widget.ResetAppearanceStream();
 Console.WriteLine("Add button field.");
 }
 }
 }
 }
 string new_pdf = "form.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(new_pdf, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
 }
}

---

how to import page
using System;
using System.IO;

using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void ImportPage()
 {
 string file_dest = "page_organization_123.pdf";
 string file_src = "page_organization_abc.pdf";
 using (var doc_src = new PDFDoc(file_src))
 {
 ErrorCode code = doc_src.Load(null);
 if (code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("The PDFDoc {0} Error: {1}", file_src, code);
 return;
 }
 Range import_ranges = new Range(0);
 import_ranges.AddSingle(doc_src.GetPageCount() - 1);
 using (var doc_dest = new PDFDoc(file_dest))
 {
 code = doc_dest.Load(null);
 if (code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("The PDFDoc {0} Error: {1}", file_dest, code);
 return;
 }
 // Import page from PDFDoc object.
 using (var progressive =
 doc_dest.StartImportPages(-1, doc_src, (int)PDFDoc.ImportPageFlags.e_ImportFlagNormal,
 "abc", import_ranges, null))
 {
 while (progressive.Continue() != Progressive.State.e_Finished)
 {
 }
 }
 string output_file = "page_organization_abc_to_123_import_pages.pdf";
 doc_dest.SaveAs(output_file, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNormal);
 }
 using (var doc_dest = new PDFDoc(file_dest))
 {
 code = doc_dest.Load(null);
 if (code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("The PDFDoc {0} Error: {1}", file_dest, code);
 return;
 }
 // Import pages from file path.
 using (var progressive = doc_dest.StartImportPagesFromFilePath(
 -1, file_src, null, (int)PDFDoc.ImportPageFlags.e_ImportFlagNormal, "abc",
 import_ranges, null))
 {
 while (progressive.Continue() != Progressive.State.e_Finished)
 {
 }
 }
 string output_file = "abc_to_123_import_pages_form_filepath.pdf";
 doc_dest.SaveAs(output_file, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNormal);
 }
 }
 Console.WriteLine("Import pages.");

 }

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }
 ImportPage();
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

How to get associate files in page dictionary
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;
using foxit.pdf.objects;
using foxit.pdf.annots;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 const string sn = "";
 const string key = "";

 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("Simple.pdf"))
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("Load document error!");
 }

 AssociatedFiles associated_files = new AssociatedFiles(doc);

 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);
 PDFDictionary page_dict = page.GetDict();
 int count = associated_files.GetAssociatedFilesCount(page_dict);
 if (count > 0)
 {
 FileSpec filespec = associated_files.GetAssociatedFile(page_dict, 0);
 filespec.ExportToFile("af_2.txt");
 }
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}
