how to convert text to pdf
using System;
using System.IO;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.addon.conversion;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here
 const string output_file = "AboutFoxit.pdf";
 const string input_file = "AboutFoxit.txt";

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }

 {
 using (var setting_data = new TXT2PDFSettingData())
 {
 using (var font = new Font("SimSun", (int)Font.Styles.e_StyleFixedPitch, Font.Charset.e_CharsetGB2312, 0))
 {
 setting_data.page_width = 595;
 setting_data.page_height = 842;
 setting_data.font = font;
 setting_data.text_color = 0xFF0000FF;
 setting_data.text_size = 9;
 setting_data.linespace = 1;
 setting_data.page_margin = new RectF(0, 0, 0, 0);
 foxit.addon.conversion.Convert.FromTXT(input_file, output_file, setting_data);
 }
 }

 Console.WriteLine("Convert TEXT file to PDF file.");
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to add header and footer
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Environment.Exit(1);
 }

 // Load PDF document.
 string input_file = "HeaderFooter.pdf";
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("The PDFDoc [{0}] Error: {1}\n", input_file, error_code);
 Library.Release();
 return;
 }

 using (HeaderFooter headerfooter = doc.GetEditableHeaderFooter())
 {
 // Add header-footer
 headerfooter.text_color = 0x00FFFF;
 headerfooter.page_range = new PageNumberRange(1, doc.GetPageCount(), foxit.common.Range.Filter.e_Odd);
 headerfooter.has_fixedsize_for_print = false;
 headerfooter.has_text_shrinked = false;
 headerfooter.start_page_number = 2;
 headerfooter.page_margin = new RectF(36, 70, 36, 70);
 headerfooter.text_size = 8;
 doc.AddHeaderFooter(headerfooter);
 string output_file = "HeaderFooter_AddHeaderFooter.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(output_file, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 Console.WriteLine("Add PDF document header-footer.");
 }
 }
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

---

how to create a text watermark
using System;
using System.IO;

using foxit.common;
using foxit.pdf;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }
 const string input_file = "AboutFoxit.pdf";
 const string output_file = "watermark_add.pdf";
 using (var doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 error_code = doc.Load(null);

 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("The PDFDoc " + input_file + " Error: " + error_code);
 return;
 }
 int nCount = doc.GetPageCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < nCount; i++)
 {
 using (var page = doc.GetPage(i))
 {
 page.StartParse((int)PDFPage.ParseFlags.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);

 AddTextWatermark(doc, page); ;
 }
 }

 doc.SaveAs(output_file, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 Console.WriteLine("Add watermarks to PDF file.");
 }

 Library.Release();
 }

 static void AddTextWatermark(PDFDoc doc, PDFPage page)
 {
 using (var settings = new WatermarkSettings())
 {
 settings.flags = (int)(WatermarkSettings.Flags.e_FlagASPageContents | WatermarkSettings.Flags.e_FlagOnTop);
 settings.offset_x = 0;
 settings.offset_y = 0;
 settings.opacity = 90;
 settings.position = Position.e_PosTopRight;
 settings.rotation = -45.0f;
 settings.scale_x = 1.0f;
 settings.scale_y = 1.0f;

 using (var font = new Font(Font.StandardID.e_StdIDTimesB))
 {
 using (var text_properties = new WatermarkTextProperties())
 {
 text_properties.alignment = Alignment.e_AlignmentCenter;
 text_properties.color = 0xF68C21;
 text_properties.font_style = WatermarkTextProperties.FontStyle.e_FontStyleNormal;
 text_properties.line_space = 1;
 text_properties.font_size = 12.0f;
 text_properties.font = font;

 using (var watermark = new Watermark(doc, "Foxit PDF SDK\nwww.foxitsoftware.com", text_properties, settings))
 {
 watermark.InsertToPage(page);
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
}

---

how to create a text object in a pdf page
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;

using foxit.common;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 string input_file = "graphics_objects.pdf";

 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(input_file);
 ErrorCode ret = doc.Load(null);
 // Add a new PDF page and insert image objects.
 PDFPage page = doc.InsertPage(1, 300, 600);
 AddTextObjects(page);

 Library.Release();
 }

 static void AddTextObjects(PDFPage page)
 {
 long position = page.GetLastGraphicsObjectPosition(GraphicsObject.Type.e_TypeText);
 using (var text_object = TextObject.Create())
 {
 text_object.SetFillColor(0xFFFF7F00);

 // Prepare text state
 using (var state = new TextState())
 {
 using (var font = new Font("Simsun", (int)Font.Styles.e_StylesSmallCap, Font.Charset.e_CharsetGB2312, 0))
 {
 state.font_size = 80.0f;
 state.font = font;
 }
 state.textmode = TextState.Mode.e_ModeFill;
 text_object.SetTextState(page, state, false, 750);

 // Set text.
 text_object.SetText("Foxit Software");
 long last_position = page.InsertGraphicsObject(position, text_object);

 var rect = text_object.GetRect();
 float offset_x = (page.GetWidth() - (rect.right - rect.left)) / 2;
 float offset_y = page.GetHeight() * 0.8f - (rect.top - rect.bottom) / 2;
 text_object.Transform(new Matrix2D(1, 0, 0, 1, offset_x, offset_y), false);

 // Generate content
 page.GenerateContent();

 // Clone a text object from the old text object.
 using (var font = new Font(Font.StandardID.e_StdIDTimes))
 {
 using (var text_object2 = text_object.Clone().GetTextObject())
 {
 state.font = font;
 state.font_size = 48.0f;
 state.textmode = TextState.Mode.e_ModeFillStrokeClip;

 text_object2.SetTextState(page, state, true, 750);
 text_object2.SetText("www.foxitsoftware.com");

 text_object2.SetFillColor(0xFFAAAAAA);
 text_object2.SetStrokeColor(0xFFF68C21);
 page.InsertGraphicsObject(last_position, text_object2);

 rect = text_object2.GetRect();
 offset_x = (page.GetWidth() - (rect.right - rect.left)) / 2;
 offset_y = page.GetHeight() * 0.618f - (rect.top - rect.bottom) / 2;
 text_object2.Transform(new Matrix2D(1, 0, 0, 1, offset_x, offset_y), false);

 // Generate content again after transformation.
 page.GenerateContent();

 //Show how to get the characters' information of text object.
 int text_object_charcount = text_object2.GetCharCount();
 FileStream sfile = new FileStream("text_objects_info.txt", FileMode.OpenOrCreate);
 StreamWriter sw = new StreamWriter(sfile);
 sw.WriteLine("The new text object has " + text_object_charcount + "characters.");

 for (int i = 0; i < text_object_charcount; i++)
 {
 //The character's position.
 PointF char_pos = text_object2.GetCharPos(i);
 //The character's width.
 float width = text_object2.GetCharWidthByIndex(i);
 //The character's height.
 float height = text_object2.GetCharHeightByIndex(i);

 sw.WriteLine("The position of the " + i + " characters is (" + char_pos.x + "," + char_pos.y + ").The width and height of the characters is (" + width + "," + height + ").");
 }

 sw.Close();
 sfile.Close();
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
}

How to adds a new PDF page to document, from a named template.

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.objects;

namespace SimpledemoCS
{
 class add_page_from_template
 {

 static void Main(String[] args)
 {

 // Initialize library
 string sn = "";
 string key = "";
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 Console.WriteLine("Library Initialize Error: {0}\n", error_code);
 try
 {
 String input_file = "D:/test.pdf";
 // Load a document
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("[Failed] Cannot load PDF document: " + input_file + ".\r\nError Code: " + error_code + "\r\n");
 return;
 }

 using (PDFNameTree templates_name_tree = new PDFNameTree(doc, PDFNameTree.Type.e_Templates))
 {
 if (templates_name_tree.HasName("Page3"))
 {
 doc.AddPageFromTemplate("Page3");
 }
 doc.SaveAs("D:/test_add_template.pdf", (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 }
 }
 catch (System.Exception e)
 {
 Console.WriteLine(e.Message);
 }
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to convert office file to pdf
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }

 // Conver Word file to PDF file.
 string word_file_path = "AboutFoxit.doc";
 string saved_pdf_path = "word2pdf_result.pdf";
 using (foxit.addon.conversion.Word2PDFSettingData word_convert_setting_data = new foxit.addon.conversion.Word2PDFSettingData())
 {
 foxit.addon.conversion.Convert.FromWord(word_file_path, "", saved_pdf_path, word_convert_setting_data);
 Console.WriteLine("Convert Word file to PDF file.");
 }

 // Conver Excel file to PDF file.
 string excel_file_path = "test.xlsx";
 saved_pdf_path = "excel2pdf_result.pdf";
 using (foxit.addon.conversion.Excel2PDFSettingData excel_convert_setting_data = new foxit.addon.conversion.Excel2PDFSettingData())
 {
 foxit.addon.conversion.Convert.FromExcel(excel_file_path, "", saved_pdf_path, excel_convert_setting_data);
 Console.WriteLine("Convert Excel file to PDF file.");
 }

 // Conver PowerPoint file to PDF file.
 string ppt_file_path = "test.ppt";
 saved_pdf_path = "ppt2pdf_result.pdf";
 using (foxit.addon.conversion.PowerPoint2PDFSettingData ppt_convert_setting_data = new foxit.addon.conversion.PowerPoint2PDFSettingData())
 {
 foxit.addon.conversion.Convert.FromPowerPoint(ppt_file_path, "", saved_pdf_path, ppt_convert_setting_data);
 Console.WriteLine("Convert PowerPoint file to PDF file.");
 }
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

How to associate file to annotation dictionary
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;
using foxit.pdf.objects;
using foxit.pdf.annots;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 const string sn = "";
 const string key = "";

 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("Simple.pdf"))
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("Load document error!");
 }

 AssociatedFiles associated_files = new AssociatedFiles(doc);

 // Create filespec with 1.txt
 FileSpec filespec_txt = new FileSpec(doc);
 filespec_txt.SetAssociteFileRelationship(AssociatedFiles.Relationship.e_RelationshipSource);
 filespec_txt.SetFileName("1.txt");
 using (foxit.common.DateTime dateTime = new foxit.common.DateTime(2017, 9, 15, 17, 20, 20, 0, 8, 0))
 {
 filespec_txt.SetDescription("text");
 filespec_txt.Embed("1.txt");
 filespec_txt.SetCreationDateTime(dateTime);
 filespec_txt.SetModifiedDateTime(dateTime);
 filespec_txt.SetSubtype("application/octet-stream");

 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);
 RectF rect = new RectF(100, 50, 220, 100);
 Annot annot = page.AddAnnot(Annot.Type.e_Note, rect);
 annot.ResetAppearanceStream();
 associated_files.AssociateFile(annot, filespec_txt);

 string newPdf = "newPDF.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 }
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to ocr pdf page
using System;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.addon.ocr;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 String input_file = "AboutFoxit_ocr.pdf";
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 // "ocr_resource_path" is the path of ocr resources. Please refer to Developer Guide for more details.
 string ocr_resource_path = "";

 // Initialize OCR engine.
 error_code = OCREngine.Initialize(ocr_resource_path);
 Console.WriteLine("OCREngine is initialized.");
 // Set languages.
 OCREngine.SetLanguages("English");

 // OCR PDF page, only for search, not editable.
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 using (OCR ocr_operator = new OCR())
 {
 ErrorCode doc_error_code = doc.Load(null);
 using (PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0))
 {
 page.StartParse((int)PDFPage.ParseFlags.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);
 ocr_operator.OCRPDFPage(page, false);
 }

 String save_pdf_path = "ocr_page_searchable.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(save_pdf_path, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 // OCR PDF page, editable.
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 using (OCR ocr_operator = new OCR())
 {
 ErrorCode doc_error_code = doc.Load(null);
 using (PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0))
 {
 page.StartParse((int)PDFPage.ParseFlags.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);
 ocr_operator.OCRPDFPage(page, true);
 }

 String save_pdf_path = "ocr_page_editable.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(save_pdf_path, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 OCREngine.Release();

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

How to add a link annotation
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;
using foxit.pdf.annots;
using foxit.pdf.actions;
using foxit.pdf.objects;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 const string sn = "";
 const string key = "";

 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("Sample.pdf"))
 {
 doc.Load(null);

 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);

 {
 // Add link annotation
 Link link = null;
 Annot annot = null;
 using (annot = page.AddAnnot(Annot.Type.e_Link, new RectF(350, 350, 380, 400)))
 using (link = new Link(annot))
 using (PDFDoc doc = page.GetDocument())
 {
 foxit.pdf.actions.Action action = null;
 link.SetHighlightingMode(Annot.HighlightingMode.e_HighlightingPush);
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 link.SetFlags(4);
 // Add action for link annotation
 URIAction uriaction = null;
 using (action = foxit.pdf.actions.Action.Create(doc, foxit.pdf.actions.Action.Type.e_TypeURI))
 using (uriaction = new URIAction(action))
 {
 uriaction.SetTrackPositionFlag(true);
 uriaction.SetURI("www.foxitsoftware.com");
 link.SetAction(uriaction);
 // Appearance should be reset.
 link.ResetAppearanceStream();
 Console.WriteLine("Add a link annotation.");
 }
 }
 }

 // Save PDF file
 string newPdf = "newpdf.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

---

how to add new signature
using System;
using System.Text;
using System.IO;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit;
using foxit.pdf.annots;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Security;
using System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates;
using System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using foxit.pdf.interform;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode errorCode = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (errorCode != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }

 using (PDFDoc pdfDoc = new PDFDoc("AboutFoxit.pdf"))
 {
 pdfDoc.StartLoad(null, true, null);

 using (PDFPage pdfPage = pdfDoc.GetPage(0))
 {
 // Add a new signature to the first page.
 Signature newSignature = pdfPage.AddSignature(new RectF(1, 1, 101, 101));
 newSignature.SetKeyValue(Signature.KeyName.e_KeyNameSigner, "Foxit PDF SDK");

 // Set filter and subfilter for the new signature.
 newSignature.SetFilter("Adobe.PPKLite");
 newSignature.SetSubFilter("adbe.pkcs7.detached");

 // Sign the new signature.
 String cert_file_path = "foxit_all.pfx";
 byte[] cert_file_password = Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes("123456");
 newSignature.StartSign(cert_file_path, cert_file_password, Signature.DigestAlgorithm.e_DigestSHA1, "signed_newsignature.pdf", IntPtr.Zero, null);
 }
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to get marked content
using System;
using System.IO;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;
using foxit.pdf.objects;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 GetMarkedContentObject("marked_content.pdf");

 Library.Release();
 }

 static void GetMarkedContentObject(String pdf_file)
 {
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(pdf_file))
 {
 ErrorCode ret = doc.Load(null);
 if (ret != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine(String.Format("[Failed] Cannot load PDF document %s.\r\n Error message:%d\r\n",
 pdf_file, ret));
 return;
 }
 using (PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0))
 {
 page.StartParse((int)PDFPage.ParseFlags.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);
 long position = page.GetFirstGraphicsObjectPosition(GraphicsObject.Type.e_TypeText);
 GraphicsObject text_obj = page.GetGraphicsObject(position);
 MarkedContent content = text_obj.GetMarkedContent();

 int nCount = content.GetItemCount();
 String file_info = "markedcontent.txt";
 FileStream sfile = new FileStream(file_info, FileMode.OpenOrCreate);
 StreamWriter sw = new StreamWriter(sfile);
 // Get marked content property
 for (int i = 0; i < nCount; i++)
 {
 sw.WriteLine("index: " + i);
 String tag_name = content.GetItemTagName(i);
 sw.WriteLine("Tag name: " + tag_name);
 int mcid = content.GetItemMCID(i);
 sw.WriteLine("mcid: " + mcid);
 }
 sw.Close();
 }
 }
 }
 }
}

How to create a root node for bookmark
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.IO;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.actions;

namespace FoxitBookmarkExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 string sn = "";
 string key = "";

 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("AboutFoxit.pdf"))
 {
 doc.Load(null);

 Bookmark root = doc.GetRootBookmark();

 if (root.IsEmpty())
 {
 root = doc.CreateRootBookmark();
 }
 using (root)
 {
 for (int i = 0; i < doc.GetPageCount(); i += 2)
 {
 using (Destination dest = Destination.CreateFitPage(doc, i))
 {
 string ws_title = string.Format("A bookmark to a page (index: {0})", i);

 Bookmark child;
 using (child = root.Insert(ws_title, Bookmark.Position.e_PosLastChild))
 {
 child.SetDestination(dest);
 child.SetColor(i * 0xF68C21);
 }
 }
 }
 }
 doc.SaveAs("bookmark_add.pdf", (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to remove all watermark
using System;
using System.IO;

using foxit.common;
using foxit.pdf;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }
 const string input_file = "AboutFoxit.pdf";
 const string output_remove_file = "watermark_remove.pdf";
 using (var doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 error_code = doc.Load(null);

 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("The PDFDoc " + input_file + " Error: " + error_code);
 return;
 }
 int nCount = doc.GetPageCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < nCount; i++)
 {
 using (var page = doc.GetPage(i))
 {
 page.StartParse((int)PDFPage.ParseFlags.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);

 if (page.HasWatermark())
 {
 page.RemoveAllWatermarks();
 }
 }
 }

 doc.SaveAs(output_remove_file, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 Console.WriteLine("Remove watermarks to PDF file.");
 }

 Library.Release();
 }

 static void AddSingleWatermark(PDFDoc doc, PDFPage page)
 {
 using (var settings = new WatermarkSettings())
 {
 settings.flags = (int)(WatermarkSettings.Flags.e_FlagASPageContents | WatermarkSettings.Flags.e_FlagOnTop);
 settings.offset_x = 0.0f;
 settings.offset_y = 0.0f;
 settings.opacity = 90;
 settings.position = Position.e_PosBottomRight;
 settings.rotation = 0.0f;
 settings.scale_x = 0.1f;
 settings.scale_y = 0.1f;
 using (var watermark = new Watermark(doc, page, settings))
 {
 watermark.InsertToPage(page);
 }
 }
 }
 }
}

---

how to create portfolio pdf file
using System;
using System.Text;
using System.IO;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.actions;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 public static bool CreatPortfolioPDF(string saved_portfolio_pdf_path)
 {
 // Create a new blank portfolio PDF.
 using (Portfolio new_portfolio = Portfolio.CreatePortfolio())
 {
 if (true == new_portfolio.IsEmpty())
 {
 return false;
 }

 // Get the root node.
 using (PortfolioNode root_node = new_portfolio.GetRootNode())
 {
 if (true == root_node.IsEmpty())
 {
 return false;
 }
 // The root node should be a folder node, so transfer to use PortfolioFolderNode.
 using (PortfolioFolderNode root_folder = new PortfolioFolderNode(root_node))
 {
 string input_pdf_filename = "AboutFoxit.pdf";
 string input_pdf_file_path = input_pdf_filename;
 using (PDFDoc pdf_doc = new PDFDoc(input_pdf_file_path))
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = pdf_doc.Load(null);
 // Add a sub folder to root folder node.
 using (PortfolioFolderNode new_sub_foldernode = root_folder.AddSubFolder("Sub Folder-1"))
 {
 new_sub_foldernode.SetDescription("Added to portfolio PDF file.");

 if (false == pdf_doc.IsEmpty())
 {
 using (PortfolioFileNode new_filenode = new_sub_foldernode.AddPDFDoc(pdf_doc, input_pdf_filename))
 {
 if (true == new_filenode.IsEmpty())
 {
 }
 else
 {
 using (FileSpec file_spec = new_filenode.GetFileSpec())
 {
 file_spec.SetDescription("Added to portfolio PDF file");
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }

 // Add a non-PDF file to root folder node.
 string input_file_path = "FoxitLogo.jpg";
 using (PortfolioFileNode new_sub_filenode = root_folder.AddFile(input_file_path))
 {
 using (FileSpec file_spec = new_sub_filenode.GetFileSpec())
 {
 file_spec.SetDescription("This is a non-PDF file added to portfolio PDF file.");
 }
 }
 using (PDFDoc portfolio_pdf_doc = new_portfolio.GetPortfolioPDFDoc())
 {
 return portfolio_pdf_doc.SaveAs(saved_portfolio_pdf_path, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNormal);
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }
 {
 string saved_portfolio_pdf_path = "new_portfolio.pdf";
 // Create a new portfolio PDF file
 CreatPortfolioPDF(saved_portfolio_pdf_path);
 }
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to move page
using System;
using System.IO;

using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void MovePages()
 {
 string input_file = "page_organization_123.pdf";
 string input_file1 = "page_organization_abc.pdf";
 Range page_set = new Range();
 // Move page
 using (var doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 ErrorCode code = doc.Load(null);
 if (code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("The PDFDoc {0} Error: {1}", input_file, code);
 return;
 }
 int count = doc.GetPageCount();
 using (var page = doc.GetPage(0))
 {
 doc.MovePageTo(page, doc.GetPageCount() - 1);
 }
 string output_file1 = "move_first_page_to_last.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(output_file1, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNormal);
 for (int i = 0; i < count / 2; i++)
 {
 page_set.AddSingle(2 * i);
 }
 }
 using (var doc = new PDFDoc(input_file1))
 {
 ErrorCode code = doc.Load(null);
 if (code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }
 doc.MovePagesTo(page_set, doc.GetPageCount() - 1);
 string output_file = "move_pages.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(output_file, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNormal);
 }
 Console.WriteLine("Move pages.");
 }

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }
 MovePages();
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

---

how to encrypt a PDF file with Certificate
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates;
using System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

using foxit.common;
using foxit.pdf;

namespace securityCS
{
 class Security
 {
 const string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 const string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void CertificateSecurity(string input_file)
 {
 Random rand = new Random(23);
 byte[] seed = new byte[24];
 rand.NextBytes(seed);
 for (int i = 20; i < 24; i++)
 {
 seed[i] = (byte)0xFF;
 }

 string output_file = "certificate_encrypt.pdf";
 using (var doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("The PDFDoc " + input_file + " Error: " + error_code);
 return;
 }

 // Do encryption.
 string cert_file_path = "foxit.cer";

 var cms = new EnvelopedCms(new ContentInfo(seed));
 cms.ContentEncryptionAlgorithm.Oid.Value = "1.2.840.113549.3.4";
 cms.Encrypt(new CmsRecipient(new X509Certificate2(cert_file_path)));
 byte[] bytes = cms.Encode();

 byte[] data = new byte[20 + bytes.Length];
 Array.Copy(seed, 0, data, 0, 20);
 Array.Copy(bytes, 0, data, 20, bytes.Length);
 SHA1 sha1 = new SHA1CryptoServiceProvider();
 byte[] initial_key = new byte[16];
 Array.Copy(sha1.ComputeHash(data), initial_key, initial_key.Length);

 byte[][] bytes_array = new byte[1][];
 bytes_array[0] = bytes;
 using (var handler = new CertificateSecurityHandler())
 {
 using (var encrypt_data = new CertificateEncryptData())
 {
 encrypt_data.Set(true, SecurityHandler.CipherType.e_CipherAES,
 bytes_array);
 handler.Initialize(encrypt_data, initial_key);

 doc.SetSecurityHandler(handler);
 doc.SaveAs(output_file, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNormal);
 }
 }
 }
 // Do decryption.
 Library.RegisterSecurityCallback("Adobe.PubSec", null);

 using (var encrypted_doc = new PDFDoc(output_file))
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = encrypted_doc.Load(null);

 output_file = "certificate_decrypt.pdf";
 encrypted_doc.RemoveSecurity();
 encrypted_doc.SaveAs(output_file, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNormal);
 }
 }

 static void SecurityImpl(string pdf_file)
 {
 CertificateSecurity(pdf_file);
 }
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 // Initialize library
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 SecurityImpl("AboutFoxit.pdf");
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

using System;

 {
 return;

 string fdf_file = "AnnotationData.fdf";

---

how to transform text or image matrix
using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("SamplePDF.pdf"))
 {
 error_code = doc.Load(null);
 using (PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0))
 {
 page.StartParse((int)PDFPage.ParseFlags.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);
 long pos = page.GetFirstGraphicsObjectPosition(foxit.pdf.graphics.GraphicsObject.Type.e_TypeAll);
 int flag = 0;
 while (pos > 0)
 {
 if (flag == (2 | 4))
 break;
 foxit.pdf.graphics.GraphicsObject obj = page.GetGraphicsObject(pos);
 pos = page.GetNextGraphicsObjectPosition(pos, foxit.pdf.graphics.GraphicsObject.Type.e_TypeAll);
 foxit.pdf.graphics.GraphicsObject.Type type = obj.GetType();
 float start_x = 0;
 if (type == foxit.pdf.graphics.GraphicsObject.Type.e_TypeText && ((flag & 2) <= 0))
 {
 foxit.pdf.graphics.TextObject text_obj = obj.GetTextObject();
 string text = text_obj.GetText();
 if (string.Compare("Foxit Software Incorporated", text) != 0)
 {
 continue;
 }
 start_x = 400.0f;
 flag |= 2;
 }
 else if (type == foxit.pdf.graphics.GraphicsObject.Type.e_TypeImage && ((flag & 4) <= 0))
 {
 start_x = 150.0f;
 flag |= 4;
 }
 else
 {
 continue;
 }
 foxit.pdf.graphics.GraphicsObject clone_obj1 = obj.Clone();
 Matrix2D matrix = clone_obj1.GetMatrix();
 matrix.Translate(0, 150, false);
 clone_obj1.SetMatrix(matrix);
 page.InsertGraphicsObject(0, clone_obj1);

 foxit.pdf.graphics.GraphicsObject clone_obj2 = obj.Clone();
 matrix = clone_obj2.GetMatrix();
 float d = matrix.d;
 float e = matrix.e;
 float f = matrix.f;

 // Translate it to the original point(0,0) first
 matrix.Translate(-e, -f, false);
 matrix.Rotate(1.57f, false);
 float distance = d;
 if (type == foxit.pdf.graphics.GraphicsObject.Type.e_TypeText)
 {
 RectF obj_rect = obj.GetRect();
 distance = obj_rect.top - obj_rect.bottom;
 }
 // Translate it to the specific coordinate(fStartX,400)
 matrix.Translate(distance + start_x, 400, false);
 clone_obj2.SetMatrix(matrix);
 page.InsertGraphicsObject(0, clone_obj2);

 foxit.pdf.graphics.GraphicsObject clone_obj3 = obj.Clone();
 matrix = clone_obj3.GetMatrix();
 matrix.Translate(-e, -f, false);
 matrix.Scale(1.5f, 1.5f, false);
 matrix.Translate(start_x, 600.0f, false);
 clone_obj3.SetMatrix(matrix);
 page.InsertGraphicsObject(0, clone_obj3);

 foxit.pdf.graphics.GraphicsObject clone_obj4 = obj.Clone();
 matrix = clone_obj4.GetMatrix();
 matrix.Translate(-e, -f, false);
 matrix.Shear(0.5f, 0.5f, false);
 matrix.Translate(start_x, 800.0f, false);
 clone_obj4.SetMatrix(matrix);
 page.InsertGraphicsObject(0, clone_obj4);
 }
 // Generate the page content
 page.GenerateContent();
 }
 doc.SaveAs("MatrixTransformResult.pdf", 0);
 }
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

---

How to get associate files in graphics objects
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;
using foxit.pdf.objects;
using foxit.pdf.annots;
namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 const string sn = "";
 const string key = "";

 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("Simple.pdf"))
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("Load document error!");
 }
 using (AssociatedFiles associated_files = new AssociatedFiles(doc))
 using (PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0))
 {
 page.StartParse((int)PDFPage.ParseFlags.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);
 long pos = page.GetFirstGraphicsObjectPosition(GraphicsObject.Type.e_TypeImage);
 using (GraphicsObject image_x_object = page.GetGraphicsObject(pos))
 using (PDFDictionary image_x_object_dict = image_x_object.GetImageObject().GetStream().GetDictionary())
 {
 int count = associated_files.GetAssociatedFilesCount(image_x_object_dict);
 Console.WriteLine("The image x object of \"AF_ImageXObject_FormXObject.pdf\" has " + count + " associated files.");
 using (FileSpec filespec = associated_files.GetAssociatedFile(image_x_object_dict, 0))
 {
 Console.WriteLine("The file name is \"" + filespec.GetFileName() + "\".");
 filespec.ExportToFile("af_5.txt");
 }
 }
 pos = page.GetFirstGraphicsObjectPosition(GraphicsObject.Type.e_TypeFormXObject);
 using (GraphicsObject form_x_object = page.GetGraphicsObject(pos))
 using (PDFDictionary form_x_object_dict = form_x_object.GetFormXObject().GetStream().GetDictionary())
 {
 int count = associated_files.GetAssociatedFilesCount(form_x_object_dict);
 Console.WriteLine("The form x object of \"AF_ImageXObject_FormXObject.pdf\" has " + count + "associated files.");
 using (FileSpec filespec = associated_files.GetAssociatedFile(form_x_object_dict, 0))
 {
 Console.WriteLine("The file name is \"" + filespec.GetFileName() + "\".");
 filespec.ExportToFile("af_6.txt");
 }
 }
 }
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

How to clone bitmap with the bounding box according to the given background color
using System;
using System.Drawing;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using System.Drawing.Imaging;

namespace FoxitImageExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 string sn = "";
 string key = "";
 // Initialize library
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 void SaveBitmap(Bitmap bitmap, string filePath)
 {
 Image image = new Image();
 image.AddFrame(bitmap);
 image.SaveAs(filePath);
 }

 Image image = new Image("Sample.png");
 Bitmap bitmap = image.GetFrameBitmap(0);

 int width = bitmap.GetWidth();
 int height = bitmap.GetHeight();

 RectI rect = bitmap.CalculateBBoxByColor(Convert.ToUInt32(0xFFFDFDFD));
 System.Drawing.Bitmap clone_bitmap;
 if (rect.Height() > 0 && rect.Width() > 0)
 {
 clone_bitmap = bitmap.Clone(rect);
 string output_file = "result.bmp";
 SaveBitmap(clone_bitmap, output_file);
 }
 else
 {
 Console.WriteLine("[Warning] The result of bounding box (according to the given background color) is an empty rectangle.\r\n");
 }

 Library.Release();
 Environment.Exit(0);
 }
 }
}

 {

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc())
 using (Form form = new Form(doc))

 using (PDFPage page = doc.InsertPage(0, PDFPage.Size.e_SizeLetter))

how to add table to a PDF document
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.IO;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.addon;
using foxit.addon.tablegenerator;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.annots;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ".."; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ".."; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode errorCode = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (errorCode != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Environment.Exit(1);
 }

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc())
 {
 PDFPage page = doc.InsertPage(0, PDFPage.Size.e_SizeLetter);
 AddElectronicTable(page);

 doc.SaveAs("output.pdf", (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }

 Library.Release();
 }

 public static void AddElectronicTable(PDFPage page)
 {
 // Add a spreadsheet with 4 rows and 3 columns
 {
 using (TableCellDataArray cell_array = new TableCellDataArray())
 {
 for (int row = 0; row < 4; row++)
 {
 using (RichTextStyle style = new RichTextStyle())
 using (TableCellDataColArray col_array = new TableCellDataColArray())
 {
 for (int col = 0; col < 3; col++)
 {
 string cell_text ="Foxit PDF SDK";
 Image image = new Image();
 using (TableCellData cell_data = new TableCellData(style, cell_text, image, new RectF()))
 {
 col_array.Add(cell_data);
 }
 }
 cell_array.Add(col_array);
 }
 }
 float page_width = page.GetWidth();
 float page_height = page.GetHeight();
 TableBorderInfo outside_border_left = new TableBorderInfo();
 outside_border_left.line_width = 1;
 outside_border_left.table_border_style = TableBorderInfo.TableBorderStyle.e_TableBorderStyleSolid;
 TableBorderInfo outside_border_right = new TableBorderInfo();
 outside_border_right.line_width = 1;
 outside_border_right.table_border_style = TableBorderInfo.TableBorderStyle.e_TableBorderStyleSolid;
 TableBorderInfo outside_border_top = new TableBorderInfo();
 outside_border_top.line_width = 1;
 outside_border_top.table_border_style = TableBorderInfo.TableBorderStyle.e_TableBorderStyleSolid;
 TableBorderInfo outside_border_bottom = new TableBorderInfo();
 outside_border_bottom.line_width = 1;
 outside_border_bottom.table_border_style = TableBorderInfo.TableBorderStyle.e_TableBorderStyleSolid;
 TableBorderInfo inside_border_row_info = new TableBorderInfo();
 inside_border_row_info.line_width = 1;
 inside_border_row_info.table_border_style = TableBorderInfo.TableBorderStyle.e_TableBorderStyleSolid;
 TableBorderInfo inside_border_col_info = new TableBorderInfo();
 inside_border_col_info.line_width = 1;
 inside_border_col_info.table_border_style = TableBorderInfo.TableBorderStyle.e_TableBorderStyleSolid;
 using (RectF rect = new RectF(100, 550, page_width - 100, page_height - 100))
 using (TableData data = new TableData(rect, 4, 3, outside_border_left, outside_border_right, outside_border_top, outside_border_bottom, inside_border_row_info, inside_border_col_info, new TableCellIndexArray(), new FloatArray(), new FloatArray()))
 {
 TableGenerator.AddTableToPage(page, data, cell_array);
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
}

How to add a polyline annotation
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;
using foxit.pdf.annots;
using foxit.pdf.actions;
using foxit.pdf.objects;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static foxit.common.DateTime GetLocalDateTime()
 {
 System.DateTimeOffset rime = System.DateTimeOffset.Now;
 foxit.common.DateTime datetime = new foxit.common.DateTime();
 datetime.year = (UInt16)rime.Year;
 datetime.month = (UInt16)rime.Month;
 datetime.day = (ushort)rime.Day;
 datetime.hour = (UInt16)rime.Hour;
 datetime.minute = (UInt16)rime.Minute;
 datetime.second = (UInt16)rime.Second;

 datetime.utc_hour_offset = (short)rime.Offset.Hours;
 datetime.utc_minute_offset = (ushort)rime.Offset.Minutes;

 return datetime;
 }
 static String RandomUID()
 {
 return System.Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
 }
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 const string sn = "";
 const string key = "";

 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("Sample.pdf"))
 {
 doc.Load(null);

 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);

 {
 // Add polyline annotation
 PolyLine polyline = null;
 Annot annot = null;
 using (annot = page.AddAnnot(Annot.Type.e_PolyLine, new RectF(500, 650, 600, 700)))
 {
 PointFArray vertexe_array = new PointFArray();
 using (polyline = new PolyLine(annot))
 {
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 polyline.SetFlags(4);
 vertexe_array.Add(new foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF(515, 705));
 vertexe_array.Add(new foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF(535, 740));
 vertexe_array.Add(new foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF(565, 740));
 vertexe_array.Add(new foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF(585, 705));
 vertexe_array.Add(new foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF(565, 665));
 vertexe_array.Add(new foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF(535, 665));
 polyline.SetVertexes(vertexe_array);
 polyline.SetSubject("PolyLine");
 polyline.SetTitle("Foxit SDK");
 polyline.SetCreationDateTime(GetLocalDateTime());
 polyline.SetModifiedDateTime(GetLocalDateTime());
 polyline.SetUniqueID(RandomUID());
 // Appearance should be reset.
 polyline.ResetAppearanceStream();
 Console.WriteLine("Add a polyline annotation.");
 }
 }
 }

 // Save PDF file
 string newPdf = "newpdf.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

---

how to remove text object from pdf page
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;

using foxit.common;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 string input_file = input_path + "graphics_objects.pdf";
 using (var doc = new PDFDoc("graphics_objects.pdf"))
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load(null);

 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("The PDFDoc {0} Error: {1}", input_file, error_code);
 return;
 }
 using (var page = doc.GetPage(0))
 {
 page.StartParse((int)PDFPage.ParseFlags.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);
 long position = page.GetFirstGraphicsObjectPosition(GraphicsObject.Type.e_TypeAll);
 while (position != 0)
 {
 using (var obj = page.GetGraphicsObject(position))
 {
 if (obj.GetType() == GraphicsObject.Type.e_TypeText)
 {
 TextObject textobj = obj.GetTextObject();
 string s = textobj.GetText();
 if (s.Length > 0)
 {
 page.RemoveGraphicsObject(textobj);
 position = page.GetFirstGraphicsObjectPosition(GraphicsObject.Type.e_TypeAll);
 continue;
 }
 }
 else if (obj.GetType() == GraphicsObject.Type.e_TypeFormXObject)
 {
 FormXObject formxobj = obj.GetFormXObject();
 GraphicsObjects graphicsObjects_form = formxobj.GetGraphicsObjects();
 long pos = graphicsObjects_form.GetFirstGraphicsObjectPosition(GraphicsObject.Type.e_TypeText);
 if (pos != 0)
 {
 TextObject textobj = page.GetGraphicsObject(pos).GetTextObject();
 if (textobj.GetType() == GraphicsObject.Type.e_TypeText)
 {
 string s = textobj.GetText();
 if (s.Length > 0)
 {
 page.RemoveGraphicsObject(obj);
 position = page.GetFirstGraphicsObjectPosition(GraphicsObject.Type.e_TypeAll);
 continue;
 }
 }
 }
 }
 position = page.GetNextGraphicsObjectPosition(position, GraphicsObject.Type.e_TypeAll);
 }
 }
 page.GenerateContent();
 }
 string output_file = "graphics_objects_remove_text_objects.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(output_file, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNormal);
 }
 Console.WriteLine("Remove text objects from PDF file.");

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to ocr pdf document
using System;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.addon.ocr;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 String input_file = "AboutFoxit_ocr.pdf";
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 // "ocr_resource_path" is the path of ocr resources. Please refer to Developer Guide for more details.
 string ocr_resource_path = "";

 // Initialize OCR engine.
 error_code = OCREngine.Initialize(ocr_resource_path);
 Console.WriteLine("OCREngine is initialized.");
 // Set languages.
 OCREngine.SetLanguages("English");

 // OCR PDF document, only for search, not editable.
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 using (OCR ocr_operator = new OCR())
 {
 ErrorCode doc_error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (doc_error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("The Doc [" + input_file + "] Error: " + doc_error_code);
 return;
 }
 ocr_operator.OCRPDFDocument(doc, false);

 String save_pdf_path = "ocr_doc_searchable.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(save_pdf_path, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }

 // OCR PDF document, editable.
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 using (OCR ocr_operator = new OCR())
 {
 ErrorCode doc_error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (doc_error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("The Doc [" + input_file + "] Error: " + doc_error_code);
 return;
 }
 ocr_operator.OCRPDFDocument(doc, true);

 String save_pdf_path = "ocr_doc_editable.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(save_pdf_path, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 OCREngine.Release();

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

---

How to sign PDF using .Net SDK with an X509 certificate from Windows Certificate Store

using System;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates;
using System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;

namespace signatureCS
{

class signature
{
static foxit.common.DateTime GetLocalDateTime()
{
 System.DateTimeOffset rime = System.DateTimeOffset.Now;
 foxit.common.DateTime datetime = new foxit.common.DateTime();
 datetime.year = (UInt16)rime.Year;
 datetime.month = (UInt16)rime.Month;
 datetime.day = (ushort)rime.Day;
 datetime.hour = (UInt16)rime.Hour;
 datetime.minute = (UInt16)rime.Minute;
 datetime.second = (UInt16)rime.Second;
 datetime.utc_hour_offset = (short)rime.Offset.Hours;
 datetime.utc_minute_offset = (ushort)rime.Offset.Minutes;
 return datetime;
}
static Signature AddSiganture(PDFPage pdf_page, string sub_filter)
{
 float page_height = pdf_page.GetHeight();
 float page_width = pdf_page.GetWidth();
 RectF new_sig_rect = new RectF(0, (float)(page_height * 0.9), (float)(page_width * 0.4), page_height);
 // Add a new signature to page.
 Signature new_sig = pdf_page.AddSignature(new_sig_rect);
 if (new_sig.IsEmpty()) return null;
 // Set values for the new signature.
 new_sig.SetKeyValue(Signature.KeyName.e_KeyNameSigner, "Foxit PDF SDK");
 String new_value = String.Format("As a sample for subfilter \"{0}\"", sub_filter);
 new_sig.SetKeyValue(Signature.KeyName.e_KeyNameReason, new_value);
 new_sig.SetKeyValue(Signature.KeyName.e_KeyNameContactInfo, "support@foxitsoftware.com");
 new_sig.SetKeyValue(Signature.KeyName.e_KeyNameDN, "CN=CN,MAIL=MAIL@MAIL.COM");
 new_sig.SetKeyValue(Signature.KeyName.e_KeyNameLocation, "Fuzhou, China");
 new_value = String.Format("As a sample for subfilter \"{0}\"", sub_filter);
 new_sig.SetKeyValue(Signature.KeyName.e_KeyNameText, new_value);
 foxit.common.DateTime sign_time = GetLocalDateTime();
 new_sig.SetSignTime(sign_time);
 String image_file_path = "FoxitLogo.jpg";
 using (Image image = new Image(image_file_path))
 {
 new_sig.SetImage(image, 0);
 // Set appearance flags to decide which content would be used in appearance.
 int ap_flags = Convert.ToInt32(Signature.APFlags.e_APFlagLabel | Signature.APFlags.e_APFlagSigner |
 Signature.APFlags.e_APFlagReason | Signature.APFlags.e_APFlagDN |
 Signature.APFlags.e_APFlagLocation | Signature.APFlags.e_APFlagText |
 Signature.APFlags.e_APFlagSigningTime | Signature.APFlags.e_APFlagBitmap);
 new_sig.SetAppearanceFlags(ap_flags);
 }

 return new_sig;
}

// Callback class for signature. you can search how to define a signature callback class that inherits SignatureCallback for signing PDF using X509 certificates in the. Net SDK and Windows certificate store. in ai assistant.
static SignatureCallbackImpl sig_callback = new SignatureCallbackImpl();
static void Main(string[] args)
{
 string sn = "";
 string key = "";
 // Initialize library
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }

 try
 {
 using (PDFDoc pdf_doc = new PDFDoc("AboutFoxit.pdf"))
 {
 pdf_doc.StartLoad(null, true, null);
 using (PDFPage pdf_page = pdf_doc.GetPage(0))
 {
 string filter = "Adobe.PPKLite";

 string sub_filter = "adbe.pkcs7.sha1";
 Library.RegisterSignatureCallback(filter, sub_filter, sig_callback);
 // Add a new signature to first page.
 using (Signature new_signature = AddSiganture(pdf_page, sub_filter))
 {
 new_signature.SetFilter(filter);
 new_signature.SetSubFilter(sub_filter);
 String signed_pdf_path = "signed_newsignature.pdf";
 new_signature.StartSign("", Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes(""), Signature.DigestAlgorithm.e_DigestSHA1, signed_pdf_path, IntPtr.Zero, null);
 }
 }
 }
 }
 catch (PDFException e)
 {
 Console.WriteLine(e.Message);
 }
 Library.Release();
}
}
}

how to add bitmap watermark
using System;
using System.IO;

using foxit.common;
using foxit.pdf;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }
 const string input_file = "AboutFoxit.pdf";
 const string output_file = "watermark_add.pdf";
 using (var doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 error_code = doc.Load(null);

 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("The PDFDoc " + input_file + " Error: " + error_code);
 return;
 }
 int nCount = doc.GetPageCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < nCount; i++)
 {
 using (var page = doc.GetPage(i))
 {
 page.StartParse((int)PDFPage.ParseFlags.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);

 string wm_bmp = "watermark.bmp";
 AddBitmapWatermark(doc, page, wm_bmp);
 }
 }

 doc.SaveAs(output_file, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 Console.WriteLine("Add watermarks to PDF file.");
 }

 Library.Release();
 }

 static void AddBitmapWatermark(PDFDoc doc, PDFPage page, string bitmap_file)
 {
 using (var settings = new WatermarkSettings())
 {
 settings.flags = (int)(WatermarkSettings.Flags.e_FlagASPageContents | WatermarkSettings.Flags.e_FlagOnTop);
 settings.offset_x = 0.0f;
 settings.offset_y = 0.0f;
 settings.opacity = 60;
 settings.position = Position.e_PosCenterLeft;
 settings.rotation = 90.0f;

 using (var image = new Image(bitmap_file))
 {
 using (var bitmap = image.GetFrameBitmap(0))
 {
 settings.scale_x = page.GetHeight() * 1.0f / bitmap.Width;
 settings.scale_y = settings.scale_x;
 using (var watermark = new Watermark(doc, bitmap, settings))
 {
 watermark.InsertToPage(page);
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
}

how to flatten a pdf
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode errorCode = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (errorCode != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }

 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("annotations.pdf");
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load(null);
 // Get page count.
 int pageCount = doc.GetPageCount();
 // Flatten PDF pages.
 for (int i = 0; i < pageCount; i++)
 {
 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(i);
 // Parse page before flattening the page.
 page.StartParse((int)foxit.pdf.PDFPage.ParseFlags.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);
 // Flatten all contents of a PDF page
 page.Flatten(true, (int)PDFPage.FlattenOptions.e_FlattenAll);
 }

 string flatten_all = "annotations_flatten_all.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(flatten_all, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNormal);

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to get annotation rectangle in device coordinate system.

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using foxit;
using foxit.pdf.annots;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.annots;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace sample
{
 class sample_class
 {

 static void Main(String[] args)
 {
 // Initialize library
 string sn = "";
 string key = "";
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 Console.WriteLine("Library Initialize Error: {0}\n", error_code);
 try
 {

 // Load a document
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("input_file.pdf"))
 {
 error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }
 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);
 float width = page.GetWidth();
 float height = page.GetHeight();
 float[] bmpWidth = { width, 2 * width };
 float[] bmpheight = { height, 2 * height };
 for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
 {
 Matrix2D setMatrix = page.GetDisplayMatrix(0, 0, (int)bmpWidth[i], (int)bmpheight[i], Rotation.e_Rotation0);
 int iAnnotCount = page.GetAnnotCount();
 for (int j = 0; j < iAnnotCount; j++)
 {
 Annot pAnnot = page.GetAnnot(j);
 RectI deviceRect = pAnnot.GetDeviceRect(setMatrix);
 }
 }
 }
 }
 catch (System.Exception e)
 {
 Console.WriteLine(e.Message);
 }
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}
```

How to associate file to image object
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;
using foxit.pdf.objects;
using foxit.pdf.annots;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ".."; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ".."; // Enter the key here
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("Simple.pdf"))
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("Load document error!");
 }

 AssociatedFiles associated_files = new AssociatedFiles(doc);

 FileSpec filespec_jpg = new FileSpec(doc);
 filespec_jpg.SetAssociteFileRelationship(AssociatedFiles.Relationship.e_RelationshipSource);
 filespec_jpg.SetFileName("2.jpg");
 filespec_jpg.SetDescription("jpeg");
 filespec_jpg.Embed("2.jpg");
 using (foxit.common.DateTime dateTime = new foxit.common.DateTime(2017, 9, 15, 17, 20, 20, 0, 8, 0))
 {
 filespec_jpg.SetCreationDateTime(dateTime);
 filespec_jpg.SetModifiedDateTime(dateTime);
 filespec_jpg.SetSubtype("application/octet-stream");

 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);
 page.StartParse((int)PDFPage.ParseFlags.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);
 Int64 position = page.GetFirstGraphicsObjectPosition(GraphicsObject.Type.e_TypeImage);
 using (ImageObject image_object = page.GetGraphicsObject(position).GetImageObject())
 {
 if (image_object != null)
 {
 associated_files.AssociateFile(image_object, filespec_jpg);
 }

 string newPdf = "newPDF.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 }
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to summary annotation
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.annots;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 string sn = "";
 string key = "";

 ErrorCode code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }

 String input_file = "Annot_all.pdf";
 // Load a document
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }
 String output_file = "AnnotationSummary_generate.pdf";
 using (AnnotationSummary commentssummary = new AnnotationSummary(doc))
 {
 using (AnnotationSummarySettings settings = new AnnotationSummarySettings())
 {
 settings.SetSummaryLayout(AnnotationSummarySettings.SummaryLayout.e_SummaryLayoutSinglePageWithLine);
 settings.SetSortType(AnnotationSummarySettings.SortType.e_TypeSortByPage);
 settings.SetAnnotType(Annot.Type.e_UnknownType, true);
 settings.SetFileTitle("AnnotationSummaryFileTitle");
 settings.EnableOutputNoAnnotationPage(true);
 settings.SetConnectorLineColor(0xFFFF22);
 settings.SetConnectorLineOpacity(0.5f);
 commentssummary.StartSummarize(output_file, settings, null);
 }
 }
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to fill sign
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;

namespace fillsignCS
{
 class fillsign
 {

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 string sn = "";
 string key = "";
 // Initialize library
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }
 {
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("blank.pdf"))
 {
 error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }
 using (PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0))
 {
 page.StartParse((int)PDFPage.ParseFlags.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);
 using (FillSign fillsign = new FillSign(page))
 {
 using (FillSignObject fillsignobject = fillsign.AddObject(FillSign.FillSignObjectType.e_FillSignObjectTypeCrossMark, new PointF(0, 0), 100, 100, Rotation.e_Rotation0))
 {
 fillsignobject.GenerateContent();
 }
 using (FillSignObject fillsignobject = fillsign.AddObject(FillSign.FillSignObjectType.e_FillSignObjectTypeCheckMark, new PointF(100, 100), 50, 100, Rotation.e_Rotation0))
 {
 fillsignobject.GenerateContent();
 }
 using (FillSignObject fillsignobject = fillsign.AddObject(FillSign.FillSignObjectType.e_FillSignObjectTypeRoundRectangle, new PointF(200, 200), 100, 50, Rotation.e_Rotation0))
 {
 fillsignobject.GenerateContent();
 }
 using (FillSignObject fillsignobject = fillsign.AddObject(FillSign.FillSignObjectType.e_FillSignObjectTypeLine, new PointF(300, 300), 100, 50, Rotation.e_Rotation0))
 {
 fillsignobject.GenerateContent();
 }
 using (FillSignObject fillsignobject = fillsign.AddObject(FillSign.FillSignObjectType.e_FillSignObjectTypeDot, new PointF(400, 400), 100, 100, Rotation.e_Rotation0))
 {
 fillsignobject.GenerateContent();
 }
 using (TextFillSignObjectDataArray textdataarray = new TextFillSignObjectDataArray())
 {
 using (TextState textState = new TextState())
 {
 using (Font font = new Font(foxit.common.Font.StandardID.e_StdIDHelvetica))
 textState.font = font;
 textState.font_size = 20;
 textState.origin_position = new PointF(500, 0);
 textState.charspace = 1.0f;
 using (TextFillSignObjectData textdata = new TextFillSignObjectData(textState, "666777888"))
 textdataarray.Add(textdata);
 using (FillSignObject fillsignobject = fillsign.AddTextObject(textdataarray, new PointF(400, 100), 200, 200, Rotation.e_Rotation0, false))
 {
 fillsignobject.GenerateContent();
 }
 }
 }

 page.GenerateContent();
 doc.SaveAs("new_fillsign.pdf", (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }

 }
 }
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to flatten a pdf without annotations and form controls
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode errorCode = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (errorCode != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }

 {

 // Flatten PDF with no form control and no annotation
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("annotations.pdf"))
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess) {
 Library.Release();
 return;
 }

 // Get page count.
 int pageCount = doc.GetPageCount();
 // Flatten PDF pages.
 for (int i = 0; i < pageCount; i++)
 {
 using (PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(i))
 {
 // Parse page before flattening the page.
 page.StartParse((int)foxit.pdf.PDFPage.ParseFlags.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);
 page.Flatten(true, (int)(PDFPage.FlattenOptions.e_FlattenNoAnnot | PDFPage.FlattenOptions.e_FlattenNoFormControl));
 }
 }
 doc.SaveAs("annotations_flatten_noannotnoform.pdf", (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNormal);
 }
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to open a document including wrapper data
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Drawing.Imaging;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Drawing;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;
using foxit.pdf.objects;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void OpenWrapperFile(String file_name)
 {
 String file_info = "Wrapperinfo.txt";

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(file_name))
 {
 ErrorCode code = doc.Load(null);
 if (code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }
 if (!doc.IsWrapper())
 {
 return;
 }
 long offset = doc.GetWrapperOffset();
 }

 }

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }

 String input_file = "wrapper.pdf";
 // Load PDF document.
 using (PDFDoc doc_wrapper = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 error_code = doc_wrapper.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Library.Release();
 return;
 }
 // Save the PDF document as a wrapper file.
 using (WrapperData wrapperData = new WrapperData(10, "Foxit", "Foxit", "www.foxitsoftware.com", "foxit"))
 {
 String output_file = "AboutFoxit_wrapper.pdf";
 using (PDFDoc doc_real = new PDFDoc("AboutFoxit.pdf"))
 {
 error_code = doc_real.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Library.Release();
 return;
 }
 doc_real.SaveAs(output_file, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNormal);

 // "0xFFFFFFFC" can be changed to other values defined in enumeration FSUserPermissions.
 int flag = (int)Convert.ToUInt32(0xFFFFFFFC);
 doc_wrapper.SaveAsWrapperFile(output_file, wrapperData, flag, "");
 // Open the wrapper file.
 OpenWrapperFile(output_file);
 Console.WriteLine("Add wrapper to PDF file.");

 output_file = "AboutFoxit_payloadfile.pdf";
 doc_wrapper.StartSaveAsPayloadFile(output_file, "AboutFoxit.pdf", "Unknown", "no_description", 1.0f, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagIncremental, null);

 Console.WriteLine("Save as payload file.");
 }
 }
 }
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

---

how to compare two pdf documents and marked the difference of replace type
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.annots;
using foxit.addon;
using foxit.addon.comparison;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static void CreateSquigglyRect(PDFPage page, RectFArray rects, int color, String csContents, String csType, String csObjType)
 {
 int rectSize = rects.GetSize();
 if (rectSize == 0) return;
 using (Annot annot = page.AddAnnot(Annot.Type.e_Squiggly, new RectF()))
 {
 Squiggly squiggly = new Squiggly(annot);
 squiggly.SetContent(csContents);

 QuadPointsArray quad_points_array = new QuadPointsArray();
 for (int i = 0; i < rectSize; i++)
 {
 RectF item = rects.GetAt(i);
 QuadPoints quad_points = new QuadPoints();
 quad_points.first = new foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF(item.left, item.top);
 quad_points.second = new foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF(item.right, item.top);
 quad_points.third = new foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF(item.left, item.bottom);
 quad_points.fourth = new foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF(item.right, item.bottom);
 quad_points_array.Add(quad_points);
 }
 squiggly.SetQuadPoints(quad_points_array);

 squiggly.SetBorderColor(color);
 squiggly.SetSubject(csObjType);
 squiggly.SetTitle(csType);

 squiggly.ResetAppearanceStream();
 squiggly.Dispose();
 }
 }

 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 // Initialize library
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 {
 using (PDFDoc base_doc = new PDFDoc("test_base.pdf"))
 {
 error_code = base_doc.Load(null);

 using (PDFDoc compared_doc = new PDFDoc("test_compared.pdf"))
 {
 error_code = compared_doc.Load(null);

 using (Comparison comparison = new Comparison(base_doc, compared_doc))
 {
 CompareResults result = comparison.DoCompare(0, 0, (int)Comparison.CompareType.e_CompareTypeText);
 CompareResultInfoArray oldInfo = result.base_doc_results;
 CompareResultInfoArray newInfo = result.compared_doc_results;
 uint oldInfoSize = oldInfo.GetSize();
 uint newInfoSize = newInfo.GetSize();

 using (PDFPage page1 = base_doc.GetPage(0))
 {
 for (uint i = 0; i < oldInfoSize; i++)
 {
 CompareResultInfo item = oldInfo.GetAt(i);
 CompareResultInfo.CompareResultType type = item.type;
 if (type == CompareResultInfo.CompareResultType.e_CompareResultTypeReplaceText)
 {
 String res_string = String.Format("[New]: \"{0}\"\r\n[Old]: \"{1}\"", newInfo.GetAt(i).diff_contents, item.diff_contents);
 CreateSquigglyRect(page1, item.rect_array, 0xe7651a, res_string, "Compare : Replace", "Text");
 }
 }
 }
 base_doc.SaveAs("old.pdf", (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNormal);

 using (PDFDoc new_doc = comparison.GenerateComparedDoc((int)Comparison.CompareType.e_CompareTypeAll))
 {
 new_doc.SaveAs("generate_result.pdf", (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNormal);
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to load annotations from a FDF file and add them into the first page of a given PDF
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 // Import FDF file
 string input_file = "AboutFoxit.pdf";
 string fdf_file = "AnnotationData.fdf";
 using (PDFDoc pdf_doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = pdf_doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("The Doc [{0}] Error: {1}\n", input_file, error_code);
 Library.Release();
 return;
 }
 using (foxit.fdf.FDFDoc fdf_doc = new foxit.fdf.FDFDoc(fdf_file))
 {
 pdf_doc.ImportFromFDF(fdf_doc, (int)foxit.pdf.PDFDoc.DataType.e_Annots, new Range());
 Console.WriteLine("Import annotations from fdf with file.\n");
 string output_file = "AboutFoxit_importFDF.pdf";
 pdf_doc.SaveAs(output_file, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 }
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

How to add a square annotation
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;
using foxit.pdf.annots;
using foxit.pdf.actions;
using foxit.pdf.objects;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static foxit.common.DateTime GetLocalDateTime()
 {
 System.DateTimeOffset rime = System.DateTimeOffset.Now;
 foxit.common.DateTime datetime = new foxit.common.DateTime();
 datetime.year = (UInt16)rime.Year;
 datetime.month = (UInt16)rime.Month;
 datetime.day = (ushort)rime.Day;
 datetime.hour = (UInt16)rime.Hour;
 datetime.minute = (UInt16)rime.Minute;
 datetime.second = (UInt16)rime.Second;

 datetime.utc_hour_offset = (short)rime.Offset.Hours;
 datetime.utc_minute_offset = (ushort)rime.Offset.Minutes;

 return datetime;
 }
 static String RandomUID()
 {
 return System.Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
 }
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 const string sn = "";
 const string key = "";

 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("Sample.pdf"))
 {
 doc.Load(null);

 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);
 {
 // Add square annotation
 Square square = null;
 Annot annot = null;
 using (annot = page.AddAnnot(Annot.Type.e_Square, new RectF(200, 650, 300, 750)))
 using (square = new Square(annot))
 {
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 square.SetFlags(4);
 square.SetFillColor(0x00FF00);
 square.SetInnerRect(new RectF(220, 660, 260, 740));
 square.SetSubject("Square");
 square.SetTitle("Foxit SDK");
 square.SetCreationDateTime(GetLocalDateTime());
 square.SetModifiedDateTime(GetLocalDateTime());
 square.SetUniqueID(RandomUID());
 // Appearance should be reset.
 square.ResetAppearanceStream();
 Console.WriteLine("Add a square annotation.");
 }
 }

 // Save PDF file
 string newPdf = "newpdf.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

---

how to verify pdf file is converted to be PDFA-1a version
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.IO;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.addon.compliance;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 // "compliance_resource_folder_path" is the path of compliance resource folder. Please refer to Developer Guide for more details.
 string compliance_resource_folder_path = "";
 // If you use an authorization key for Foxit PDF SDK, please set a valid unlock code string to compliance_engine_unlockcode for ComplianceEngine.
 // If you use an trial key for Foxit PDF SDK, just keep compliance_engine_unlockcode as an empty string.
 string compliance_engine_unlockcode = "";

 if (compliance_resource_folder_path.Length < 1)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("compliance_resource_folder_path is still empty. Please set it with a valid path to compliance resource folder path.");
 return;
 }
 // Initialize compliance engine.
 ErrorCode error_code = ComplianceEngine.Initialize(compliance_resource_folder_path, compliance_engine_unlockcode);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 switch (error_code)
 {
 case ErrorCode.e_ErrInvalidLicense:
 Console.WriteLine("[Failed] Compliance module is not contained in current Foxit PDF SDK keys.");
 break;
 default:
 Console.WriteLine("[Failed] Fail to initialize compliance engine. Error: {0}", error_code);
 break;
 }
 return;
 }
 Console.WriteLine("ComplianceEngine is initialized.");
 string input_file = "AboutFoxit.pdf";
 using (PDFACompliance pdfa_compliance = new PDFACompliance())
 {
 // Verify converted result PDF file, which is expected to be PDFA-1a version.
 Console.WriteLine("======== PDFACompliance: Verify after convert ========");
 ResultInformation verify_result_info = pdfa_compliance.Verify(PDFACompliance.Version.e_VersionPDFA1a, input_file, 0, -1, null);
 ComplianceEngine.Release();
 }
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to verify pdfa 1a version
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.IO;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.addon.compliance;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 string sn = "";
 string key = "";

 Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 string compliance_resource_folder_path = "";
 string compliance_engine_unlockcode = "";

 ErrorCode code = ComplianceEngine.Initialize(compliance_resource_folder_path, compliance_engine_unlockcode);
 if (code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 switch (code)
 {
 case ErrorCode.e_ErrInvalidLicense:
 Console.WriteLine("[Failed] Compliance module is not contained in current Foxit PDF SDK keys.");
 break;
 default:
 Console.WriteLine("[Failed] Fail to initialize compliance engine. Error: {0}", code);
 break;
 }
 return;
 }
 Console.WriteLine("ComplianceEngine is initialized.");

 PDFACompliance pdfa_compliance = new PDFACompliance();
 {
 // Verify PDF file.
 ResultInformation verify_result_info = pdfa_compliance.Verify(PDFACompliance.Version.e_VersionPDFA1a, "AboutFoxit.pdf", 0, -1, null);
 }

 ComplianceEngine.Release();
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

How to associate file to catalog dictionary
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;
using foxit.pdf.objects;
using foxit.pdf.annots;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 const string sn = "";
 const string key = "";

 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("Simple.pdf"))
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("Load document error!");
 }

 AssociatedFiles associated_files = new AssociatedFiles(doc);

 // Create filespec with 1.txt
 FileSpec filespec_txt = new FileSpec(doc);
 filespec_txt.SetAssociteFileRelationship(AssociatedFiles.Relationship.e_RelationshipSource);
 filespec_txt.SetFileName("1.txt");
 using (foxit.common.DateTime dateTime = new foxit.common.DateTime(2017, 9, 15, 17, 20, 20, 0, 8, 0))
 {
 filespec_txt.SetDescription("text");
 filespec_txt.Embed("1.txt");
 filespec_txt.SetCreationDateTime(dateTime);
 filespec_txt.SetModifiedDateTime(dateTime);
 filespec_txt.SetSubtype("application/octet-stream");

 // Associate 1.txt with catalog dictionary.
 PDFObject catalog_dict = doc.GetCatalog();
 associated_files.AssociateFile(catalog_dict, filespec_txt);

 string newPdf = "newPDF.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

How to use Foxit PDF SDK to add table of contents to PDF file.

using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
namespace sample
{
 class sample_class
 {

 static void Main(String[] args)
 {
 // Initialize library
 string sn = "";
 string key = "";
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 Console.WriteLine("Library Initialize Error: {0}\n", error_code);
 try
 {
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("Bookmark.pdf"))
 {
 error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Library.Release();
 return;
 }
 int depth = doc.GetBookmarkLevelDepth();
 using (TableOfContentsConfig toc_config = new TableOfContentsConfig())
 {
 toc_config.title = "Table of Contents";
 toc_config.is_show_serial_number = true;
 toc_config.include_toc_pages = false;
 using (Int32Array bookmark_level_array = new Int32Array())
 {
 for (int i = 0; i < depth; i++)
 {
 bookmark_level_array.Add(i);
 }
 toc_config.bookmark_level_array = bookmark_level_array;
 doc.AddTableOfContents(toc_config);
 }
 }
 doc.SaveAs("TOC.pdf", (int)foxit.pdf.PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNormal);
 }
 }
 catch (System.Exception e)
 {
 Console.WriteLine(e.Message);
 }
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to Verify PDFA file
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.IO;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.addon.compliance;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 // "compliance_resource_folder_path" is the path of compliance resource folder. Please refer to Developer Guide for more details.
 string compliance_resource_folder_path = "";
 // If you use an authorization key for Foxit PDF SDK, please set a valid unlock code string to compliance_engine_unlockcode for ComplianceEngine.
 // If you use an trial key for Foxit PDF SDK, just keep compliance_engine_unlockcode as an empty string.
 string compliance_engine_unlockcode = "";

 if (compliance_resource_folder_path.Length < 1)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("compliance_resource_folder_path is still empty. Please set it with a valid path to compliance resource folder path.");
 return;
 }
 // Initialize compliance engine.
 ErrorCode error_code = ComplianceEngine.Initialize(compliance_resource_folder_path, compliance_engine_unlockcode);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 switch (error_code)
 {
 case ErrorCode.e_ErrInvalidLicense:
 Console.WriteLine("[Failed] Compliance module is not contained in current Foxit PDF SDK keys.");
 break;
 default:
 Console.WriteLine("[Failed] Fail to initialize compliance engine. Error: {0}", error_code);
 break;
 }
 return;
 }
 Console.WriteLine("ComplianceEngine is initialized.");
 string input_file = "AboutFoxit.pdf";
 using (PDFACompliance pdfa_compliance = new PDFACompliance())
 {
 // Verify original PDF file.
 Console.WriteLine("======== PDFACompliance: Verify ========");
 ResultInformation verify_result_info = pdfa_compliance.Verify(PDFACompliance.Version.e_VersionPDFA1a, input_file, 0, -1, null);
 ComplianceEngine.Release();
 }
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

How to export attachment file
using System;
using System.Text;
using System.IO;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.objects;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ".."; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ".."; // Enter the key here
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("Simple.pdf"))
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("Load document error!");
 }

 using (Attachments attachments = new Attachments(doc, new PDFNameTree()))
 {
 int count = attachments.GetCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
 {
 string key = attachments.GetKey(i);
 FileSpec file_spec = attachments.GetEmbeddedFile(key);
 if (!file_spec.IsEmpty())
 {
 string name = file_spec.GetFileName();

 if (file_spec.IsEmbedded())
 file_spec.ExportToFile(name);
 }
 }
 }
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to add image watermark
using System;
using System.IO;

using foxit.common;
using foxit.pdf;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }
 const string input_file = "AboutFoxit.pdf";
 const string output_file = "watermark_add.pdf";
 using (var doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 error_code = doc.Load(null);

 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("The PDFDoc " + input_file + " Error: " + error_code);
 return;
 }
 int nCount = doc.GetPageCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < nCount; i++)
 {
 using (var page = doc.GetPage(i))
 {
 page.StartParse((int)PDFPage.ParseFlags.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);

 string wm_image = "sdk.png";
 AddImageWatermark(doc, page, wm_image);
 }
 }

 doc.SaveAs(output_file, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 Console.WriteLine("Add watermarks to PDF file.");
 }

 Library.Release();
 }

 static void AddImageWatermark(PDFDoc doc, PDFPage page, string image_file)
 {
 using (var settings = new WatermarkSettings())
 {
 settings.flags = (int)(WatermarkSettings.Flags.e_FlagASPageContents | WatermarkSettings.Flags.e_FlagOnTop);
 settings.offset_x = 0.0f;
 settings.offset_y = 0.0f;
 settings.opacity = 20;
 settings.position = Position.e_PosCenter;
 settings.rotation = 0.0f;

 using (var image = new Image(image_file))
 {
 using (var bitmap = image.GetFrameBitmap(0))
 {
 settings.scale_x = page.GetWidth() * 0.618f / bitmap.Width;
 settings.scale_y = settings.scale_x;

 using (var watermark = new Watermark(doc, image, 0, settings))
 {
 watermark.InsertToPage(page);
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
}

how to get original shading objects from PDF page
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;
using foxit.pdf.objects;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 string input_file = "AboutFoxit.pdf";

 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(input_file);
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load(null);

 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Library.Release();
 return;
 }

 // Get original shading objects from PDF page.
 PDFPage original_page = doc.GetPage(0);
 original_page.StartParse((int)PDFPage.ParseFlags.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);
 long position = original_page.GetFirstGraphicsObjectPosition(GraphicsObject.Type.e_TypeShading);
 if (position == 0)
 {
 return;
 }
 ShadingObject black_pieces = (ShadingObject)original_page.GetGraphicsObject(position);
 position = original_page.GetNextGraphicsObjectPosition(position, GraphicsObject.Type.e_TypeShading);
 ShadingObject white_pieces = (ShadingObject)original_page.GetGraphicsObject(position);

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}
