How to add a underline annotation
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;
using foxit.pdf.annots;
using foxit.pdf.actions;
using foxit.pdf.objects;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static foxit.common.DateTime GetLocalDateTime()
 {
 System.DateTimeOffset rime = System.DateTimeOffset.Now;
 foxit.common.DateTime datetime = new foxit.common.DateTime();
 datetime.year = (UInt16)rime.Year;
 datetime.month = (UInt16)rime.Month;
 datetime.day = (ushort)rime.Day;
 datetime.hour = (UInt16)rime.Hour;
 datetime.minute = (UInt16)rime.Minute;
 datetime.second = (UInt16)rime.Second;

 datetime.utc_hour_offset = (short)rime.Offset.Hours;
 datetime.utc_minute_offset = (ushort)rime.Offset.Minutes;

 return datetime;
 }

 static String RandomUID()
 {
 return System.Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
 }
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 const string sn = "";
 const string key = "";

 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 int err_ret = 0;

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("Sample.pdf"))
 {
 doc.Load(null);

 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);

 {
 // Add underline annotation.
 Underline underline = null;
 Annot annot = null;
 using (annot = page.AddAnnot(Annot.Type.e_Underline, new RectF(100, 450, 200, 550)))
 using (underline = new Underline(annot))
 using (QuadPoints quad_points = new QuadPoints())
 using (quad_points.first = new foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF(110, 500))
 using (quad_points.second = new foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF(190, 500))
 using (quad_points.third = new foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF(110, 480))
 using (quad_points.fourth = new foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF(190, 480))
 using (QuadPointsArray quad_points_array = new QuadPointsArray())
 {
 quad_points_array.Add(quad_points);
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 underline.SetFlags(4);
 underline.SetQuadPoints(quad_points_array);
 underline.SetSubject("Underline");
 underline.SetTitle("Foxit SDK");
 underline.SetCreationDateTime(GetLocalDateTime());
 underline.SetModifiedDateTime(GetLocalDateTime());
 underline.SetUniqueID(RandomUID());
 // Appearance should be reset.
 underline.ResetAppearanceStream();
 Console.WriteLine("Add a underline annotation.");
 }
 }

 // Save PDF file
 string newPdf = "newpdf.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Drawing;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Environment.Exit(1);
 }

 // create layer tree
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("AboutFoxit.pdf"))
 {
 error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Library.Release();
 return;
 }

 bool has_layer = doc.HasLayer();
 using (LayerTree layertree = new LayerTree(doc))
 {
 has_layer = doc.HasLayer();
 using (LayerNode root = layertree.GetRootNode())
 {
 if (root.IsEmpty())
 {
 Console.WriteLine("No layer information!\r\n");
 Library.Release();
 return;
 }
 int children_count = root.GetChildrenCount();

 using (LayerNode child = root.AddChild(0, "AddedLayerNode", true))
 {
 using (root.AddChild(0, "AddedNode", false)) { }
 doc.SaveAs("create_layer_tree.pdf", (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }

how to convert pdf file to text file
using System;
using System.IO;

using foxit.common;
using foxit.pdf;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here
 const string text_name = "AboutFoxit.txt";
 const string input_file = "AboutFoxit.pdf";

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }

 using (var doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("The PDFDoc " + input_file + " Error: " + error_code);
 return;
 }
 using (var writer = new StreamWriter(text_name, false, System.Text.Encoding.Unicode))
 {
 // Get page count
 int pageCount = doc.GetPageCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < pageCount; i++)
 {
 using (var page = doc.GetPage(i))
 {
 // Parse page
 page.StartParse((int)PDFPage.ParseFlags.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);
 // Get the text select object.
 using (var text_select = new TextPage(page, (int)TextPage.TextParseFlags.e_ParseTextNormal))
 {
 int count = text_select.GetCharCount();
 if (count > 0)
 {
 String chars = text_select.GetChars(0, count);
 writer.Write(chars);
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to optimize PDF files by compressing images
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.IO;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;
using foxit.pdf.objects;
using foxit.addon;
using foxit.addon.optimization;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 string input_file = "ImageCompression.pdf";
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }
 using (OptimizerSettings settings = new OptimizerSettings())
 {
 settings.SetOptimizerOptions((int)foxit.addon.optimization.OptimizerSettings.OptimizerOptions.e_OptimizerCompressImages);
 Progressive progressive = Optimizer.Optimize(doc, settings, null);
 Progressive.State progress_state = Progressive.State.e_ToBeContinued;
 while (Progressive.State.e_ToBeContinued == progress_state)
 {
 progress_state = progressive.Continue();
 int percent = progressive.GetRateOfProgress();
 Console.WriteLine("Optimize progress percent: {0}%", percent);
 }
 if (Progressive.State.e_Finished == progress_state)
 {
 doc.SaveAs("ImageCompression_Optimized.pdf", (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagRemoveRedundantObjects);
 }
 }
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to add page label
using System;
using System.IO;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }

 {
 // gif file convert to pdf
 string input_file = "page_labels.pdf";
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Library.Release();
 return;
 }

 // Add new page labels
 using (PageLabels page_labels = new PageLabels(doc))
 {
 page_labels.RemoveAll();
 String pdf_removeall = "removeall_page_labels.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(pdf_removeall, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);

 int count = doc.GetPageCount();
 if (count > 0)
 {
 page_labels.SetPageLabel(0, PageLabels.Style.e_UpperRomanNums, 1, "Cover-");
 }
 if (count > 1)
 {
 page_labels.SetPageLabel(1, PageLabels.Style.e_LowerRomanNums, 1, "Catolog-");
 }
 if (count > 2)
 {
 page_labels.SetPageLabel(2, PageLabels.Style.e_DecimalNums, 1, "Contents-");
 }
 if (count > 5)
 {
 page_labels.SetPageLabel(count - 1, PageLabels.Style.e_UpperLetters, 1, "Appendix-");
 }
 String pdf_new = "new_page_labels.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(pdf_new, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 }
 Console.WriteLine("PDFPage label test.");
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

---

how to verify PADES signature
using System;
using System.Text;

using foxit.common;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.objects;
using foxit;
using foxit.pdf.annots;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf.interform;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = "";
 static string key = "";
 static void PAdESVerify(string check_pdf_path, Signature.PAdESLevel expect_pades_level)
 {
 using (PDFDoc check_pdf_doc = new PDFDoc(check_pdf_path))
 {
 check_pdf_doc.StartLoad(null, true, null);
 Console.WriteLine("To verify level of PAdES signature in file{0}", check_pdf_path);

 int sig_count = check_pdf_doc.GetSignatureCount();
 if (0 == sig_count)
 Console.WriteLine("No signature in current PDF file.");
 bool has_cades_signature = false;
 for (int i = 0; i < check_pdf_doc.GetSignatureCount(); i++)
 {
 using (Signature temp_sig = check_pdf_doc.GetSignature(i))
 {
 if (temp_sig.IsEmpty()) continue;
 uint sig_org_state = temp_sig.GetState();
 bool is_true = (sig_org_state & Convert.ToUInt32(Signature.States.e_StateSigned)) > 0;
 if (!is_true) continue;
 if (temp_sig.GetSubFilter() == "ETSI.CAdES.detached")
 {
 has_cades_signature = true;
 // Verify PAdES signature.
 using (Progressive verify_progressive = temp_sig.StartVerify(IntPtr.Zero, null))
 {
 if (100 != verify_progressive.GetRateOfProgress())
 {
 if (Progressive.State.e_Finished != verify_progressive.Continue())
 {
 Console.WriteLine("[Failed] Fail to verify a PAdES signature. Signature index:{0}", i);
 continue;
 }
 }
 }
 uint sig_state = temp_sig.GetState();

 // Get PAdES level.
 Signature.PAdESLevel actual_level = temp_sig.GetPAdESLevel();
 Console.WriteLine("Signature index:{0}, PAdES level:{1}, {2}",
 i, actual_level,
 actual_level == expect_pades_level ? "matching expected level." : "NOT match expected level.");
 }
 }
 }
 if (false == has_cades_signature)
 Console.WriteLine("No PAdES signature in current PDF file.");
 }
 }

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 {
 TimeStampServerMgr.Initialize();

 PAdESVerify("AboutFoxit.pdf", Signature.PAdESLevel.e_PAdESLevelBB);

 TimeStampServerMgr.Release();
 }
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

---

how to import page use optimized way
using System;
using System.IO;

using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 public static void ImportPageOptimized()
 {
 string file_dest = "page_organization_123.pdf";
 string file_src = "page_organization_abc.pdf";
 string file_temp = "page_organization_import_extracted_pages.pdf";

 ErrorCode code;
 using (var doc_src = new PDFDoc(file_src))
 {
 code = doc_src.Load(null);
 if (code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("The PDFDoc {0} Error: {1}", file_src, code);
 return;
 }
 // Extract pages to temporary document
 Range import_ranges = new Range(0);
 import_ranges.AddSingle(doc_src.GetPageCount() - 1);
 using (var progressive = doc_src.StartExtractPages(file_temp, (int)PDFDoc.ExtractPagesOptions.e_ExtractPagesOptionAnnotation, import_ranges, null))
 {
 while (progressive.Continue() != Progressive.State.e_Finished)
 {
 }
 }
 }

 using (var doc_temp = new PDFDoc(file_temp))
 {
 code = doc_temp.Load(null);
 if (code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("The PDFDoc {0} Error: {1}", file_temp, code);
 return;
 }

 using (var doc_dest = new PDFDoc(file_dest))
 {
 code = doc_dest.Load(null);
 if (code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("The PDFDoc {0} Error: {1}", file_dest, code);
 return;
 }
 // Insert temporary document into destination
 doc_dest.InsertDocument(-1, doc_temp, (int)PDFDoc.InsertDocOptions.e_InsertDocOptionAttachments);
 string output_file = "abc_to_123_insert_document.pdf";
 doc_dest.SaveAs(output_file, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNormal);
 }
 }
 Console.WriteLine("Import pages optimized.");
 }

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }
 ImportPageOptimized();
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

How to associate file to FormX object
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.graphics;
using foxit.pdf.objects;
using foxit.pdf.annots;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ".."; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ".."; // Enter the key here
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("Simple.pdf"))
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("Load document error!");
 }

 AssociatedFiles associated_files = new AssociatedFiles(doc);

 FileSpec filespec_jpg = new FileSpec(doc);
 filespec_jpg.SetAssociteFileRelationship(AssociatedFiles.Relationship.e_RelationshipSource);
 filespec_jpg.SetFileName("2.jpg");
 filespec_jpg.SetDescription("jpeg");
 filespec_jpg.Embed("2.jpg");
 using (foxit.common.DateTime dateTime = new foxit.common.DateTime(2017, 9, 15, 17, 20, 20, 0, 8, 0))
 {
 filespec_jpg.SetCreationDateTime(dateTime);
 filespec_jpg.SetModifiedDateTime(dateTime);
 filespec_jpg.SetSubtype("application/octet-stream");

 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);
 page.StartParse((int)PDFPage.ParseFlags.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);
 Int64 position = page.GetFirstGraphicsObjectPosition(GraphicsObject.Type.e_TypeFormXObject);
 using (FormXObject form_x_object = page.GetGraphicsObject(position).GetFormXObject())
 {
 if (form_x_object != null)
 {
 associated_files.AssociateFile(form_x_object, filespec_jpg);
 Console.WriteLine("Associate a jpeg file with form xobject.");

 using (FileSpec filespec_form_x_object = associated_files.GetAssociatedFile(form_x_object.GetStream().GetDictionary(), 0))
 {
 filespec_form_x_object.ExportToFile("form_x_object.jpg");
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to convert html page to pdf
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static String url_or_html = "AboutFoxit.html";
 // "engine_path" is the path of the engine file "fxhtml2pdf" which is used to convert html to pdf. Please refer to Developer Guide for more details.
 static String engine_path = "";
 // "cookies_path" is the path of the cookies file exported from the web pages that you want to convert. Please refer to Developer Guide for more details.
 static String cookies_path = "";
 static String output_path = "html2pdf_result.pdf";
 static int time_out = 15;

 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 {
 foxit.addon.conversion.HTML2PDFSettingData pdf_setting_data = new foxit.addon.conversion.HTML2PDFSettingData();
 pdf_setting_data.scaling_mode = foxit.addon.conversion.HTML2PDFSettingData.HTML2PDFScalingMode.e_ScalingModeScale;
 pdf_setting_data.is_convert_link = true;
 pdf_setting_data.is_generate_tag = true;
 pdf_setting_data.to_generate_bookmarks = true;
 pdf_setting_data.rotate_degrees = 0;
 pdf_setting_data.page_height = 640;
 pdf_setting_data.page_width = 900;
 pdf_setting_data.page_mode = foxit.addon.conversion.HTML2PDFSettingData.HTML2PDFPageMode.e_PageModeSinglePage;
 pdf_setting_data.to_print_background = true;
 pdf_setting_data.to_optimize_tag_tree = false;
 pdf_setting_data.media_style = foxit.addon.conversion.HTML2PDFSettingData.HTML2PDFMediaStyle.e_MediaStyleScreen;
 foxit.addon.conversion.Convert.FromHTML(url_or_html, engine_path, cookies_path, pdf_setting_data, output_path, time_out);

 Console.WriteLine("Convert HTML to PDF successfully.");
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

How to add a freetext annotation as textbox
using System;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.pdf.annots;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static foxit.common.DateTime GetLocalDateTime()
 {
 System.DateTimeOffset rime = System.DateTimeOffset.Now;
 foxit.common.DateTime datetime = new foxit.common.DateTime();
 datetime.year = (UInt16)rime.Year;
 datetime.month = (UInt16)rime.Month;
 datetime.day = (ushort)rime.Day;
 datetime.hour = (UInt16)rime.Hour;
 datetime.minute = (UInt16)rime.Minute;
 datetime.second = (UInt16)rime.Second;

 datetime.utc_hour_offset = (short)rime.Offset.Hours;
 datetime.utc_minute_offset = (ushort)rime.Offset.Minutes;

 return datetime;
 }
 static String RandomUID()
 {
 return System.Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
 }
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 const string sn = "";
 const string key = "";

 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 ErrorCode error_code = ErrorCode.e_ErrUnknown;

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("Sample.pdf"))
 {
 doc.Load(null);
 PDFPage page = doc.GetPage(0);

 {
 // Add freetext annotation, as text box.
 FreeText freetext = null;
 Annot annot = null;
 using (annot = page.AddAnnot(Annot.Type.e_FreeText, new RectF(450, 550, 550, 600)))
 using (freetext = new FreeText(annot))
 // Set default appearance
 using (DefaultAppearance default_ap = new DefaultAppearance())
 {
 default_ap.flags = (int)DefaultAppearance.DefAPFlags.e_FlagFont | (int)DefaultAppearance.DefAPFlags.e_FlagFontSize | (int)DefaultAppearance.DefAPFlags.e_FlagTextColor;
 using (default_ap.font = new foxit.common.Font(foxit.common.Font.StandardID.e_StdIDHelveticaI))
 {
 default_ap.text_size = 12.0f;
 default_ap.text_color = 0x000000;
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 freetext.SetFlags(4);
 freetext.SetDefaultAppearance(default_ap);
 freetext.SetContent("A text box annotation.");
 freetext.SetSubject("Textbox");
 freetext.SetTitle("Foxit SDK");
 freetext.SetCreationDateTime(GetLocalDateTime());
 freetext.SetModifiedDateTime(GetLocalDateTime());
 freetext.SetUniqueID(RandomUID());
 // Appearance should be reset.
 freetext.ResetAppearanceStream();
 Console.WriteLine("Add a text box freetext annotation.");
 }
 }
 }

 // Save PDF file
 string newPdf = "newpdf.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(newPdf, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to Convert PDF file to PDFA-1a version
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.IO;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.addon.compliance;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 // "compliance_resource_folder_path" is the path of compliance resource folder. Please refer to Developer Guide for more details.
 string compliance_resource_folder_path = "";
 // If you use an authorization key for Foxit PDF SDK, please set a valid unlock code string to compliance_engine_unlockcode for ComplianceEngine.
 // If you use an trial key for Foxit PDF SDK, just keep compliance_engine_unlockcode as an empty string.
 string compliance_engine_unlockcode = "";

 if (compliance_resource_folder_path.Length < 1)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("compliance_resource_folder_path is still empty. Please set it with a valid path to compliance resource folder path.");
 return;
 }
 // Initialize compliance engine.
 ErrorCode error_code = ComplianceEngine.Initialize(compliance_resource_folder_path, compliance_engine_unlockcode);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 switch (error_code)
 {
 case ErrorCode.e_ErrInvalidLicense:
 Console.WriteLine("[Failed] Compliance module is not contained in current Foxit PDF SDK keys.");
 break;
 default:
 Console.WriteLine("[Failed] Fail to initialize compliance engine. Error: {0}", error_code);
 break;
 }
 return;
 }
 Console.WriteLine("ComplianceEngine is initialized.");

 using (PDFACompliance pdfa_compliance = new PDFACompliance())
 {
 string input_file = "AF_ImageXObject_FormXObject.pdf";
 string save_pdf_path = "pdfacompliance_convert_to_pdf1a.pdf";
 // Convert original PDF file to PDFA-1a version.
 Console.WriteLine("======== PDFACompliance: Convert ========");

 ResultInformation convert_result_info = pdfa_compliance.ConvertPDFFile(input_file, save_pdf_path,
 PDFACompliance.Version.e_VersionPDFA1a,
 null);
 ComplianceEngine.Release();
 }
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

---

how to compare two pdf documents and marked the difference of delete type
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.annots;
using foxit.addon;
using foxit.addon.comparison;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {

 static void CreateDeleteText(PDFPage page, RectFArray rects, int color, String csContents, String csType, String csObjType)
 {
 int rectSize = rects.GetSize();
 if (rectSize == 0) return;
 using (Annot annot = page.AddAnnot(Annot.Type.e_StrikeOut, new RectF()))
 {
 StrikeOut strikeout = new StrikeOut(annot);
 strikeout.SetContent(csContents);

 QuadPointsArray quad_points_array = new QuadPointsArray();

 for (int i = 0; i < rectSize; i++)
 {
 RectF item = rects.GetAt(i);
 QuadPoints quad_points = new QuadPoints();
 quad_points.first = new foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF(item.left, item.top);
 quad_points.second = new foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF(item.right, item.top);
 quad_points.third = new foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF(item.left, item.bottom);
 quad_points.fourth = new foxit.common.fxcrt.PointF(item.right, item.bottom);
 quad_points_array.Add(quad_points);
 }
 strikeout.SetQuadPoints(quad_points_array);

 strikeout.SetBorderColor(color);
 strikeout.SetSubject(csObjType);
 strikeout.SetTitle(csType);

 strikeout.ResetAppearanceStream();
 strikeout.Dispose();
 }
 }

 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 // Initialize library
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 {
 using (PDFDoc base_doc = new PDFDoc("test_base.pdf"))
 {
 error_code = base_doc.Load(null);

 using (PDFDoc compared_doc = new PDFDoc("test_compared.pdf"))
 {
 error_code = compared_doc.Load(null);

 using (Comparison comparison = new Comparison(base_doc, compared_doc))
 {
 CompareResults result = comparison.DoCompare(0, 0, (int)Comparison.CompareType.e_CompareTypeText);
 CompareResultInfoArray oldInfo = result.base_doc_results;
 CompareResultInfoArray newInfo = result.compared_doc_results;
 uint oldInfoSize = oldInfo.GetSize();
 uint newInfoSize = newInfo.GetSize();

 using (PDFPage page1 = base_doc.GetPage(0))
 {
 for (uint i = 0; i < oldInfoSize; i++)
 {
 CompareResultInfo item = oldInfo.GetAt(i);
 CompareResultInfo.CompareResultType type = item.type;
 if (type == CompareResultInfo.CompareResultType.e_CompareResultTypeDeleteText)
 {
 String res_string = String.Format("\"{0}\"", item.diff_contents);
 CreateDeleteText(page1, item.rect_array, 0xff0000, res_string, "Compare : Delete", "Text");
 }
 }
 }

 base_doc.SaveAs("old.pdf", (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNormal);

 using (PDFDoc new_doc = comparison.GenerateComparedDoc((int)Comparison.CompareType.e_CompareTypeAll))
 {
 new_doc.SaveAs("generate_result.pdf", (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNormal);
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

---

How to async load pdf document
using System;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.common;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 struct DownloadHintDataInfo
 {
 public DownloadHintDataInfo(long offset, long size, bool is_downloaded)
 {
 this.offset = offset;
 this.size = size;
 this.is_downloaded = is_downloaded;
 }
 public long offset;
 public long size;
 public bool is_downloaded;
 }

 class AsyncFileRead : AsyncReaderCallback
 {
 private List<DownloadHintDataInfo> hint_data_record_;
 private FILE file_;
 private bool is_large_file_;

 public AsyncFileRead()
 {
 hint_data_record_ = new List<DownloadHintDataInfo>();
 file_ = null;
 is_large_file_ = false;
 }

 public bool LoadFile(string file_path, bool is_large_file = false)
 {
 file_ = new FILE(file_path, "rb");
 if (!file_.IsValid())
 return false;
 is_large_file_ = is_large_file;
 return true;
 }

 public long GetSize()
 {
 if (is_large_file_)
 {
 file_.Seek(0, SeekOrigin.End);
 long size_long = file_.Tell();
 return size_long;
 }
 else
 {
 file_.Seek(0, SeekOrigin.End);
 return (long)file_.Tell();
 }
 }

 public override bool ReadBlock(IntPtr buffer, long offset, int size)
 {
 if (is_large_file_)
 {
 file_.Seek(offset, SeekOrigin.Begin);
 long read_size = file_.Read(buffer, 1, size);
 return read_size == size;
 }
 else
 {
 if (file_.Seek(offset, SeekOrigin.Begin) != 0)
 return false;
 if (file_.Read(buffer, size, 1) == 0)
 return false;
 return true;
 }
 }

 public override void Release()
 {
 if (file_ != null)
 file_.Close();
 file_ = null;
 }

 public override bool IsDataAvail(long offset, int size)
 {
 return CheckRecordDownloaded(offset, size, false);
 }

 public override bool AddDownloadHint(long offset, int size)
 {
 return CheckRecordDownloaded(offset, size, true);
 }

 protected bool CheckRecordDownloaded(long offset, long size, bool to_download)
 {
 for (int i = 0; i < hint_data_record_.Count; i++)
 {
 DownloadHintDataInfo data_info = hint_data_record_[i];
 if (offset > (data_info.offset + data_info.size))
 continue;
 if (offset + size < data_info.offset)
 continue;
 }
 if (to_download)
 {
 hint_data_record_.Add(new DownloadHintDataInfo(offset, size, true));
 return true;
 }
 return false;
 }
 }

 class Program
 {
 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 Library.Initialize("", "");
 using (AsyncFileRead file_read = new AsyncFileRead())
 {
 file_read.LoadFile("Sample.pdf", true);
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(file_read, true))
 {
 ErrorCode code = ErrorCode.e_ErrDataNotReady;
 while (code == ErrorCode.e_ErrDataNotReady)
 code = doc.Load();
 PDFPage page = null;
 code = ErrorCode.e_ErrDataNotReady;
 while (code == ErrorCode.e_ErrDataNotReady)
 {
 try
 {
 page = doc.GetPage(0);
 break;
 }
 catch (Exception e)
 {
 code = e.GetErrCode();
 }
 }
 }
 }
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to export fdf file
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode errorCode = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (errorCode != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }

 {
 // Export FDF file
 using (foxit.pdf.PDFDoc pdf_doc = new foxit.pdf.PDFDoc("AboutFoxit.pdf"))
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = pdf_doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Library.Release();
 return;
 }

 using (foxit.fdf.FDFDoc fdf_doc = new foxit.fdf.FDFDoc(foxit.fdf.FDFDoc.Type.e_FDF))

 pdf_doc.ExportToFDF(fdf_doc, (int)foxit.pdf.PDFDoc.DataType.e_Annots, new Range());

 Console.WriteLine("Export a fdf file.\n");
 }
 }
 }

 Library.Release();
 }
 }

how to add list box
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.interform;
using foxit.pdf.annots;
using foxit.pdf.actions;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 Library.Initialize(sn, key);

 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc())
 using (Form form = new Form(doc))
 {
 // Create a blank new page and add some form fields.
 using (PDFPage page = doc.InsertPage(0, PDFPage.Size.e_SizeLetter))
 {
 using (Control control = form.AddControl(page, "List Box0", Field.Type.e_TypeListBox, new RectF(50f, 450f, 350f, 500f)))
 using (Field field = control.GetField())
 using (ChoiceOptionArray options = new ChoiceOptionArray())
 {
 options.Add(new ChoiceOption("Foxit SDK", "Foxit SDK", true, true));
 options.Add(new ChoiceOption("Foxit Reader", "Foxit Reader", true, true));
 options.Add(new ChoiceOption("Foxit Phantom", "Foxit Phantom", true, true));
 field.SetOptions(options);

 using (Widget widget = control.GetWidget())
 {
 widget.SetMKBorderColor(0x000000);
 widget.SetMKBackgroundColor(0xFFFFFF);
 widget.ResetAppearanceStream();
 }
 }
 string new_pdf = "form.pdf";
 doc.SaveAs(new_pdf, (int)PDFDoc.SaveFlags.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 }
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}

how to search and replace text
using System;
using System.IO;

using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.addon.pageeditor;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode error_code = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }

 {
 String input_file = "SearchReplaceText.pdf";
 String output_file = "SearchReplaceTextResult.pdf";
 using (PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(input_file))
 {
 error_code = doc.Load(null);
 if (error_code != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 Console.WriteLine("The PDFDoc " + input_file + " Error: " + error_code);
 return;
 }

 // sample 1: search for all pages of doc.
 using (TextSearchReplace searchreplace = new TextSearchReplace(doc))
 using (FindOption find_option = new FindOption(true, true))
 using (ReplaceCallbackImpl replace_callback = new ReplaceCallbackImpl())
 {
 searchreplace.SetReplaceCallback(replace_callback);
 searchreplace.SetPattern("PDF", 0, find_option);
 while (searchreplace.ReplaceNext("PDC") == true) { }

 doc.SaveAs(output_file, 0);
 }
 }
 Console.WriteLine("Search Replace demo finished.");
 }

 Library.Release();
 }

 class ReplaceCallbackImpl : ReplaceCallback
 {
 public ReplaceCallbackImpl()
 {
 }
 public int count = 0;
 public override void Dispose()
 {
 }
 public override bool NeedToReplace(string search_text, string replace_text, int current_page_index, RectFArray text_rect_array)
 {
 count++;
 if (count <= 10) return true;
 else return false;
 }
 public override void Release() { }
 }
 }
}

how to combine pdf files
using System;

using foxit;
using foxit.common;
using foxit.common.fxcrt;
using foxit.pdf;
using foxit.pdf.interform;

namespace FoxitPDFExample
{
 class Program
 {
 static string sn = ""; // Enter the serial number here
 static string key = ""; // Enter the key here

 static void Main(string[] args)
 {
 ErrorCode errorCode = Library.Initialize(sn, key);
 if (errorCode != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess)
 {
 return;
 }

 Console.WriteLine("===Start combine pdf files===");
 CombineDocumentInfo file_info1 = new CombineDocumentInfo("Annot_all.pdf", "");
 file_info1.SetBookmarkTitle("Annot_all.pdf");
 file_info1.SetPDFFileName("Annot_all.pdf");

 using (PDFDoc pdfdoc = new PDFDoc("PDF2Img.pdf"))
 {
 if (pdfdoc.Load(null) != ErrorCode.e_ErrSuccess) return;
 using (CombineDocumentInfo file_info2 = new CombineDocumentInfo(pdfdoc))
 {
 file_info2.SetBookmarkTitle("PDF2Img.pdf");
 file_info2.SetPDFFileName("PDF2Img.pdf");

 using (CombineDocumentInfo file_info3 = new CombineDocumentInfo("SamplePDF.pdf", ""))
 {
 file_info3.SetBookmarkTitle("SamplePDF.pdf");
 file_info3.SetPDFFileName("SamplePDF.pdf");

 using (CombineDocumentInfoArray combine_document_array = new CombineDocumentInfoArray())
 {
 combine_document_array.Add(file_info1);
 combine_document_array.Add(file_info2);
 combine_document_array.Add(file_info3);
 int flag = (int)Convert.ToUInt32(0xFFFFFFFC);
 Combination.StartCombineDocuments("pdfcombination.pdf", combine_document_array, flag, null);
 }

 }

 }

 }
 Library.Release();
 }
 }
}
